selected_candidates.why_matched: 该模型直接针对实时安全约束 OPF，目标是最小化累计发电运行成本，同时满足功率平衡、线路潮流、电压、机组出力、爬坡以及安全/事故后约束，和用户对安全与运行约束的要求高度一致。/ This model directly targets real-time security-constrained OPF, aiming to minimize cumulative generation operating cost while satisfying power balance, line-flow, voltage, generator, ramping, and security/post-contingency constraints, closely matching the user's safety and operating-constraint requirements.

supporting_evidence: hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve sequential real-time security-constrained optimal power flow with fast dispatch decisions under inaccurate environmental parameters. / hasPrimaryPurpose: 在环境参数不准确的情况下求解序列实时安全约束最优潮流并快速给出调度决策。

hasSolvedProblem: Sequential security-constrained AC optimal power flow for real-time operation with generator active/reactive dispatch and network security limits. / hasSolvedProblem: 面向实时运行的序列安全约束 AC 最优潮流，包含机组有功/无功调度与网络安全限制。
hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize cumulative generation operating cost, with quadratic cost coefficients for each generator over time. / hasObjectiveFunction: 最小化累计发电运行成本，且各机组采用二次成本系数。

hasConstraintFunction: AC power-balance equations, branch active/reactive flow equations, generator active/reactive limits, branch flow limits, voltage magnitude limits, and ramping-coupled generator bounds; safety-layer projection also enforces linearized security constraints and power balance. / hasConstraintFunction: AC 功率平衡方程、支路有功/无功潮流方程、机组有功/无功限值、支路潮流限值、电压幅值限值以及与爬坡耦合的机组边界；安全层投影还施加线性化安全约束与功率平衡。

hasPrimaryOutput: Safe generator active and reactive power dispatch commands; resulting bus voltage magnitudes and branch active/reactive power flows within limits. / hasPrimaryOutput: 安全的机组有功/无功调度指令；以及满足限值的母线电压幅值和支路有功/无功潮流。

hasFindingsSummary: The method maintains voltages and branch flows within safe ranges, reduces violation times in early training and contingencies, and scales to larger systems with low decision time. / hasFindingsSummary: 该方法可将电压和支路潮流维持在安全范围内，减少训练早期与事故场景中的违规时间，并以较低决策时间扩展到更大系统。

raw_output.group_summary: 本组中最匹配的是面向实时/安全/成本最小化的 AC OPF 与安全约束 OPF 模型，尤其是需求响应调度、实时强化学习、序列安全约束、多时段安全约束、概率鲁棒 AC OPF，以及图神经网络近似 ACOPF。/ The best matches in this group are AC OPF and security-constrained OPF models aimed at real-time, secure, and cost-minimizing operation, especially demand-response scheduling, real-time reinforcement learning, sequential security-constrained OPF, multi-step security-constrained OPF, probabilistically robust AC OPF, and GNN-based ACOPF approximation.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 该模型直接面向 AC OPF 下的需求响应调度，目标明确包含降低系统总成本、峰值与运行代价，并同时满足电压、线路潮流、功率平衡等约束。/ This model directly targets demand-response scheduling within AC OPF, explicitly aiming to reduce total system cost, peak demand, and operating cost while satisfying voltage, line-flow, and power-balance constraints.

data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can AC OPF coordinate demand response and flexible-load aggregators to lower cost and peaks without violating grid and comfort constraints?

data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: 24-hour scheduling with hourly intervals.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Scenario-based renewable uncertainty and LSTM-based load forecasting; EV energy and travel distance modeled with normal distribution.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Smart grid transmission network with thermal units, wind, solar, ESS, EVs, HVACs, and load shedding.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Solved as MINLP in GAMS with CONOPT3; TOPSIS used to select the preferred DR step.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Evaluated on modified IEEE 24-bus and IEEE 118-bus systems; reports cost, peak reduction, voltage variation, and execution time.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Demand response for large flexible loads plus aggregated EV and HVAC loads with comfort and participation limits.

data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 24-bus and 118-bus systems using 12 renewable scenarios and DR steps from 0% to 25%.

data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Claims faster decision-making and reduced security violations with comparable economic performance.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Co-optimize energy dispatch and operating reserve allocation in AC power system operation.

data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses predefined zonal reserve requirements; no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model.

data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Accelerated primal-dual interior point method with symmetric Jacobian, Cholesky factorization, direct step-size update, and tailored initialization.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for faster and more stable solution of large-scale RCOPF instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consuming devices participate in energy and reserve provision.

data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Solved by A-PDIPM using perturbed KKT conditions, symmetric Jacobian construction, pivoted Cholesky factorization, matrix reordering/scaling, direct feasibility-preserving step sizes, and problem-specific primal/dual initialization.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on 73-bus to 23,643-bus GO3-derived cases; compared with pre-reserve/post-reserve OPF and IPOPT.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: RCOPF produced converged secure solutions and higher market surplus than simplified reserve allocation approaches; A-PDIPM reduced iterations and runtime, especially on large cases.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: accurate AC co-optimization with reserves and improved computational efficiency. Limitation: single-period formulation and some scenarios still allow reserve shortfalls when economically optimal.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve distributed optimal power flow under unreliable communication by estimating exchanged global variables.

data_properties.hasModelFeature: Multi-agent distributed OPF with coordinator-agent consensus and predictive estimation of missing exchanged variables.

data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Handles unreliable communication by estimating missing consensus messages with a trained DFNN.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: IEEE 14-bus transmission network partitioned into three regions with PV units and a BESS.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Extended ADMM combined with a shallow feedforward neural-network estimator for missing messages.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Faster convergence to actual global variables and feasible D-OPF results under interrupted links.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost for each region/sub-network.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Regional OPF constraints are enforced through bus-voltage and tie-line coupling; line power flows are updated from estimated voltages and consensus variables.

data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: IEEE 14-bus case split into three areas; ADMM iterations compute regional OPF, estimate missing voltages with DFNN, average exchanged voltages, and update line flows.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Compared three scenarios: normal communication, lost bus-5 communication, and lost communication recovered by estimation; tested on IEEE 14-bus case.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: With DFNN-based estimation, interrupted-link cases converged closer to global voltages and faster than the unrecovered communication-loss case.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: improves distributed OPF feasibility and convergence under communication loss. Limitation: estimator still shows biased error and needs more training data.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: ANN/DFNN estimator trained on OPF data generated from 90%–100% loading scenarios.

checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是偏重 N-1 预防式安全约束与离线/基态调度，实时调整成本与市场成本不是其主轴。 / English explanation: The main gap is its emphasis on N-1 preventive security constraints and offline/base-case dispatch; real-time adjustment cost and market-cost modeling are not its main focus.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足成本最小化与 AC 潮流、电压、线路等约束的核心要求，但它把需求响应、储能、EV/HVAC 和可再生不确定性一起纳入，问题设定明显比纯 OPF 更复杂。 / English explanation: This model satisfies the core requirements of cost minimization under AC power-flow, voltage, and line constraints, but it jointly includes demand response, storage, EV/HVAC, and renewable uncertainty, making the formulation substantially more complex than a pure OPF.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：相较于用户的通用 OPF 需求，它额外引入了需求侧业务约束与多类聚合器控制；若只想要发电侧成本最小化，这会偏重。 / English explanation: Relative to the user's general OPF need, it adds demand-side business constraints and multiple aggregator controls; if only generation-side cost minimization is desired, it is heavier than necessary.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型非常契合实时安全约束 OPF 场景，明确最小化累计发电运行成本，并满足功率平衡、线路、电压、机组与爬坡等约束；它对实时调度的匹配度很高。 / English explanation: This model fits real-time security-constrained OPF very well, explicitly minimizing cumulative generation operating cost while satisfying power balance, line, voltage, generator, and ramping constraints; its alignment with real-time dispatch is strong.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要限制在于其安全层依赖线性化潮流近似，面对强非线性或极端工况时可能更保守，且更偏向序列决策而非传统集中式 OPF。 / English explanation: The main limitation is that its safety layer relies on linearized power-flow approximations, which may be conservative under strong nonlinearity or extreme conditions, and it is more sequential-decision oriented than conventional centralized OPF.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足“最小化运行成本并满足潮流/安全约束”的核心方向，且显式考虑风光随机性、备用与惩罚成本；但它是单时段静态 OPF，且采用启发式求解。 / English explanation: This model matches the core direction of minimizing operating cost under power-flow/security constraints and explicitly considers wind/solar uncertainty, reserves, and penalty costs; however, it is a single-period static OPF solved by a heuristic.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是缺少多时段或实时滚动调度能力，也不提供严格全局最优保证。 / English explanation: The main gaps are the lack of multi-period or real-time rolling dispatch capability and no strict global optimality guarantee.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型与实时调节成本/运行成本最小化需求高度一致，明确在实时 OPF 中最小化发电成本，并满足电压、线路、爬坡与功率平衡约束。 / English explanation: This model is highly consistent with real-time adjustment/operating-cost minimization, explicitly minimizing generation cost in real-time OPF while satisfying voltage, line, ramping, and power-balance constraints.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要限制是对训练后的策略依赖较强，且验证范围相对集中；它更像实时近似控制器，而不是传统求解器。 / English explanation: The main limitation is its strong dependence on trained policy behavior and a relatively narrow validation scope; it behaves more like a real-time approximate controller than a traditional solver.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型很好地覆盖了多时段成本最小化与 AC/DC 潮流、线路、电压、储能等约束，适合用户提到的运行/市场成本控制。 / English explanation: This model covers multi-period cost minimization very well together with AC/DC power-flow, line, voltage, and storage constraints, making it suitable for the user's operating/market-cost control setting.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要偏向灵活性市场清算与 TSO-DSO 协调，且未包含无功灵活性；若只要单时段 OPF，它会偏复杂。 / English explanation: It is mainly oriented toward flexibility market clearing and TSO-DSO coordination, and it does not include reactive-power flexibility; if only single-period OPF is needed, it is more complex than necessary.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型同时覆盖日前与实时 OPF，目标包含实时总发电成本最小化与日前利润/收益相关目标，并显式考虑电压、线路、无功、爬坡和备用约束。 / English explanation: This model covers both day-ahead and real-time OPF, with objectives including real-time total generation cost minimization and day-ahead profit/revenue-related terms, while explicitly handling voltage, line, reactive power, ramping, and reserve constraints.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是依赖预测波动与固定参与因子，对更强随机/鲁棒建模或更复杂市场机制的覆盖有限。 / English explanation: The main gap is reliance on forecasted variability and fixed participation factors, with limited coverage for stronger stochastic/robust modeling or more complex market mechanisms.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足配电网 OPF 中的潮流、线路与电压约束，并以经济优化为目标，但其重点是径向配电网与分接头离散控制，目标更偏向网损或变电站注入优化。 / English explanation: This model satisfies power-flow, line, and voltage constraints in distribution OPF and pursues economic optimization, but it focuses on radial distribution networks and discrete tap control, with objectives leaning more toward loss or substation-injection optimization.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：相较于用户的通用系统运营成本最小化需求，它更偏配电侧单时段问题，且不直接面向实时市场或广义安全约束。 / English explanation: Relative to the user's general system operating-cost minimization need, it is more of a distribution-side single-period problem and does not directly target real-time market or broader security constraints.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足多时段安全约束 OPF、AC 潮流、事故、备用、爬坡与设备约束等要求，并面向大规模系统的成本/市场优化。 / English explanation: This model satisfies multi-step security-constrained OPF requirements, including AC power flow, contingencies, reserves, ramping, and device constraints, and it targets cost/market optimization for large-scale systems.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要偏向大规模分解与市场盈余最大化，整体复杂度较高；若用户只需要单次实时成本最小化，它会显得过重。 / English explanation: It is mainly geared toward large-scale decomposition and market-surplus maximization, with high overall complexity; if the user only needs single-shot real-time cost minimization, it is heavier than necessary.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型与“最小化运行成本并满足潮流、电压、线路和机组约束”一致，但它更偏日前机组组合与 OPF 联合优化，而不是实时调整成本。 / English explanation: This model is consistent with minimizing operating cost under power-flow, voltage, line, and generator constraints, but it is more about day-ahead unit commitment plus OPF than real-time adjustment cost.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是缺少显式随机/鲁棒不确定性建模，且时间尺度集中在 24 小时日前计划。 / English explanation: The main gaps are the lack of explicit stochastic/robust uncertainty modeling and a focus on a 24-hour day-ahead planning horizon.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足安全约束 OPF 与成本最小化的核心要求，并显式考虑电压、线路、机组和无功补偿约束；适合需要快速近似求解的场景。 / English explanation: This model satisfies the core requirements of security-constrained OPF and cost minimization, explicitly considering voltage, line, generator, and reactive-compensation constraints; it is suitable for fast approximate solving scenarios.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要限制是它更偏单时段机器学习近似求解，不是多时段实时成本优化框架。 / English explanation: The main limitation is that it is more of a single-period machine-learning approximation than a multi-period real-time cost-optimization framework.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足分布式 OPF 下的总发电成本最小化与潮流可行性要求，适合多区域协同优化场景。 / English explanation: This model satisfies total generation cost minimization and power-flow feasibility in distributed OPF, making it suitable for multi-area coordinated optimization scenarios.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要重点是通信不可靠下的分布式协调与变量估计，而不是集中式 OPF 的通用经济调度；若用户更关注单系统直接成本最优，它的定位不完全一致。 / English explanation: Its main focus is distributed coordination and variable estimation under unreliable communication rather than general centralized economic dispatch; if the user cares more about direct single-system cost optimality, its positioning is not fully aligned.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型与用户需求高度一致，直接以最小化发电/运行成本为目标，并显式满足 AC 潮流、安全、电压与线路约束；唯一的小缺口是它更偏向预防式安全约束调度，对“实时调整成本/市场成本”的显式建模不是核心。 / English explanation: This model is highly consistent with the user need: it directly minimizes generation/operating cost and explicitly enforces AC power-flow, security, voltage, and line constraints; the only minor gap is that it is oriented toward preventive security-constrained dispatch rather than explicit real-time adjustment or market-cost modeling.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是偏重 N-1 预防式安全约束与离线/基态调度，实时调整成本与市场成本不是其主轴。 / English explanation: The main gap is its emphasis on N-1 preventive security constraints and offline/base-case dispatch; real-time adjustment cost and market-cost modeling are not its main focus.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型非常契合实时安全约束 OPF 场景，明确最小化累计发电运行成本，并满足功率平衡、线路、电压、机组与爬坡等约束；它对实时调度的匹配度很高。 / English explanation: This model fits real-time security-constrained OPF very well, explicitly minimizing cumulative generation operating cost while satisfying power balance, line, voltage, generator, and ramping constraints; its alignment with real-time dispatch is strong.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要限制在于其安全层依赖线性化潮流近似，面对强非线性或极端工况时可能更保守，且更偏向序列决策而非传统集中式 OPF。 / English explanation: The main limitation is that its safety layer relies on linearized power-flow approximations, which may be conservative under strong nonlinearity or extreme conditions, and it is more sequential-decision oriented than conventional centralized OPF.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型与实时调节成本/运行成本最小化需求高度一致，明确在实时 OPF 中最小化发电成本，并满足电压、线路、爬坡与功率平衡约束。 / English explanation: This model is highly consistent with real-time adjustment/operating-cost minimization, explicitly minimizing generation cost in real-time OPF while satisfying voltage, line, ramping, and power-balance constraints.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要限制是对训练后的策略依赖较强，且验证范围相对集中；它更像实时近似控制器，而不是传统求解器。 / English explanation: The main limitation is its strong dependence on trained policy behavior and a relatively narrow validation scope; it behaves more like a real-time approximate controller than a traditional solver.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型很好地覆盖了多时段成本最小化与 AC/DC 潮流、线路、电压、储能等约束，适合用户提到的运行/市场成本控制。 / English explanation: This model covers multi-period cost minimization very well together with AC/DC power-flow, line, voltage, and storage constraints, making it suitable for the user's operating/market-cost control setting.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要偏向灵活性市场清算与 TSO-DSO 协调，且未包含无功灵活性；若只要单时段 OPF，它会偏复杂。 / English explanation: It is mainly oriented toward flexibility market clearing and TSO-DSO coordination, and it does not include reactive-power flexibility; if only single-period OPF is needed, it is more complex than necessary.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型同时覆盖日前与实时 OPF，目标包含实时总发电成本最小化与日前利润/收益相关目标，并显式考虑电压、线路、无功、爬坡和备用约束。 / English explanation: This model covers both day-ahead and real-time OPF, with objectives including real-time total generation cost minimization and day-ahead profit/revenue-related terms, while explicitly handling voltage, line, reactive power, ramping, and reserve constraints.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是依赖预测波动与固定参与因子，对更强随机/鲁棒建模或更复杂市场机制的覆盖有限。 / English explanation: The main gap is reliance on forecasted variability and fixed participation factors, with limited coverage for stronger stochastic/robust modeling or more complex market mechanisms.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足成本最小化与 AC 潮流、电压、线路等约束的核心要求，但它把需求响应、储能、EV/HVAC 和可再生不确定性一起纳入，问题设定明显比纯 OPF 更复杂。 / English explanation: This model satisfies the core requirements of cost minimization under AC power-flow, voltage, and line constraints, but it jointly includes demand response, storage, EV/HVAC, and renewable uncertainty, making the formulation substantially more complex than a pure OPF.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：相较于用户的通用 OPF 需求，它额外引入了需求侧业务约束与多类聚合器控制；若只想要发电侧成本最小化，这会偏重。 / English explanation: Relative to the user's general OPF need, it adds demand-side business constraints and multiple aggregator controls; if only generation-side cost minimization is desired, it is heavier than necessary.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足多时段安全约束 OPF、AC 潮流、事故、备用、爬坡与设备约束等要求，并面向大规模系统的成本/市场优化。 / English explanation: This model satisfies multi-step security-constrained OPF requirements, including AC power flow, contingencies, reserves, ramping, and device constraints, and it targets cost/market optimization for large-scale systems.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要偏向大规模分解与市场盈余最大化，整体复杂度较高；若用户只需要单次实时成本最小化，它会显得过重。 / English explanation: It is mainly geared toward large-scale decomposition and market-surplus maximization, with high overall complexity; if the user only needs single-shot real-time cost minimization, it is heavier than necessary.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足“最小化运行成本并满足潮流/安全约束”的核心方向，且显式考虑风光随机性、备用与惩罚成本；但它是单时段静态 OPF，且采用启发式求解。 / English explanation: This model matches the core direction of minimizing operating cost under power-flow/security constraints and explicitly considers wind/solar uncertainty, reserves, and penalty costs; however, it is a single-period static OPF solved by a heuristic.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是缺少多时段或实时滚动调度能力，也不提供严格全局最优保证。 / English explanation: The main gaps are the lack of multi-period or real-time rolling dispatch capability and no strict global optimality guarantee.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型与“最小化运行成本并满足潮流、电压、线路和机组约束”一致，但它更偏日前机组组合与 OPF 联合优化，而不是实时调整成本。 / English explanation: This model is consistent with minimizing operating cost under power-flow, voltage, line, and generator constraints, but it is more about day-ahead unit commitment plus OPF than real-time adjustment cost.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是缺少显式随机/鲁棒不确定性建模，且时间尺度集中在 24 小时日前计划。 / English explanation: The main gaps are the lack of explicit stochastic/robust uncertainty modeling and a focus on a 24-hour day-ahead planning horizon.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足安全约束 OPF 与成本最小化的核心要求，并显式考虑电压、线路、机组和无功补偿约束；适合需要快速近似求解的场景。 / English explanation: This model satisfies the core requirements of security-constrained OPF and cost minimization, explicitly considering voltage, line, generator, and reactive-compensation constraints; it is suitable for fast approximate solving scenarios.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要限制是它更偏单时段机器学习近似求解，不是多时段实时成本优化框架。 / English explanation: The main limitation is that it is more of a single-period machine-learning approximation than a multi-period real-time cost-optimization framework.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型把备用纳入 AC OPF，并同时考虑市场盈余/成本权衡、线路、电压与备用约束，和用户对成本与安全约束并重的需求相符。 / English explanation: This model incorporates reserves into AC OPF and jointly considers market-surplus/cost trade-offs, line, voltage, and reserve constraints, aligning with the user's need to balance cost and security constraints.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是单时段设定，且重点在备用与市场盈余而非实时滚动调度。 / English explanation: The main gap is its single-period setting, with emphasis on reserves and market surplus rather than real-time rolling dispatch.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型直接以 OPF 成本最小化为目标，并满足 AC 潮流、电压、线路与机组约束，适合快速近似求解成本最小化 OPF。 / English explanation: This model directly targets OPF cost minimization and satisfies AC power-flow, voltage, line, and generator constraints, making it suitable for fast approximate cost-minimizing OPF.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是学习型近似求解，对新系统或新运行区间的泛化与精度依赖训练样本与分区策略。 / English explanation: The main gap is that it is a learning-based approximate solver, so generalization and accuracy on new systems or operating regions depend on training samples and partitioning strategy.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足混合 AC/DC 网络下的成本最小化与电压、线路、变压器、VSC 等约束，适合网络约束下的经济优化。 / English explanation: This model satisfies cost minimization under hybrid AC/DC network constraints, including voltage, line, transformer, and VSC limits, making it suitable for economic optimization under network constraints.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是静态单时段且采用元启发式求解，对实时调整成本、多时段市场成本或严格最优性证明覆盖有限。 / English explanation: The main gaps are its static single-period nature and metaheuristic solution approach, with limited coverage for real-time adjustment cost, multi-period market cost, or rigorous optimality guarantees.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足配电网 OPF 中的潮流、线路与电压约束，并以经济优化为目标，但其重点是径向配电网与分接头离散控制，目标更偏向网损或变电站注入优化。 / English explanation: This model satisfies power-flow, line, and voltage constraints in distribution OPF and pursues economic optimization, but it focuses on radial distribution networks and discrete tap control, with objectives leaning more toward loss or substation-injection optimization.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：相较于用户的通用系统运营成本最小化需求，它更偏配电侧单时段问题，且不直接面向实时市场或广义安全约束。 / English explanation: Relative to the user's general system operating-cost minimization need, it is more of a distribution-side single-period problem and does not directly target real-time market or broader security constraints.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Fast solution of preventive security-constrained optimal power flow using a hybrid data-driven DRL method
data_properties.hasMotivation: Conventional SCOPF solvers are computationally burdensome for online applications under contingencies and volatile operating conditions
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Preventive security-constrained optimal power flow with N-1 contingency constraints
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid model-assisted DRL method solve SCOPF rapidly while satisfying security constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal base-case dispatch decisions, including generator active power setpoints and generator-bus voltage setpoints, with contingency-feasible bus voltages and branch flows
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid data-driven, model-assisted deep reinforcement learning with primal-dual DDPG and interior-point/KKT gradient derivation
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations for base case and contingencies; sparse Jacobians and Hessians
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single operating point with multiple contingency scenarios
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Base case plus all considered contingencies
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Monte Carlo load-scenario generation for training data; no explicit stochastic optimization
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security constraints on generator limits, bus voltage magnitudes, and transmission line flows
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Closed-form actor gradients from KKT conditions; sparse matrix formulation; interior-point updates
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Real-time online inference after offline training; high-quality feasible solutions
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, defined as the sum of quadratic generator cost functions over the base case
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints enforce AC power balance for base case and contingencies; inequality constraints enforce generator capacity, bus-voltage bounds, and transmission-line flow limits
data_properties.usesParameter: Bus voltage magnitudes and angles; generator active and reactive powers; base-case control variables vg and pg; contingency index k; contingency line outages; load states p and q; Lagrange multipliers; slack variables; learning rate
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Offline supervised initialization followed by DRL training using power-flow evaluations, KKT-based Newton steps, and sparse Jacobian/Hessian calculations; online stage outputs SCOPF controls directly
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on modified IEEE 57-bus, modified IEEE 300-bus, and ACTIVSg2000 systems with Monte Carlo load scenarios and critical contingencies
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method achieves near-benchmark operating cost, satisfies security constraints much better than supervised learning, and is orders of magnitude faster than IPOPT-based SCOPF
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: fast, constraint-aware, scalable to larger systems. Limitations: still slightly higher cost than IPOPT and some reactive-power violations may remain under contingencies
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Preventive SCOPF; model-assisted RL; contingency filtering used in experiments

data_properties.hasAuthor: Mohammadreza Chamanbaz; Fabrizio Dabbene; Constantino M. Lagoa
data_properties.hasInstitution: iTrust Center for Research in Cyber Security, Singapore University of Technology and Design; CNR-IEIIT, Torino, Italy; Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Penn State University
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Minimize generation cost in AC optimal power flow while satisfying network constraints under uncertain loads and renewable generation with probabilistic guarantees.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Classical OPF dispatch is rigid and can become inefficient or infeasible under renewable and load uncertainty, causing overloads and outages.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Robust and chance-constrained AC optimal power flow with uncertain loads and renewable generators.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can AC-OPF be solved efficiently under uncertainty while limiting the probability of violating generation and transmission constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal controllable generation dispatch, generator voltage magnitudes, deployment vector, and corresponding bus voltage and line-flow-feasible operating point.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Scenario-with-certificates formulation combined with convex SDP relaxation of AC power flow.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with voltage-magnitude and line-flow constraints via lifted matrix W.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period OPF repeated over hourly demand scenarios in experiments.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per solve; 24 hourly solves in simulation.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Probabilistic uncertainty in loads and renewable generation using scenario with certificates and chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes renewable generators, uncertain loads, generator participation factors, voltage limits, and transmission limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Convex relaxation plus randomized scenario-with-certificates sampling.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: A priori probabilistic guarantee on constraint-violation risk; exact for a restricted class of networks.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Uncertain loads are explicitly modeled and balanced through generator deployment factors.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost f(u); in the penalized variant, worst-case cost adds reactive-power and line-loss penalties.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power balance equalities; generator active/reactive limits; voltage magnitude bounds; line-voltage-difference or apparent-flow limits; deployment factors sum to one and remain nonnegative.
data_properties.usesParameter: Uncertain complex load and renewable deviations δ; deployment vector α; bus-voltage matrix W split into Wu and Wx; risk levels ε and β; line admittances ylm; voltage and power limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Uses SDP lifting W=VV* and scenario-with-certificates sampling to solve a convex program; implemented with YALMIP and Mosek.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the New England 39-bus system with Monte Carlo testing over 10,000 samples and comparison against nominal OPF and a prior probabilistic AC-OPF method.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method greatly reduced infeasible samples and line-flow violations versus nominal OPF, while using far fewer scenario samples than the compared parameterized approach.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Can incorporate N-1 security constraints and outage probabilities within the same scenario framework.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: A Deep Neural Network-based Frequency Predictor for Frequency-Constrained Optimal Power Flow
data_properties.hasAuthor: Fan Jiang; Xingpeng Li; Pascal Van Hentenryck
data_properties.hasInstitution: University of Houston; Georgia Institute of Technology
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Real-time frequency-constrained optimal power flow with DNN-based RoCoF and frequency nadir constraints.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Accurate RoCoF and frequency nadir constraints are complex to compute, yet needed for fast real-time FCOPF.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Traditional OPF lacks frequency security; linearized FCOPF can be inaccurate for RoCoF and frequency nadir.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a DNN predictor replace simplified frequency constraints in FCOPF while improving accuracy and maintaining solvability?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generator dispatch with associated RoCoF and frequency nadir values under contingencies.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: FCOPF augmented with a DNN-based frequency predictor and mixed-integer linearized ReLU constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: DC power flow with nodal balance, line flow equations, generator limits, and thermal limits.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period real-time dispatch; no multi-period horizon.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Real-time OPF, described as run about every 5 minutes.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Scenario-based EMT training data across varying loads, generator outputs, and outage locations; no explicit stochastic optimization.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Frequency security constraints for low-inertia grids using RoCoF and frequency nadir.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: DNN predictor linearized with mixed-integer constraints and solved with Gurobi.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Compared solve time and frequency-metric accuracy against T-OPF and linear FCOPF.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Load variations are included as scenario inputs; no explicit demand response or load control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost using quadratic generator cost functions, sum_i(c2_i Pg_i^2 + c1_i Pg_i + c0_i).
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Nodal power balance, DC line flow equations, generator output bounds, transmission line thermal limits, and frequency constraints on RoCoF and frequency nadir.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients c2_i, c1_i, c0_i; line reactance x_k; generator and line limits; system inertia H_sys; base power P_base; base frequency f0; RoCoF and frequency thresholds; DNN weights, biases, and ReLU bounds.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Implemented in Python 3.9 with Gurobi; DNN trained on PSCAD/EMTDC simulation data and embedded as mixed-integer linear constraints.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated against PSCAD/EMTDC simulations on a modified IEEE 9-bus system under normal and high-load contingencies.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: DNN-FCOPF produced frequency metrics much closer to EMT simulations than linear FCOPF, with modest extra cost and longer solve time.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Improves frequency-security accuracy over linear FCOPF, but adds mixed-integer complexity and depends on training-data coverage.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Evaluated under multiple load profiles and contingencies, including out-of-distribution high-load cases.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Reserve Constrained AC Optimal Power Flow Using Accelerated Primal-Dual Interior Point Method
data_properties.hasAuthor: Yehong Peng; Yong Fu
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Co-optimize energy dispatch and operating reserve allocation in AC power system operation.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Conventional reserve scheduling or simplified ED-based approaches neglect full AC network constraints and can cause infeasibility, voltage insecurity, congestion, and suboptimality.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Single-period reserve-constrained AC optimal power flow with device energy/reserve co-optimization, AC network limits, and zonal reserve requirements.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can reserve models be efficiently incorporated into AC OPF and solved accurately for large-scale systems?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation and consumption dispatch, device reserve allocations, bus voltage magnitudes and angles, AC branch power flows, shunt steps, transformer tap ratios and phase shifts, and reserve shortfall amounts.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Single-period nonlinear AC OPF with co-optimized energy and real/reactive reserve scheduling.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Full AC branch flow equations with voltage magnitudes/angles, transformer tap ratios, phase shifting, and shunt modeling.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses predefined zonal reserve requirements; no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes producing and consuming devices, real/reactive reserves, zonal reserve zones, shunts, transformers, and branch overload penalties.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Accelerated primal-dual interior point method with symmetric Jacobian, Cholesky factorization, direct step-size update, and tailored initialization.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for faster and more stable solution of large-scale RCOPF instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consuming devices participate in energy and reserve provision.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus: device consumption benefit minus generation cost, imbalance penalties, branch overload penalties, reserve offer costs, zonal reserve shortfall penalties, and reactive reserve costs.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints enforce device definitions, reserve cost definitions, AC branch flow equations, bus real/reactive power balances, and zonal reserve requirements; inequalities bound device outputs, reserve capabilities, voltage magnitudes, transformer settings, branch apparent flows, shunt steps, and reserve requirements.
data_properties.usesParameter: Offer/bid block prices, imbalance penalty costs, branch overload penalty cost, reserve marginal costs, branch conductance/susceptance, shunt coefficients, device power limits, reserve capability limits, zonal reserve requirements and scaling factors, branch flow limits, voltage/tap/phase bounds.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Solved by A-PDIPM using perturbed KKT conditions, symmetric Jacobian construction, pivoted Cholesky factorization, matrix reordering/scaling, direct feasibility-preserving step sizes, and problem-specific primal/dual initialization.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on 73-bus to 23,643-bus GO3-derived cases; compared with pre-reserve/post-reserve OPF and IPOPT.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: RCOPF produced converged secure solutions and higher market surplus than simplified reserve allocation approaches; A-PDIPM reduced iterations and runtime, especially on large cases.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: accurate AC co-optimization with reserves and improved computational efficiency. Limitation: single-period formulation and some scenarios still allow reserve shortfalls when economically optimal.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Derived from DOE ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Chance-Constrained OPF: A Distributed Method With Confidentiality Preservation
data_properties.hasAuthor: Mengshuo Jia; Gabriela Hug; Yifan Su; Chen Shen
data_properties.hasInstitution: ETH Zurich; Tsinghua University
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve multi-regional chance-constrained optimal power flow in a distributed, confidentiality-preserving way.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Regional ISOs in interconnected grids need coordinated CC-OPF but cannot disclose confidential generator, load, topology, and line data.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Centralized CC-OPF is unsuitable for multi-regional interconnected grids with confidential regional data.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can CC-OPF be solved exactly in a distributed manner while preserving each ISO’s confidential information?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal dispatchable generation schedules across regions; associated bus voltage and line-flow constraint satisfaction under chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Uses decoupled linearized power flow to express voltages and line flows as linear functions of injections.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Multi-period day-ahead dispatch over T time slots.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Time slots; case studies use 24 hourly periods.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Day-ahead, 24 time slots in experiments.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Chance constraints with wind-power uncertainty modeled by Gaussian mixture distributions.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Multi-regional interconnected grid with dispatchable generators, wind farms, loads, voltages, and line flows.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Transformation-based encryption plus accelerated average consensus and privacy-preserving average consensus.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported exact optimality relative to centralized benchmark and high accuracy across system sizes and load levels.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost: sum over regions and time of quadratic and linear dispatchable-generation costs.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Capacity bounds, ramp-rate limits, supply-demand chance constraint, and chance constraints on voltages or line flows converted to deterministic inequalities.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generation cost coefficients, generator capacity bounds, ramp-rate bounds, wind-power quantiles from GMMs, chance limits εb and αS, and DLPF mapping coefficients.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Convert chance constraints to deterministic form, encrypt regional variables and coefficients, compute coupled coefficients and aggregated constants via distributed consensus, solve transformed QP, then decrypt regional optimal dispatch.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on multiple IEEE and PEGASE test systems; proposed method matched centralized solutions with very small relative errors.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The method achieves distributed CC-OPF without revealing confidential data and without optimality loss relative to the benchmark.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: exact optimality, no parameter tuning, confidentiality preservation. Limitation: relies on linearized power flow and is not directly full AC OPF.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Applicable to AGC-aware CC-OPF with deterministic participation factors and extendable to joint-chance-constrained OPF.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: To advocate and outline grid foundation models for power-system operations, planning, and control.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Increasing grid complexity and uncertainty from the energy transition, climate change, aging infrastructure, and cybersecurity threats.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Lack of scalable, transferable AI methods for diverse power-grid tasks and power-flow-related applications.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can foundation models be developed for electric power grids to generalize across grid data and accelerate downstream applications such as power flow and OPF?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: No OPF model is solved in this paper; it proposes a GridFM-v0 concept for reconstructing power-flow states and, in discussed downstream use, optimal generation dispatch and objective values.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Graph neural network-based foundation model concept; masked autoencoder pre-training on graph-structured grid data.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power flow reconstruction on graph nodes with bus variables and line/transformer edges.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Initially single-time-step power-flow data; extendable to multiple consecutive time steps for forecasting.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Single time step in the near-term model; high-resolution PMU data mentioned for dynamic extensions.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Not specified; near-term focus is static power-flow applications.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses diverse topologies, load conditions, perturbations, and synthetic scenarios; discusses scenario trees and stochastic programming.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Transmission and distribution grid applications including power flow, OPF, contingency analysis, state estimation, stability, control, planning, and cybersecurity.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Self-supervised masked graph autoencoding with physics-informed loss; intended to speed up power-flow-related computation.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Projected 3–4 orders-of-magnitude speed-up over conventional power-flow solvers; less than 1% error cited from related GNN work.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Mentions load conditions, load forecasting, electric vehicles, heating electrification, and demand uncertainty.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: For OPF use, minimize generation costs by reconstructing generator power; the paper does not present a full OPF mathematical formulation.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Reconstructed node variables must satisfy power-flow equations and bounds such as generator capacity constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Bus active power, reactive power, voltage magnitude, voltage angle; line and transformer connectivity; topology, load conditions, and power-flow solutions.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: GridFM-v0 is proposed as a masked graph autoencoder pre-trained on solved power-flow cases from multiple topologies and load conditions, then fine-tuned for downstream tasks.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: No direct model validation results are reported for GridFM-v0; validation is proposed on open datasets and later on utility data behind firewalls.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The paper argues GridFMs could generalize across grid tasks and substantially accelerate power-system analysis, especially power-flow-related applications.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: scalability, adaptability, and simulation acceleration. Limitations: data availability, privacy, trust, and difficulty accessing operational grid data.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper is a perspective proposing a roadmap rather than presenting a completed OPF solver.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Day-Ahead and Real Time Optimal Power Flow considering Renewable Energy Resources
data_properties.hasAuthor: S. Surender Reddy; P.R. Bijwe
data_properties.hasInstitution: Woosong University; Indian Institute of Technology Delhi
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: To schedule generation economically while maintaining security in day-ahead and real-time OPF with renewable variability.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Conventional DA-OPF and RT-OPF use static snapshots and ignore renewable/load variability within scheduling intervals.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Optimal power flow for thermal-wind-solar systems with renewable variability, voltage, reactive power, line-flow, and ramp constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can participation factors evaluated once at the start of each interval capture intra-interval renewable variability without increasing optimization dimensionality?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generator dispatch schedules, renewable generation schedules, interval costs/profits, and voltage stability index values.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Single optimization with 'best-fit' participation factors over sub-interval variability.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with voltage magnitude/angle, reactive power, and line-flow constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Day-ahead and real-time multi-interval scheduling with 15-min and 1-min sub-intervals.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: RT-OPF: 1 min sub-intervals within 10-min intervals; DA-OPF: 15 min sub-sub-intervals within 1 h intervals.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: RT-OPF over 60 min; DA-OPF over 24 h.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses forecasted solar, wind, and load variability within intervals; no explicit stochastic or robust formulation.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Thermal generators with wind and solar PV injections, AGC participation factors, ramp limits, and voltage stability index.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Evaluates 'best-fit' participation factors once to avoid separate optimization for every sub-interval.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported lower total cost and improved voltage stability versus conventional interval-by-interval OPF.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Forecasted load demand varies within sub-intervals and is included in imbalance calculations.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost over RT sub-intervals; maximize total profit over DA intervals as revenue minus generation cost.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Active and reactive nodal power balance, generator output limits with ramp-up/down limits, renewable output caps, bus-voltage limits, line-flow limits, and demand-supply balance constraint in DA-OPF.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients; energy price; wind and solar direct cost coefficients; bus admittance Gij/Bij; ramp limits; voltage and line-flow limits; forecasted load, wind, and solar outputs; participation factors.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: MATLAB Optimization Toolbox FMINCON was used on the IEEE 30-bus system with wind at bus 11 and solar PV at bus 13.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Compared conventional and proposed RT-OPF/DA-OPF on IEEE 30-bus test system using 60-min RT and 24-h DA schedules.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed approach reduced RT total cost and increased DA profit while keeping optimization size unchanged and improving voltage stability.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: captures intra-interval variability with little added computational burden. Limitation: relies on forecast availability and fixed participation factors within each interval.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Voltage stability was assessed using the L-index/VSEI.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Online Optimization in Power Systems With High Penetration of Renewable Generation: Advances and Prospects
data_properties.hasAuthor: Zhaojian Wang; Wei Wei; John Zhen Fu Pang; Feng Liu; Bo Yang; Xinping Guan; Shengwei Mei
data_properties.hasInstitution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Tsinghua University; Institute of High Performance Computing (A*STAR), Singapore
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Review and compare online optimization techniques for power-system operation under high renewable penetration.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Increasing renewable variability and controllable loads make offline optimization less reliable for real-time power-system operation.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: How to classify and apply online optimization methods to dynamic control, single-period OPF/voltage regulation, and multi-period energy management problems.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Which online optimization paradigms are most suitable for different power-system time scales and operational settings?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Not applicable; this is a review paper rather than a solved OPF model.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Review of optimization-guided dynamic control, feedback optimization, Lyapunov optimization, and online convex optimization.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Discusses AC bus-injection and branch-flow models; linearized DC power flow and DistFlow approximations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Covers single-period and multi-period formulations, plus fast dynamic-control time scales.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Seconds to minutes for dynamic control; single-period and multi-period decision settings.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period and multi-period; some Lyapunov examples use finite or infinite horizons.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Addresses renewable variability and uncertainty through online decision-making without relying on forecasts or historical distributions.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Frequency control, voltage regulation, OPF, economic dispatch, energy storage scheduling, demand response, and power markets.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Compares feedback-based, primal-dual, ADMM, Newton-Raphson, Lyapunov, and OCO methods; discusses distributed and asynchronous variants.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Emphasizes fast response, tracking of time-varying conditions, and reduced computational burden.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Includes controllable loads, demand response, electric vehicles, and load-side frequency control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Examples include minimizing generation cost in OPF, regulation cost in frequency control, and long-term average cost in Lyapunov/OCO formulations.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Power-flow equations, voltage limits, generation and reactive-power bounds, power-balance constraints, line congestion, storage SoC and charging/discharging limits, ramping and other coupled constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generation cost coefficients ai, bi; voltage bounds vi; power injection bounds Pi, Qi; line parameters rij, xij, Bij; storage queue/SoC Qt; Lyapunov weight ρ; stepsize η; control gains.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: The paper reviews algorithmic frameworks and representative formulations; it does not present a single new solved OPF instance.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: No dedicated validation of a new OPF model; cites prior experimental and numerical studies in the reviewed literature.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: Online optimization is useful for volatile power systems because it can track changing conditions and avoid reliance on inaccurate forecasts.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: fast, measurement-driven, and suitable for time-varying systems. Limitations: problem-dependent, often lacks a unified theory, and some methods need communication or predictions.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper is a survey and taxonomy of online optimization methods in power systems.
data_properties.hasSourceFileName: Online Optimization in Power Systems With.pdf

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Optimal Power Flow Using Graph Neural Networks
data_properties.hasAuthor: Damian Owerko; Fernando Gama; Alejandro Ribeiro
data_properties.hasInstitution: University of Pennsylvania, Department of Electrical and Systems Engineering
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Approximate AC optimal power flow solutions with a local, scalable graph neural network trained by imitation learning.
data_properties.hasMotivation: ACOPF is non-convex and costly to solve, and existing approximate methods do not scale well to large power networks.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: AC optimal power flow on power networks, using IEEE-30 and IEEE-118 test cases.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a graph neural network learn to imitate optimal ACOPF solutions accurately and efficiently in a decentralized, scalable way?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Estimated optimal generator active power outputs; evaluated against IPOPT ACOPF solutions.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Graph neural network parametrization with local message passing and scalable architecture.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power flow equations with nonlinear active and reactive power balance.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Training uses randomly sampled load scenarios from uniform ranges around reference loads.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Generator dispatch, bus voltages, active/reactive loads, and network topology on IEEE test systems.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Imitation learning with GNNs trained on IPOPT-generated optimal solutions.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported relative RMSE and much faster inference than IPOPT.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Loads are sampled as inputs; model predicts generator dispatch to meet demand.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, with generator cost depending on active power output.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Active and reactive power balance equations p=P(v,δ;W), q=Q(v,δ;W), plus elementwise bounds Xmin ⪯ X ⪯ Xmax on voltages, angles, active and reactive powers.
data_properties.usesParameter: Network adjacency/weights W from line impedances; node states X=[v,δ,p,q]; generator selection matrix G; load vectors pL and qL; generator cost functions cm(pm).
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: IPOPT is used to solve ACOPF and generate training targets; GNNs are trained with MSE using ADAM on IEEE-30 and IEEE-118 datasets.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on held-out test sets from IEEE-30 and IEEE-118; compared against global/local GNN and MLP baselines using relative RMSE.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: GNNs outperform MLP baselines, especially on the larger IEEE-118 case, and provide orders-of-magnitude faster inference than IPOPT.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: local, scalable, permutation-equivariant, and stable to graph perturbations. Limitation: trained to imitate IPOPT solutions rather than solve OPF exactly.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Uses graph convolution layers with K-hop neighborhood aggregation.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：明确包含 N-1 安全约束、事故后运行约束和 AC 潮流，可满足正常与事故工况下的安全运行需求；同时还加入小信号稳定约束，安全覆盖面较强。 / English explanation: It explicitly includes N-1 security constraints, post-contingency operating constraints, and AC power flow, so it can satisfy safe operation under normal and contingency conditions; it also adds small-signal stability constraints, giving strong security coverage.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它是单时刻静态模型，且重点包含小信号稳定而非更广泛的多时段连续事故演化；对更复杂的故障序列覆盖有限。 / English explanation: It is a single-snapshot static model and emphasizes small-signal stability rather than broader multi-period cascading outage evolution; coverage of more complex fault sequences is limited.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：面向实时序列安全约束 OPF，包含事故/安全约束、AC 潮流、线路与电压限制，并支持多步连续调度，适合在正常与事故后状态下维持安全运行。 / English explanation: It targets real-time sequential security-constrained OPF, includes contingency/security constraints, AC power flow, and line/voltage limits, and supports multi-step sequential dispatch, making it suitable for maintaining safe operation under normal and post-contingency states.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Minimize generation cost in AC optimal power flow while satisfying network constraints under uncertain loads and renewable generation with probabilistic guarantees.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Classical OPF dispatch is rigid and can become inefficient or infeasible under renewable and load uncertainty, causing overloads and outages.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Robust and chance-constrained AC optimal power flow with uncertain loads and renewable generators.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can AC-OPF be solved efficiently under uncertainty while limiting the probability of violating generation and transmission constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal controllable generation dispatch, generator voltage magnitudes, deployment vector, and corresponding bus voltage and line-flow-feasible operating point.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Scenario-with-certificates formulation combined with convex SDP relaxation of AC power flow.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with voltage-magnitude and line-flow constraints via lifted matrix W.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period OPF repeated over hourly demand scenarios in experiments.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per solve; 24 hourly solves in simulation.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Probabilistic uncertainty in loads and renewable generation using scenario with certificates and chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes renewable generators, uncertain loads, generator participation factors, voltage limits, and transmission limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Convex relaxation plus randomized scenario-with-certificates sampling.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: A priori probabilistic guarantee on constraint-violation risk; exact for a restricted class of networks.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Uncertain loads are explicitly modeled and balanced through generator deployment factors.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost f(u); in the penalized variant, worst-case cost adds reactive-power and line-loss penalties.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power balance equalities; generator active/reactive limits; voltage magnitude bounds; line-voltage-difference or apparent-flow limits; deployment factors sum to one and remain nonnegative.
data_properties.usesParameter: Uncertain complex load and renewable deviations δ; deployment vector α; bus-voltage matrix W split into Wu and Wx; risk levels ε and β; line admittances ylm; voltage and power limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Uses SDP lifting W=VV* and scenario-with-certificates sampling to solve a convex program; implemented with YALMIP and Mosek.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the New England 39-bus system with Monte Carlo testing over 10,000 samples and comparison against nominal OPF and a prior probabilistic AC-OPF method.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method greatly reduced infeasible samples and line-flow violations versus nominal OPF, while using far fewer scenario samples than the compared parameterized approach.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Can incorporate N-1 security constraints and outage probabilities within the same scenario framework.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve large-scale security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps efficiently under strict time limits.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Large SCOPF instances contain millions of continuous/integer variables and nonlinear nonconvex constraints, making them difficult to solve within challenge time limits.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps, including AC power flow, contingencies, reserves, device switching, and ramping constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a decomposition-based hybrid solver scale multi-timestep SCOPF to very large grids while maintaining high-quality feasible solutions?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation and consumption dispatch, device switching status, bus voltage angles, AC power-flow feasible operating point, and reserve allocations.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Two-stage DC/AC decomposition with sequential optimization for large networks.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: DC module uses linearized/MILP approximations; AC module solves full nonlinear AC power-flow equations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Multiple time steps; sequential stage-wise optimization for large horizons.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Time-step based control horizon; exact interval length not specified.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Control horizon divided into stages for networks over 2000 buses.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Contingency constraints included; no stochastic or robust uncertainty model stated.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained AC OPF with reserves, ramping, device uptime/downtime, and switching constraints.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Problem reformulation, McCormick relaxation, slack variables, clique constraints, analytical derivatives, vectorization, and sequential bound updates.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for scalability and strict time limits on very large instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consumption devices represented with bid blocks and power consumption bounds.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus z over device powers, bus voltage angles, and switching variables.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints G enforce power-balance and AC/DC network equations; inequality constraints H cover voltage limits, real/reactive power limits, reserves, ramping, switching, contingency, and device operation constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Device power pjt, bus voltage angle θit, switching status ujt, shunt conductance gshjt, branch flow limits smaxj, reserve factors σscrn, ramp-up Pru, ramp-down Prd, and mismatch penalty pit.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: DC subproblem solved as MILP with Gurobi; AC subproblem solved as NLP with IPOPT; large cases use sequential stage-wise optimization and selective contingency inclusion.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on 300+ scenarios across 73 to 8316-bus networks from ARPA-E GO challenge datasets.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The approach achieved high scaled scores in most scenarios, with average scores around 0.983 on Scenario Set 3 and 0.9992 on Scenario Set 2, while meeting time limits.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: scalable, robust, high-quality solutions, full AC formulation. Limitation: solution quality varies by scenario and depends on available reserve abundance; large cases require sequential decomposition.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Applied to ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets and testing platform.

selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文说明：它是静态单时段、预防式SCOPF，主要保证基态和预设故障场景可行，不是面向连续时间快速波动的滚动再优化；此外在部分故障下仍可能出现少量无功越限。 / English explanation: It is a static single-period preventive SCOPF that mainly ensures base-case and preset contingency feasibility, not rolling re-optimization for continuous fast fluctuations; it may also still have some reactive-power violations under certain contingencies.
supporting_evidence: hasPrimaryPurpose: Fast solution of preventive security-constrained optimal power flow using a hybrid data-driven DRL method.
hasMotivation: Conventional SCOPF solvers are computationally burdensome for online applications under contingencies and volatile operating conditions.
hasModelPerformanceFeature: Real-time online inference after offline training; high-quality feasible solutions.
hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal base-case dispatch decisions ... with contingency-feasible bus voltages and branch flows.

hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: fast, constraint-aware, scalable to larger systems. Limitations: still slightly higher cost than IPOPT and some reactive-power violations may remain under contingencies.
hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single operating point with multiple contingency scenarios.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文说明：该模型面向实时频率约束OPF，明确强调“real-time”与“run about every 5 minutes”，并且其动机就是为快速实时调度提供可行解；这与用户希望在新能源和负荷快速变化后快速更新并保持可行运行高度一致。 / English explanation: This model targets real-time frequency-constrained OPF, explicitly states it runs about every 5 minutes, and is motivated by fast real-time dispatch with feasible solutions, which aligns well with the need to update quickly and keep operation feasible after rapid renewable/load changes.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文说明：它是单时段快照式调度，没有多时段滚动优化或显式动态跟踪，因此对“前一时刻解很快失效”的连续时序修复能力有限；同时还引入混合整数复杂度，可能影响极端情况下的在线速度。 / English explanation: It is a single-period snapshot dispatch without multi-period rolling optimization or explicit dynamic tracking, so its ability to continuously repair solutions as conditions change is limited; it also adds mixed-integer complexity, which may hurt online speed in extreme cases.
supporting_evidence: hasPrimaryPurpose: Real-time frequency-constrained optimal power flow with DNN-based RoCoF and frequency nadir constraints.
hasTemporalResolution: Real-time OPF, described as run about every 5 minutes.
hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period real-time dispatch; no multi-period horizon.
hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: DNN predictor linearized with mixed-integer constraints and solved with Gurobi.
hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Improves frequency-security accuracy over linear FCOPF, but adds mixed-integer complexity and depends on training-data coverage.
hasFindingsSummary: DNN-FCOPF produced frequency metrics much closer to EMT simulations than linear FCOPF, with modest extra cost and longer solve time.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文说明：该模型明确处理实时OPF，并通过缩短到1分钟子间隔来捕捉可再生出力和负荷在区间内的快速变化；其核心目标之一就是在不显著增加优化规模的情况下提升实时可行性与稳定性。 / English explanation: This model explicitly handles real-time OPF and uses 1-minute sub-intervals to capture rapid intra-interval renewable and load changes; one of its core goals is to improve real-time feasibility and stability without significantly increasing optimization size.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文说明：它依赖预测值和固定参与因子，属于区间内近似处理，不是严格的快速重求解机制；因此当变化超出预测或参与因子设定时，可行性仍可能受影响。 / English explanation: It relies on forecasts and fixed participation factors, using an approximate intra-interval treatment rather than a strict fast re-solving mechanism; feasibility can still be affected when changes exceed the forecast or factor settings.
supporting_evidence: hasPrimaryPurpose: To schedule generation economically while maintaining security in day-ahead and real-time OPF with renewable variability.
hasMotivation: Conventional DA-OPF and RT-OPF use static snapshots and ignore renewable/load variability within scheduling intervals.
hasTimeHorizonFeature: Day-ahead and real-time multi-interval scheduling with 15-min and 1-min sub-intervals.
hasTemporalResolution: RT-OPF: 1 min sub-intervals within 10-min intervals; DA-OPF: 15 min sub-sub-intervals within 1 h intervals.
hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Evaluates 'best-fit' participation factors once to avoid separate optimization for every sub-interval.

hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: captures intra-interval variability with little added computational burden. Limitation: relies on forecast availability and fixed participation factors within each interval.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文说明：该模型强调用物理信息学习生成ACOPF解，并通过迭代可行性校准把预测结果拉回可行域，适合需要快速更新且尽量保持可行的场景。 / English explanation: This model emphasizes physics-informed learning to generate ACOPF solutions and uses iterative feasibility calibration to pull predictions back into the feasible region, which suits scenarios needing fast updates while preserving feasibility as much as possible.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文说明：它的可行性依赖后续校准步骤，且在较大系统上并非总能收敛，因此在极端快速波动或更大规模网络中，在线稳定可行性存在边界。 / English explanation: Its feasibility depends on a post-prediction calibration step, and convergence is not guaranteed on larger systems, so online stable feasibility has a boundary under extreme fast fluctuations or larger networks.
supporting_evidence: hasPrimaryPurpose: Generate ACOPF solutions using physics-informed deep learning and feasibility calibration.
hasMotivation: Need for a more efficient and reliable ACOPF solver because ACOPF is nonconvex, NP-hard, and difficult to solve quickly in modern grids.
hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Physics-informed loss, cycle-consistency reconstruction, and Gauss-Seidel-style calibration with warm starts.
hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal bus voltage magnitudes and phase angles, generator active/reactive power dispatch, and calibrated feasible ACOPF solutions.
hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method achieved lower feasibility error and smaller optimality gaps than baselines, with strong convergence on both benchmark systems.

hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: improved feasibility with near-optimal solutions and no traditional solver in the prediction stage. Limitation: calibration did not converge for all 118-bus test cases.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文说明：该模型的动机就是减少重复OPF求解的计算负担并提升实时适用性，且明确报告训练和测试都很快，适合需要快速更新的OPF应用。 / English explanation: The model is motivated by reducing the computational burden of repeated OPF solves and improving real-time applicability, and it explicitly reports fast training and testing, making it suitable for fast-update OPF use cases.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文说明：它主要是离线学习型近似器，不是在线闭环重优化器；当运行点变化非常剧烈时，预测解仍可能需要额外校正才能保证可行。 / English explanation: It is mainly an offline learning-based approximator rather than an online closed-loop re-optimizer; when operating points change very sharply, predicted solutions may still need extra correction to ensure feasibility.
supporting_evidence: hasMotivation: Reduce the high computational burden of repeated OPF solves and improve real-time applicability.
hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Feature decomposition, reinforcement-mode SELM, and active-constraint sample clustering.
hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generator active/reactive dispatch, bus voltage magnitudes/angles, branch active/reactive flows, and objective function value.
hasModelPerformanceFeature: Fast training and testing with improved accuracy over original SELM and deep-learning alternatives.

hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: fast, few hyperparameters, extensible across systems. Limitation: direct deep learning and original SELM struggle with OPF complexity; future work targets field-data validation.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文说明：该模型强调分布式、快速、可扩展的系统级控制，并且每个控制周期重复求解，适合需要快速更新调度并维持运行约束的场景。 / English explanation: This model emphasizes distributed, fast, scalable system-level control and is repeated at each control period, which suits scenarios requiring rapid dispatch updates while maintaining operating constraints.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文说明：它面向MTDC直流配电网而非常规交流OPF，且采用线性化/顺序凸近似；因此对用户所述快速波动下的通用AC可行性维护只能算相邻适用，而非直接对应。 / English explanation: It is designed for MTDC DC distribution grids rather than conventional AC OPF, and it uses linearized/sequential convex approximation; thus it is only adjacent in applicability, not a direct match for maintaining general AC feasibility under rapid fluctuations.
supporting_evidence: hasPrimaryPurpose: Distributed OPF-based system-level control of MTDC distribution grids with DER coordination.
hasMotivation: Need fast, scalable, modular, privacy-preserving control for MTDC grids with high DER integration and changing operating conditions.
hasTimeHorizonFeature: Repeated at each control period.
hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: ADMM with sequential convex approximation and an added initialization step for time-varying DER parameters.

hasFindingsSummary: The algorithm converges in a few hundred iterations, remains scalable across network sizes, and can dispatch diverse DER under different ANM schemes with acceptable voltage deviations from centralized solutions.

hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: distributed, modular, scalable, privacy-preserving, fast. Limitations: relies on linearized OPF, assumes normal communication operation, and communication time can dominate total execution time.

For the need to update quickly and keep feasible operation after rapid renewable/load changes, it is the closest match to the core requirement of fast updates plus feasibility.

hasTimeHorizonFeature: Covers single-period and multi-period formulations, plus fast dynamic-control time scales. / hasTimeHorizonFeature: Covers single-period and multi-period formulations, plus fast dynamic-control time scales.

hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported zero constraint violation for the proposed method and much faster solution time than MATPOWER MIPS. / hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported zero constraint violation for the proposed method and much faster solution time than MATPOWER MIPS.

hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period steady-state OPF. / hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period steady-state OPF.

hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: fast and feasible OPF approximation without running a physics-based solver. / hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: fast and feasible OPF approximation without running a physics-based solver.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 该模型强调用神经网络编码可行域，并通过 MILP 形式提高求解可行性与可解性，适合对快速变化工况下的安全可行运行有要求的场景。 / This model emphasizes encoding the feasible region with neural networks and improving solvability and feasibility via a MILP formulation, which suits scenarios requiring secure feasible operation under changing conditions.

hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single operating point; no multi-period horizon. / hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single operating point; no multi-period horizon.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 该模型把 OPF 可行性修正嵌入到含 PV 和储能的日内/日前调度中，并明确通过 Newton-Raphson 可行性检查与 PSO 修复违反约束的时段，能在可再生波动下维持可行运行。 / This model embeds OPF feasibility correction into day-ahead scheduling with PV and storage, and explicitly uses Newton-Raphson feasibility checks plus PSO repair for violated hours, helping maintain feasible operation under renewable variability.

hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reduces power-flow violations by more than 99% and lowers penalty from 302,210.9 to 2,128.49. / hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reduces power-flow violations by more than 99% and lowers penalty from 302,210.9 to 2,128.49.

hasFindingsSummary: UC alone gave the lowest cost but infeasible power flow; OPF refinement slightly increased cost while making the schedule technically feasible. / hasFindingsSummary: UC alone gave the lowest cost but infeasible power flow; OPF refinement slightly increased cost while making the schedule technically feasible.
