data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve sequential real-time security-constrained optimal power flow with fast dispatch decisions under inaccurate environmental parameters.
data_properties.hasMotivation: ACOPF is nonconvex, time-coupled by ramping limits, and difficult to solve quickly and safely when system parameters are inaccurate or contingencies are unexperienced.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Sequential security-constrained AC optimal power flow for real-time operation with generator active/reactive dispatch and network security limits.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning method produce safe real-time OPF dispatches efficiently without relying on accurate environmental models?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Safe generator active and reactive power dispatch commands; resulting bus voltage magnitudes and branch active/reactive power flows within limits.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning with a safety-layer projection model and inactive-constraint identification.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow formulation with nonlinear nodal injections, branch flows, voltage magnitudes, and ramping-coupled generator limits.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Sequential multi-step dispatch with future load forecasts and ramping-coupled time dependence.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Real-time operation over time slots; forecasting horizon T steps.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Infinite-horizon sequential decision process terminated by grid failure/non-convergence.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses reinforcement learning for inaccurate environments and updates safety-layer parameters from latest measurements.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained ACOPF with coordinated active and reactive power dispatch, voltage and branch-flow security limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Improved SAC with SAM, prioritized replay, adaptive entropy, hybrid safety layer, and inactive-constraint elimination.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Claims faster decision-making and reduced security violations with comparable economic performance.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Includes forecasted net load demand in the state; no explicit demand response control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize cumulative generation operating cost, with quadratic cost coefficients for each generator over time.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power-balance equations, branch active/reactive flow equations, generator active/reactive limits, branch flow limits, voltage magnitude limits, and ramping-coupled generator bounds; safety-layer projection also enforces linearized security constraints and power balance.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients; generator active/reactive bounds and ramping limits; bus voltages; line conductance/susceptance or resistance/reactance; branch flow limits; load demand and forecasted load; slack-bus limits; penalty coefficients; SAC temperature and learning rates.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Sequential decisions are produced by an improved soft actor-critic policy, then projected by a linear security layer initialized from linearized power-flow knowledge and updated with data; inactive constraints are removed analytically.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 30-bus and larger systems, including contingency and parameter-error scenarios, with comparisons against penalty, constrained-policy, and pure data-driven safety-layer baselines.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The method maintains voltages and branch flows within safe ranges, reduces violation times in early training and contingencies, and scales to larger systems with low decision time.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: safe real-time dispatch, better robustness to inaccurate models, and high computational efficiency. Limitation: safety layer uses linearized power-flow approximation and may need conservative limits to offset approximation error.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper also evaluates scalability on 9-, 30-, 57-, 118-, and 1187-bus systems.

data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Control horizon divided into stages for networks over 2000 buses.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Contingency constraints included; no stochastic or robust uncertainty model stated.

data_properties.hasInstitution: iTrust Center for Research in Cyber Security, Singapore University of Technology and Design; CNR-IEIIT, Torino, Italy; Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Penn State University
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Minimize generation cost in AC optimal power flow while satisfying network constraints under uncertain loads and renewable generation with probabilistic guarantees.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Classical OPF dispatch is rigid and can become inefficient or infeasible under renewable and load uncertainty, causing overloads and outages.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Robust and chance-constrained AC optimal power flow with uncertain loads and renewable generators.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can AC-OPF be solved efficiently under uncertainty while limiting the probability of violating generation and transmission constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal controllable generation dispatch, generator voltage magnitudes, deployment vector, and corresponding bus voltage and line-flow-feasible operating point.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Scenario-with-certificates formulation combined with convex SDP relaxation of AC power flow.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with voltage-magnitude and line-flow constraints via lifted matrix W.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period OPF repeated over hourly demand scenarios in experiments.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per solve; 24 hourly solves in simulation.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Probabilistic uncertainty in loads and renewable generation using scenario with certificates and chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes renewable generators, uncertain loads, generator participation factors, voltage limits, and transmission limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Convex relaxation plus randomized scenario-with-certificates sampling.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: A priori probabilistic guarantee on constraint-violation risk; exact for a restricted class of networks.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Uncertain loads are explicitly modeled and balanced through generator deployment factors.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost f(u); in the penalized variant, worst-case cost adds reactive-power and line-loss penalties.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power balance equalities; generator active/reactive limits; voltage magnitude bounds; line-voltage-difference or apparent-flow limits; deployment factors sum to one and remain nonnegative.
data_properties.usesParameter: Uncertain complex load and renewable deviations δ; deployment vector α; bus-voltage matrix W split into Wu and Wx; risk levels ε and β; line admittances ylm; voltage and power limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Uses SDP lifting W=VV* and scenario-with-certificates sampling to solve a convex program; implemented with YALMIP and Mosek.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the New England 39-bus system with Monte Carlo testing over 10,000 samples and comparison against nominal OPF and a prior probabilistic AC-OPF method.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method greatly reduced infeasible samples and line-flow violations versus nominal OPF, while using far fewer scenario samples than the compared parameterized approach.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Can incorporate N-1 security constraints and outage probabilities within the same scenario framework.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Machine Learning-Aided Security Constrained Optimal Power Flow
data_properties.hasAuthor: Jubeyer Rahman; Cong Feng; Jie Zhang
data_properties.hasInstitution: The University of Texas at Dallas
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve security-constrained AC optimal power flow efficiently using a machine-learning-aided approach.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Full AC OPF is highly nonlinear and non-convex, making large-scale security-constrained solving computationally challenging.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Security-constrained AC optimal power flow with switched shunt security constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a machine-learning-aided method predict key OPF variables and avoid running a physics-based OPF solver while preserving feasibility?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Bus voltage magnitudes and voltage angles; derived current injections, complex/real power injections, generator dispatch settings, and branch power flows.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid machine-learning-aided OPF using multi-input multi-output random forest plus physics-based network equations.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with bus admittance matrix, current injection, apparent power, and nodal power balance.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period steady-state OPF.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Not specified; load samples from hourly ERCOT profile used for training/testing.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per case.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: No explicit uncertainty model; trained on sampled load cases.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained AC transmission OPF with generators, buses, branches, and switched shunts.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Multi-input multi-output random forest predicts voltages, then network equations recover remaining variables.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported zero constraint violation for the proposed method and much faster solution time than MATPOWER MIPS.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Load demand inputs Pd and Qd are used as predictors; no demand response model.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, with generator costs represented by individual piece-wise linear cost functions.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Voltage magnitude and angle bounds; generator active/reactive power bounds; switched shunt susceptance bounds; real and reactive nodal power balance equations; branch apparent power flow limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Bus voltage magnitudes vi and angles θi; generator outputs pg and qg; switched shunt susceptance bcs; real/reactive demands pd and qd; branch flow limit sf; bus admittance matrix Y; generator cost cg.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: RF is trained on converged MATPOWER solutions; case I predicts v and θ then computes injections and costs via network equations; case II predicts all OPF variables directly.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on a 500-bus GO competition network using 8,760 load samples; compared against MATPOWER MIPS and a pure ML baseline.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method closely matches MIPS voltage solutions, satisfies network constraints, and reduces total solution time from 2030.4 s to 35.26 s.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: fast and feasible OPF approximation without running a physics-based solver. Limitation: pure end-to-end ML still causes many equality-constraint violations.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Potentially useful for post-contingency analysis with many network topologies and load profiles.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Optimal Power Flow Using Graph Neural Networks
data_properties.hasAuthor: Damian Owerko; Fernando Gama; Alejandro Ribeiro
data_properties.hasInstitution: University of Pennsylvania, Department of Electrical and Systems Engineering
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Approximate AC optimal power flow solutions with a local, scalable graph neural network trained by imitation learning.
data_properties.hasMotivation: ACOPF is non-convex and costly to solve, and existing approximate methods do not scale well to large power networks.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: AC optimal power flow on power networks, using IEEE-30 and IEEE-118 test cases.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a graph neural network learn to imitate optimal ACOPF solutions accurately and efficiently in a decentralized, scalable way?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Estimated optimal generator active power outputs; evaluated against IPOPT ACOPF solutions.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Graph neural network parametrization with local message passing and scalable architecture.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power flow equations with nonlinear active and reactive power balance.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Training uses randomly sampled load scenarios from uniform ranges around reference loads.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Generator dispatch, bus voltages, active/reactive loads, and network topology on IEEE test systems.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Imitation learning with GNNs trained on IPOPT-generated optimal solutions.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported relative RMSE and much faster inference than IPOPT.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Loads are sampled as inputs; model predicts generator dispatch to meet demand.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, with generator cost depending on active power output.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Active and reactive power balance equations p=P(v,δ;W), q=Q(v,δ;W), plus elementwise bounds Xmin ⪯ X ⪯ Xmax on voltages, angles, active and reactive powers.
data_properties.usesParameter: Network adjacency/weights W from line impedances; node states X=[v,δ,p,q]; generator selection matrix G; load vectors pL and qL; generator cost functions cm(pm).
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: IPOPT is used to solve ACOPF and generate training targets; GNNs are trained with MSE using ADAM on IEEE-30 and IEEE-118 datasets.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on held-out test sets from IEEE-30 and IEEE-118; compared against global/local GNN and MLP baselines using relative RMSE.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: GNNs outperform MLP baselines, especially on the larger IEEE-118 case, and provide orders-of-magnitude faster inference than IPOPT.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: local, scalable, permutation-equivariant, and stable to graph perturbations. Limitation: trained to imitate IPOPT solutions rather than solve OPF exactly.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Uses graph convolution layers with K-hop neighborhood aggregation.

data_properties.hasAuthor: Junfei Wang; Pirathayini Srikantha
data_properties.hasInstitution: York University
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Generate ACOPF solutions using physics-informed deep learning and feasibility calibration.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Need for a more efficient and reliable ACOPF solver because ACOPF is nonconvex, NP-hard, and difficult to solve quickly in modern grids.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: AC optimal power flow on IEEE bus-14 and bus-118 benchmark systems.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a data-driven ACOPF model produce near-optimal solutions while improving feasibility without relying on traditional solvers?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal bus voltage magnitudes and phase angles, generator active/reactive power dispatch, and calibrated feasible ACOPF solutions.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Two-stage physics-informed DNN prediction followed by iterative feasibility calibration.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with complex bus injections and Y-bus network model.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Generator buses, load buses, voltage magnitude/phase angle limits, and line flow limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Physics-informed loss, cycle-consistency reconstruction, and Gauss-Seidel-style calibration with warm starts.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported 0.67% optimality gap on IEEE 14-bus and 0.15% on IEEE 118-bus; calibration converged on all 14-bus tests and 92.2% on 118-bus.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Uses active and reactive power demand at all buses as input.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, with generator cost functions Cg(PGg) typically convex quadratic in active power generation.

data_properties.usesParameter: Active and reactive demand PDi, QDi; generator outputs PGg, QGg; bus voltages |Vi|, ϕi; Y-bus admittance matrix; voltage and flow bounds; calibration stop threshold ρ and maximum epochs E.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: A CNN predicts voltages and angles from demand; power-flow equations reconstruct generator outputs and demand; an iterative calibration loop updates load-bus voltages and generator injections until imbalance is below ρ or E is reached.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Trained and tested on 100K MATPOWER-generated samples for IEEE 14-bus and 118-bus systems, using 80/20 split; compared against supervised learning and DeepOPF-V.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method achieved lower feasibility error and smaller optimality gaps than baselines, with strong convergence on both benchmark systems.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: improved feasibility with near-optimal solutions and no traditional solver in the prediction stage. Limitation: calibration did not converge for all 118-bus test cases.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Future work mentions robust learning under input uncertainties and unsupervised or semi-supervised learning without labeled ACOPF solver data.

data_properties.hasModelName: Neural Networks Encoding Dynamic Security Constrained AC OPF
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Neural Networks for Encoding Dynamic Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow
data_properties.hasAuthor: Ilgiz Murzakhanov; Andreas Venzke; George S. Misyris; Spyros Chatzivasileiadis
data_properties.hasInstitution: Technical University of Denmark
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Encode dynamic security constraints into a tractable optimization model for AC optimal power flow.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Directly including dynamic security constraints makes AC-OPF intractable; the paper seeks a scalable alternative.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: AC optimal power flow with N-1 security and small-signal stability constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can neural networks encode the feasible space of dynamic security-constrained AC-OPF so it can be solved as a MILP?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Cost-optimal generator dispatch satisfying N-1 security and small-signal stability, with corresponding bus voltages and line flows.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Classification neural network encodes feasible operating points; exact mixed-integer reformulation with ReLU activations.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power flow balance for the intact system; contingency-wise AC constraints for N-1 security.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single operating point; no multi-period horizon.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single snapshot dispatch.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: None explicit; random cost-function test instances only.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: N-1 security and small-signal stability constraints on an IEEE 14-bus system.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Neural-network feasibility encoding, exact MILP reformulation, and iterative linearization of power losses.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported 99% test accuracy; feasibility improved to 100% with epsilon adjustment.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost of the intact system state.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Generator active/reactive limits, voltage magnitude limits, line-flow limits, AC power balance, preventive generator set-point equality across contingencies, eigenvalue-based small-signal stability damping ratio constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator active and reactive limits, voltage limits, line-flow limits, contingency set C, damping threshold gamma_min, neural-network weights and biases, ReLU bounds, epsilon conservativeness parameter, loss-linearization threshold rho.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Train a ReLU classification network on feasible/infeasible operating points, reformulate it exactly as MILP, and iteratively linearize AC losses to solve MILPs with Gurobi.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 14-bus system with 45,000 labeled samples; 99% test accuracy; compared against AC-OPF and N-1 security-constrained AC-OPF.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The approach obtained cost-optimal solutions satisfying both static and dynamic security constraints; epsilon increased feasibility to 100% with small cost increase.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: tractable MILP approximation and improved feasibility. Limitations: approximation error may cause optimality loss and separate networks are needed for different grids.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Uses a conservative feasibility margin epsilon to trade off feasibility and optimality.

data_properties.hasModelName: Hybrid UC OPF Renewable Integrated Power Systems
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Hybrid UC–OPF Optimization for Renewable-Integrated Power Systems
data_properties.hasAuthor: Muhammad Nurul Hadi; Ramdhan Halid Siregar; Rakhmad Syafutra Lubis
data_properties.hasInstitution: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Universitas Syiah Kuala, Banda Aceh, Indonesia
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Optimize unit commitment and power flow feasibility for renewable-integrated power systems with PV and pumped hydro storage.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Intermittent PV output creates scheduling and power-flow feasibility challenges that require flexible generation management.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Day-ahead UC-OPF scheduling for a modified IEEE 30-bus system with thermal generators, PV, and pumped hydro storage.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid MINLP–PSO approach produce a cost-effective UC schedule while satisfying power-flow constraints under varying PV outputs?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal hourly generator dispatch, PV and PHS operating schedules, bus voltages, line flows, and total operational cost/penalty values.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid two-stage UC then OPF refinement; MINLP scheduling followed by PSO-assisted Newton-Raphson feasibility correction.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with bus voltage, reactive power, and line capacity constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: 24-hour day-ahead planning horizon with hourly load and PV profiles.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: 24 hours.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Varying PV outputs are tested, but no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model is formulated.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Modified IEEE 30-bus system with thermal generators, PV at bus 6, and PHS at bus 25.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: SCIP-MINLP initial solve, Newton-Raphson feasibility check, then PSO refinement for violated hours.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reduces power-flow violations by more than 99% and lowers penalty from 302,210.9 to 2,128.49.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Hourly load profile is fixed; no demand response or flexible demand model is included.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total operational cost over 24 hours, including thermal fuel cost, start-up and shut-down cost, and PHS operating cost.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Generator active and reactive limits, minimum up/down times, ramp-rate limits, PHS storage/capacity bounds, power balance, bus voltage limits, and transmission line capacity limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Quadratic fuel-cost coefficients a, b, c; generator min/max active and reactive limits; minimum up/down times; ramp rates; PHS capacity, efficiency, initial storage, O&M cost; penalty weights for voltage, power, reactive power, line, ramp, and NR convergence violations.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: SCIP solves UC first; Newton-Raphson checks feasibility; PSO optimizes only hours with violations using a penalty-based fitness function.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Tested on a modified IEEE 30-bus system with 24-hour load and PV data; OPF refinement substantially reduced violations and penalties.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: UC alone gave the lowest cost but infeasible power flow; OPF refinement slightly increased cost while making the schedule technically feasible.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: balances economic dispatch and feasibility with large penalty reduction. Limitation: no explicit stochastic uncertainty model; PSO is applied only after detecting violations.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: PHS operates mainly as a balancing/backup resource with relatively low output.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明 / English explanation. 该模型与“可再生出力和负荷快速变化后，需要快速更新并保持可行运行”的要求高度一致：它面向实时序列化安全约束OPF，强调快速调度决策，并通过安全层投影维持电压与支路潮流在限值内。 / This model is highly consistent with the requirement to update quickly and maintain feasible operation after rapid renewable/load changes: it targets real-time sequential security-constrained OPF, emphasizes fast dispatch decisions, and maintains voltage and branch-flow limits via a safety-layer projection.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明 / English explanation. 主要边界在于采用线性化安全层近似，极端快速波动或强非线性工况下可能需要更保守的约束设置来抵消近似误差。 / The main boundary is its linearized safety-layer approximation, which may require conservative limits under extreme fast fluctuations or strongly nonlinear conditions to offset approximation error.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明 / English explanation. 该模型具备“快速更新 + 保持可行”的相关能力，尤其是在通信中断时仍可通过估计缺失变量继续迭代并收敛到可行分布式OPF结果。 / This model has relevant capabilities for fast updating and feasibility preservation, especially by estimating missing variables during communication loss and continuing iterations toward feasible distributed OPF results.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明 / English explanation. 其核心问题是分布式通信不可靠下的一致性恢复，而不是专门针对可再生与负荷快速波动的在线重优化；速度与可行性提升依赖训练好的估计器，且训练场景主要覆盖较窄负荷范围。 / Its core problem is consensus recovery under unreliable distributed communication rather than dedicated online re-optimization for fast renewable/load fluctuations; speed and feasibility gains depend on a trained estimator, and the training scenarios mainly cover a narrow load range.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明 / English explanation. 该模型能快速给出满足安全约束的可行调度，并支持在线推断，因此与“快速更新并维持可行运行”部分匹配。 / This model can quickly produce security-feasible dispatch and supports online inference, so it matches the fast-update and feasibility-preservation part of the requirement.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明 / English explanation. 它是静态单时段的预防式SCOPF，主要保证基态和预设故障场景可行，不是面向连续快速波动的滚动再优化；在部分故障下仍可能出现少量无功越限。 / It is a static single-period preventive SCOPF that mainly ensures base-case and preset contingency feasibility, not rolling re-optimization for continuous fast fluctuations; some reactive-power violations may still occur under certain contingencies.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明 / English explanation. 该模型直接面向实时OPF，按调度间隔输出控制量，并强调在满足约束的同时显著缩短求解时间，符合快速重算并保持可行的需求。 / This model directly targets real-time OPF, outputs control actions at each dispatch interval, and emphasizes large solve-time reduction while satisfying constraints, fitting the need for rapid recomputation and feasible operation.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明 / English explanation. 主要限制是依赖训练后的策略进行在线推断，且验证集中在单个改造IEEE 118节点系统上，因此在更大分布偏移或未见拓扑下的稳定性需要谨慎。 / The main limitation is reliance on a trained policy for online inference, and validation was on a single modified IEEE 118-bus system, so stability under larger distribution shifts or unseen topologies should be treated cautiously.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明 / English explanation. 该模型与需求方向一致，因为它强调在线优化、快速跟踪时变条件以及在高可再生渗透下减少对离线静态优化的依赖。 / This model is directionally consistent with the requirement because it emphasizes online optimization, fast tracking of time-varying conditions, and reduced reliance on offline static optimization under high renewable penetration.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve OPF with stochastic wind and solar generation using a heuristic optimizer.

data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Thermal, wind, and solar generation on IEEE-30 and IEEE-57 bus systems.

data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported faster convergence and lower total cost than benchmark algorithms in the studied cases.

data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: GWO achieved the best or near-best cost and convergence time in the reported scenarios, while keeping voltages and reactive powers within limits.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: handles non-convex constrained OPF with stochastic renewables and converges well. Limitation: results are case-study based and not guaranteed best for all OPF problems.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Minimize generation cost in AC optimal power flow while satisfying network constraints under uncertain loads and renewable generation with probabilistic guarantees.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Classical OPF dispatch is rigid and can become inefficient or infeasible under renewable and load uncertainty, causing overloads and outages.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Robust and chance-constrained AC optimal power flow with uncertain loads and renewable generators.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can AC-OPF be solved efficiently under uncertainty while limiting the probability of violating generation and transmission constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal controllable generation dispatch, generator voltage magnitudes, deployment vector, and corresponding bus voltage and line-flow-feasible operating point.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Scenario-with-certificates formulation combined with convex SDP relaxation of AC power flow.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with voltage-magnitude and line-flow constraints via lifted matrix W.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period OPF repeated over hourly demand scenarios in experiments.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per solve; 24 hourly solves in simulation.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Probabilistic uncertainty in loads and renewable generation using scenario with certificates and chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes renewable generators, uncertain loads, generator participation factors, voltage limits, and transmission limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Convex relaxation plus randomized scenario-with-certificates sampling.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: A priori probabilistic guarantee on constraint-violation risk; exact for a restricted class of networks.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Uncertain loads are explicitly modeled and balanced through generator deployment factors.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost f(u); in the penalized variant, worst-case cost adds reactive-power and line-loss penalties.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power balance equalities; generator active/reactive limits; voltage magnitude bounds; line-voltage-difference or apparent-flow limits; deployment factors sum to one and remain nonnegative.
data_properties.usesParameter: Uncertain complex load and renewable deviations δ; deployment vector α; bus-voltage matrix W split into Wu and Wx; risk levels ε and β; line admittances ylm; voltage and power limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Uses SDP lifting W=VV* and scenario-with-certificates sampling to solve a convex program; implemented with YALMIP and Mosek.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the New England 39-bus system with Monte Carlo testing over 10,000 samples and comparison against nominal OPF and a prior probabilistic AC-OPF method.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method greatly reduced infeasible samples and line-flow violations versus nominal OPF, while using far fewer scenario samples than the compared parameterized approach.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Can incorporate N-1 security constraints and outage probabilities within the same scenario framework.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: To schedule generation economically while maintaining security in day-ahead and real-time OPF with renewable variability.

data_properties.hasModelFeature: Single optimization with 'best-fit' participation factors over sub-interval variability.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with voltage magnitude/angle, reactive power, and line-flow constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Day-ahead and real-time multi-interval scheduling with 15-min and 1-min sub-intervals.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: RT-OPF: 1 min sub-intervals within 10-min intervals; DA-OPF: 15 min sub-sub-intervals within 1 h intervals.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: RT-OPF over 60 min; DA-OPF over 24 h.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses forecasted solar, wind, and load variability within intervals; no explicit stochastic or robust formulation.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Thermal generators with wind and solar PV injections, AGC participation factors, ramp limits, and voltage stability index.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Evaluates 'best-fit' participation factors once to avoid separate optimization for every sub-interval.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported lower total cost and improved voltage stability versus conventional interval-by-interval OPF.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Forecasted load demand varies within sub-intervals and is included in imbalance calculations.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost over RT sub-intervals; maximize total profit over DA intervals as revenue minus generation cost.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Active and reactive nodal power balance, generator output limits with ramp-up/down limits, renewable output caps, bus-voltage limits, line-flow limits, and demand-supply balance constraint in DA-OPF.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients; energy price; wind and solar direct cost coefficients; bus admittance Gij/Bij; ramp limits; voltage and line-flow limits; forecasted load, wind, and solar outputs; participation factors.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: MATLAB Optimization Toolbox FMINCON was used on the IEEE 30-bus system with wind at bus 11 and solar PV at bus 13.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Compared conventional and proposed RT-OPF/DA-OPF on IEEE 30-bus test system using 60-min RT and 24-h DA schedules.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed approach reduced RT total cost and increased DA profit while keeping optimization size unchanged and improving voltage stability.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: captures intra-interval variability with little added computational burden. Limitation: relies on forecast availability and fixed participation factors within each interval.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Voltage stability was assessed using the L-index/VSEI.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve multi-regional chance-constrained optimal power flow in a distributed, confidentiality-preserving way.

data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Centralized CC-OPF is unsuitable for multi-regional interconnected grids with confidential regional data.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can CC-OPF be solved exactly in a distributed manner while preserving each ISO’s confidential information?

data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Day-ahead, 24 time slots in experiments.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Chance constraints with wind-power uncertainty modeled by Gaussian mixture distributions.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Multi-regional interconnected grid with dispatchable generators, wind farms, loads, voltages, and line flows.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Transformation-based encryption plus accelerated average consensus and privacy-preserving average consensus.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported exact optimality relative to centralized benchmark and high accuracy across system sizes and load levels.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost: sum over regions and time of quadratic and linear dispatchable-generation costs.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Capacity bounds, ramp-rate limits, supply-demand chance constraint, and chance constraints on voltages or line flows converted to deterministic inequalities.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generation cost coefficients, generator capacity bounds, ramp-rate bounds, wind-power quantiles from GMMs, chance limits εb and αS, and DLPF mapping coefficients.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Convert chance constraints to deterministic form, encrypt regional variables and coefficients, compute coupled coefficients and aggregated constants via distributed consensus, solve transformed QP, then decrypt regional optimal dispatch.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on multiple IEEE and PEGASE test systems; proposed method matched centralized solutions with very small relative errors.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The method achieves distributed CC-OPF without revealing confidential data and without optimality loss relative to the benchmark.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: exact optimality, no parameter tuning, confidentiality preservation. Limitation: relies on linearized power flow and is not directly full AC OPF.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Applicable to AGC-aware CC-OPF with deterministic participation factors and extendable to joint-chance-constrained OPF.

data_properties.hasModelName: Scalable Security Constrained Multi Step OPF
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Scalable Solutions for Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow With Multiple Time Steps
data_properties.hasAuthor: Hussein Sharadga; Javad Mohammadi; Constance Crozier; Kyri Baker
data_properties.hasInstitution: Texas A&M International University; University of Texas at Austin; Georgia Institute of Technology; University of Colorado Boulder
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve large-scale security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps efficiently under strict time limits.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Large SCOPF instances contain millions of continuous/integer variables and nonlinear nonconvex constraints, making them difficult to solve within challenge time limits.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps, including AC power flow, contingencies, reserves, device switching, and ramping constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a decomposition-based hybrid solver scale multi-timestep SCOPF to very large grids while maintaining high-quality feasible solutions?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation and consumption dispatch, device switching status, bus voltage angles, AC power-flow feasible operating point, and reserve allocations.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Two-stage DC/AC decomposition with sequential optimization for large networks.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: DC module uses linearized/MILP approximations; AC module solves full nonlinear AC power-flow equations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Multiple time steps; sequential stage-wise optimization for large horizons.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Time-step based control horizon; exact interval length not specified.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Control horizon divided into stages for networks over 2000 buses.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Contingency constraints included; no stochastic or robust uncertainty model stated.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained AC OPF with reserves, ramping, device uptime/downtime, and switching constraints.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Problem reformulation, McCormick relaxation, slack variables, clique constraints, analytical derivatives, vectorization, and sequential bound updates.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for scalability and strict time limits on very large instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consumption devices represented with bid blocks and power consumption bounds.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus z over device powers, bus voltage angles, and switching variables.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints G enforce power-balance and AC/DC network equations; inequality constraints H cover voltage limits, real/reactive power limits, reserves, ramping, switching, contingency, and device operation constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Device power pjt, bus voltage angle θit, switching status ujt, shunt conductance gshjt, branch flow limits smaxj, reserve factors σscrn, ramp-up Pru, ramp-down Prd, and mismatch penalty pit.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: DC subproblem solved as MILP with Gurobi; AC subproblem solved as NLP with IPOPT; large cases use sequential stage-wise optimization and selective contingency inclusion.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on 300+ scenarios across 73 to 8316-bus networks from ARPA-E GO challenge datasets.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The approach achieved high scaled scores in most scenarios, with average scores around 0.983 on Scenario Set 3 and 0.9992 on Scenario Set 2, while meeting time limits.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: scalable, robust, high-quality solutions, full AC formulation. Limitation: solution quality varies by scenario and depends on available reserve abundance; large cases require sequential decomposition.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Applied to ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets and testing platform.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: To advocate and outline grid foundation models for power-system operations, planning, and control.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Increasing grid complexity and uncertainty from the energy transition, climate change, aging infrastructure, and cybersecurity threats.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Lack of scalable, transferable AI methods for diverse power-grid tasks and power-flow-related applications.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can foundation models be developed for electric power grids to generalize across grid data and accelerate downstream applications such as power flow and OPF?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: No OPF model is solved in this paper; it proposes a GridFM-v0 concept for reconstructing power-flow states and, in discussed downstream use, optimal generation dispatch and objective values.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Graph neural network-based foundation model concept; masked autoencoder pre-training on graph-structured grid data.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power flow reconstruction on graph nodes with bus variables and line/transformer edges.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Initially single-time-step power-flow data; extendable to multiple consecutive time steps for forecasting.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Single time step in the near-term model; high-resolution PMU data mentioned for dynamic extensions.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Not specified; near-term focus is static power-flow applications.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses diverse topologies, load conditions, perturbations, and synthetic scenarios; discusses scenario trees and stochastic programming.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Transmission and distribution grid applications including power flow, OPF, contingency analysis, state estimation, stability, control, planning, and cybersecurity.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Self-supervised masked graph autoencoding with physics-informed loss; intended to speed up power-flow-related computation.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Projected 3–4 orders-of-magnitude speed-up over conventional power-flow solvers; less than 1% error cited from related GNN work.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Mentions load conditions, load forecasting, electric vehicles, heating electrification, and demand uncertainty.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: For OPF use, minimize generation costs by reconstructing generator power; the paper does not present a full OPF mathematical formulation.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Reconstructed node variables must satisfy power-flow equations and bounds such as generator capacity constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Bus active power, reactive power, voltage magnitude, voltage angle; line and transformer connectivity; topology, load conditions, and power-flow solutions.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: GridFM-v0 is proposed as a masked graph autoencoder pre-trained on solved power-flow cases from multiple topologies and load conditions, then fine-tuned for downstream tasks.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: No direct model validation results are reported for GridFM-v0; validation is proposed on open datasets and later on utility data behind firewalls.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The paper argues GridFMs could generalize across grid tasks and substantially accelerate power-system analysis, especially power-flow-related applications.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: scalability, adaptability, and simulation acceleration. Limitations: data availability, privacy, trust, and difficulty accessing operational grid data.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper is a perspective proposing a roadmap rather than presenting a completed OPF solver.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 符合用户对减排、提升RES利用率和支持能源转型的核心方向。/ Aligned with the user’s core goals of emission reduction, higher RES utilization, and energy transition support.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要局限是单周期静态调度，且启发式求解带来跨场景稳定性与全局最优性不足。/ Main limitation is single-period static dispatch, and the heuristic solver does not guarantee cross-scenario robustness or global optimality.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 与可再生接入、削减弃风弃光和系统灵活性协调高度一致，适合能源转型场景。/ Strongly aligned with renewable integration, curtailment reduction, and flexibility coordination, making it suitable for energy-transition scenarios.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 碳减排不是显式主目标，更多通过成本、弃电和调度优化间接体现。/ Carbon reduction is not an explicit primary objective; it is represented indirectly through cost, curtailment, and dispatch optimization.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 具备可再生能源与排放-碳税情形，能够支撑减排导向的运行优化。/ Includes renewables and an emission-plus-carbon-tax case, so it can support emission-oriented operational optimization.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 单周期静态且以单目标为主，对RES利用率提升和显式减排约束的直接支撑较弱。/ It is single-period and mainly single-objective, so direct support for RES-utilization maximization and explicit emission constraints is weaker.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 多时段、含储能与可再生能源，能支持更灵活的转型型调度。/ Multi-period with storage and renewables, which supports more flexible transition-oriented scheduling.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 重点在TSO-DSO协调与灵活性清算，而非直接减碳或最大化RES消纳；且未包含无功灵活性。/ Focuses on TSO-DSO coordination and flexibility clearing rather than direct carbon reduction or RES-utilization maximization; reactive power flexibility is not included.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 明确包含可再生资源利用和PV hosting capacity，和提升RES消纳目标一致。/ Explicitly includes renewable resource utilization and PV hosting capacity, aligning with higher RES utilization.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要是配电网基准比较与建模分析，减排目标并非显式核心。/ Primarily a distribution-grid benchmarking and modeling study; emission reduction is not an explicit core objective.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 面向含风光不确定性的AC OPF，可为高RES场景提供可行性与稳定性保障。/ Targets AC OPF with wind and solar uncertainty, providing feasibility and stability support for high-RES scenarios.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 核心是成本最小化与概率可行性保证，没有把碳减排或RES利用率作为显式优化目标。/ Core focus is cost minimization and probabilistic feasibility; carbon reduction and RES utilization are not explicit optimization objectives.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 包含风电和光伏，并通过日内/日前协调改善调度与电压稳定性，能间接支持能源转型。/ Includes wind and solar and improves dispatch and voltage stability through day-ahead/real-time coordination, indirectly supporting energy transition.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 目标偏向经济调度与安全运行，未显式建模碳减排或RES消纳最大化。/ The objective is centered on economic scheduling and secure operation, without explicit carbon minimization or RES-utilization maximization.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 面向风电不确定性的机会约束调度，适合高RES渗透下的可行性管理。/ Chance-constrained dispatch with wind uncertainty, suitable for feasibility management under high RES penetration.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 重点在分布式保密与机会约束求解，且采用线性化潮流，对显式减排和精细RES消纳优化支撑有限。/ Focuses on distributed confidentiality and chance-constrained solving, and uses linearized power flow, so support for explicit emission reduction and fine-grained RES-utilization optimization is limited.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 多时段、安全约束、储能与可再生能源并存，适合大规模转型电网的运行协调。/ Multi-step, security-constrained, with storage and renewables, suitable for operational coordination in large transition-oriented grids.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 目标是市场剩余最大化，不直接针对碳减排或RES利用率最大化建模。/ The objective is market-surplus maximization, not direct carbon reduction or RES-utilization maximization.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 与能源转型和电网复杂性主题相关，但它是概念性基础模型路线图，不是已完成的OPF优化模型。/ Related to energy transition and grid complexity, but it is a conceptual foundation-model roadmap rather than a completed OPF optimization model.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 缺少可直接用于减排、RES消纳提升和OPF运行优化的完整求解能力，因此与用户的实际优化需求不够一致。/ It lacks a complete solver that can be directly used for emission reduction, RES-utilization improvement, and OPF operational optimization, so it is not well matched to the user’s practical optimization need.

raw_consistency.overall_summary: 整体上，多数候选都能在不同程度上支持减排、RES利用率提升或能源转型，但强弱差异明显。/ Overall, most candidates can support emission reduction, RES utilization, or energy transition to varying degrees, but their alignment strength differs significantly. 最一致的是直接把风光不确定性、碳排放项或弃电/灵活性纳入OPF目标的模型；较弱的是以成本、鲁棒性、保密或基准比较为主的模型。/ The strongest matches are models that directly include wind/solar uncertainty, emission terms, or curtailment/flexibility in the OPF objective; weaker matches are models centered on cost, robustness, confidentiality, or benchmarking. GridFM_v0 不通过一致性检查，因为它不是可直接执行的OPF求解模型。/ GridFM_v0 fails the consistency check because it is not a directly executable OPF solver.

data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Thermal unit active/reactive limits and ramping; load shedding bounds; ESS and EV charge/discharge and energy limits; wind/solar availability and curtailment; AC power balance and line flow limits; DR bounds and constant power-factor load shifting; HVAC temperature dynamics and comfort bounds.

data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Formulated in GAMS as a mixed-integer nonlinear program and solved with CONOPT3; scenario results were weighted by probabilities and ranked with TOPSIS.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 24-bus and 118-bus systems using 12 renewable scenarios and DR steps from 0% to 25%.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: At 20% DR, the model achieved the best TOPSIS outcome, reducing total cost and peak demand while keeping voltages within limits.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: integrates AC OPF, DR, EV/HVAC aggregators, storage, and uncertainty. Limitation: aggregator placement was assumed, not optimized.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Uses both active and reactive demand response with user-convenience and comfort-aware flexible-load scheduling.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Loss reduction in a windfarm participating in primary voltage control using an extension of the Convex DistFlow OPF
data_properties.hasAuthor: Benoît Martin; Philippe De Rua; Emmanuel De Jaeger; François Glineur
data_properties.hasInstitution: Université Catholique de Louvain (UCL), MEED/iMMC and CORE/ICTEAM
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Optimal reactive dispatch in a wind farm to reduce collector-grid losses while providing primary voltage control.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Current reactive power setpoint dispatch among wind turbines and switchable capacitor/inductor banks is suboptimal and causes extra energy losses.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: OPF for a radial wind-farm collector grid with transformers, line charging, OLTC, and discrete capacitor/inductor bank switching.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can an extended convex DistFlow OPF accurately and efficiently determine OLTC tap and reactive dispatch under primary voltage control?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal OLTC tap selection, reactive power dispatch of wind turbines and static units, bus voltages, branch power flows, and minimized active power losses.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Extended convex DistFlow with discrete OLTC and static bank switching; formulated as MISOCP and relaxed by linear outer approximation.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Convex DistFlow with π-line model, variable-ratio transformers, SOC relaxation, and convexified voltage-drop equations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single operating point; repeated over many operating conditions.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: 10 min data used for yearly clustering; model itself is static per case.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period OPF per operating condition.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Radial wind-farm collector grid with DFIG turbines, capacitive cables, OLTC transformer, and switchable capacitor/inductor banks.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Linear outer approximation of SOC constraints using Ben-Tal–Nemirovski BTN relaxation.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Compared with Matpower; accuracy assessed by relaxation error and PF feasibility; faster for some cases but slower at higher BTN degree.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize active power exchange at the PCC, representing collector-grid losses, plus a penalty on reactive mismatch with the PCC setpoint.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Active/reactive nodal balances; branch loss and voltage-drop equations; thermal limits; WT capability curve; voltage bounds; angle-difference limits; PCC balance and voltage; reactive mismatch disjunction; single-choice OLTC tap and bank state constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Branch impedances and charging susceptances; transformer tap ratios and series elements; voltage bounds; thermal limits; WT reactive capability limits; PCC voltage and reactive setpoint; big-M constants; OLTC tap count; bank state count; mismatch penalty weight.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Solved as a MISOCP and further as a MILP via BTN outer approximation; validated by running Matpower power flows on the obtained setpoints; compared against Matpower MIPS over 147 discrete configurations and clustered yearly operating points.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Relaxation accuracy tested on six extreme operating cases and feasibility checked with Matpower PF; results compared against exact Matpower-based OPF across many clustered timesteps.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The relaxed model is often accurate when no reactive mismatch is expected, can outperform Matpower on a significant fraction of cases, and may be faster for moderate BTN degree.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: handles OLTC, shunt elements, and discrete banks in a convex framework; can be made arbitrarily accurate by increasing BTN degree. Limitation: accuracy degrades when loss minimization conflicts with reactive-setpoint tracking.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper studies a radial 78 MW wind farm with 39 DFIG turbines, 21 OLTC taps, and 7 static-unit states.

data_properties.hasModelName: Hybrid AC DC Network VSC MTDC Renewables
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Optimal Power Flow for Hybrid AC/DC Electrical Networks Configured With VSC-MTDC Transmission Lines and Renewable Energy Sources
data_properties.hasAuthor: Hüseyin Bakır; Ugur Guvenc; Serhat Duman; Hamdi Tolga Kahraman
data_properties.hasInstitution: Dogus University; Duzce University; Bandirma Onyedi Eylul University; Karadeniz Technical University
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Formulate and solve a single-objective OPF for hybrid AC/DC networks with VSC-MTDC links and renewable sources.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Need for cost-effective, secure AC/DC grid operation with renewable integration and limited prior OPF work on VSC-MTDC systems.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Single-objective OPF on a modified IEEE 30-bus hybrid AC/DC network with thermal generators, renewables, and VSC-MTDC links.
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal fuel cost, fuel cost with valve-point effect, fuel cost with emission-carbon tax, voltage deviation, and active power loss values; corresponding optimal dispatch and voltage profiles.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid AC/DC OPF with VSC-MTDC transmission lines and renewable energy sources.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance, DC power balance, line-flow loss terms, and VSC converter constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period steady-state optimization.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating point.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Reserve and penalty cost modeling for stochastic wind, solar PV/small-hydro, and wind-tidal generation.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Modified IEEE 30-bus AC/DC network with thermal generators, wind, solar PV, small-hydro, tidal, transformers, and VSC-MTDC grids.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: FDB-SFS metaheuristic with diffusion and FDB-based updating.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Compared across 30 runs; FDB-SFS showed best objective values and robust convergence.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: None reported.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize fuel cost; fuel cost with valve-point effect; fuel cost plus emission-carbon tax; voltage deviation; or active power loss, depending on the case.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC active/reactive power balance, DC power balance, generator active/reactive and voltage limits, load-bus voltage limits, line apparent-power limits, transformer tap limits, and VSC/DC voltage-power limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Thermal cost and emission coefficients; valve-point coefficients; renewable direct/reserve/penalty cost coefficients; Weibull, Lognormal, and Gumbel distribution parameters; generator, voltage, line, tap, and VSC bounds.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: FDB-SFS, SFS, AGDE, MPA, and ASO were run for 200 iterations and 30 trials on the modified IEEE 30-bus system using MATACDC power-flow analysis.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Simulation results were checked against constraint limits and compared statistically using Wilcoxon and Friedman tests.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: FDB-SFS achieved the best results in all five cases, including lowest fuel cost, voltage deviation, and active power loss.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: integrates VSC-MTDC and multiple renewables in one OPF. Limitation: single-objective, static formulation; future work suggests multiobjective and dynamic OPF.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Future work proposed multiobjective optimization and dynamic OPF with load uncertainties.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 该模型与需求高度一致：它直接处理实时安全约束最优潮流，覆盖线路潮流、电压、爬坡与安全约束，能够识别局部拥塞、安全问题和容量瓶颈。 / This model is highly consistent with the requirement: it directly handles real-time security-constrained OPF, covering line flows, voltages, ramping, and security constraints, which can identify local congestion, security issues, and capacity bottlenecks.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要缺口是未专门针对数据中心这类高度集中负荷做显式场景化建模，因此对“数据中心负荷增长”本身的专门诊断需要依赖输入场景设计。 / Main gap: it does not explicitly model data-center-style concentrated load growth, so specialized diagnosis of that specific load pattern depends on scenario design.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 该模型与需求匹配度很高：它明确包含N-1事故约束、线路容量约束和电压约束，适合发现局部拥塞、安全问题与容量瓶颈。 / This model matches the requirement very well: it explicitly includes N-1 contingency constraints, line-capacity limits, and voltage constraints, making it suitable for detecting local congestion, security issues, and capacity bottlenecks.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要缺口是它偏静态预防式SCOPF，没有专门面向数据中心式集中负荷增长或配电侧局部热点的专门建模。 / Main gap: it is a static preventive SCOPF and does not specifically model data-center-like concentrated load growth or distribution-side local hotspots.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 该模型总体符合需求：它面向安全约束AC OPF，输出母线电压、相角和支路潮流，并包含线路限额与安全约束，可用于识别拥塞与容量瓶颈。 / This model is generally consistent with the requirement: it targets security-constrained AC OPF, outputs bus voltages, angles, and branch flows, and includes line limits and security constraints, so it can be used to identify congestion and capacity bottlenecks.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要缺口是它是单时段静态模型，且更偏输电网基准问题；对数据中心这类局部高密度负荷在配电侧引发的细粒度拥塞定位支持较弱。 / Main gap: it is a single-period static model and is more of a transmission-network benchmark; support for fine-grained congestion localization from data-center-like dense loads on distribution grids is weaker.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 该模型与需求基本一致：它显式处理动态安全约束、N-1安全、线路限额、电压边界和小信号稳定约束，能够覆盖安全问题与容量瓶颈识别。 / This model is broadly consistent with the requirement: it explicitly handles dynamic security constraints, N-1 security, line limits, voltage bounds, and small-signal stability constraints, covering security issues and capacity bottleneck identification.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要缺口是它更强调预防性安全与稳定，而不是专门针对局部负荷激增或配电网拥塞定位；对数据中心负荷热点的贴合度有限。 / Main gap: it emphasizes preventive security and stability rather than localized load surges or distribution-grid congestion localization; its fit for data-center load hotspots is limited.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 该模型与需求较一致：它面向多时段安全约束OPF，包含潮流、事故、备用、爬坡和切换约束，适合分析高负荷增长下的拥塞、安全与容量约束演化。 / This model is fairly consistent with the requirement: it targets multi-period security-constrained OPF and includes power flow, contingencies, reserves, ramping, and switching constraints, which is suitable for analyzing congestion, security, and capacity bottlenecks under growing load.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要缺口是它更偏系统级多时段调度，不专门针对数据中心式局部负荷聚集或单节点瓶颈诊断。 / Main gap: it is more of a system-level multi-period dispatch model and does not specifically target data-center-style local load clustering or single-node bottleneck diagnosis.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 该模型与需求部分一致：它处理N-k安全约束运行，考虑机组和线路故障下的安全可靠性，能够支持事故后可行性与容量压力分析。 / This model is partially consistent with the requirement: it handles N-k security-constrained operation and considers security/reliability under generator and line outages, supporting post-contingency feasibility and capacity-stress analysis.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要缺口是它重点在多重事故下的鲁棒安全调度，而不是针对高密度负荷接入导致的局部拥塞诊断；对数据中心负荷热点分析不够直接。 / Main gap: it focuses on robust secure dispatch under multiple contingencies rather than diagnosing local congestion caused by dense load interconnection; it is not directly aimed at data-center load hotspot analysis.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 该模型与需求较一致，尤其适合配电侧局部瓶颈：它覆盖配电网OPF、母线电压、支路潮流、电流和容量约束，可用于识别局部拥塞与容量瓶颈。 / This model is fairly consistent with the requirement, especially for distribution-side bottlenecks: it covers distribution-grid OPF, bus voltages, branch flows, currents, and capacity limits, which can be used to identify local congestion and capacity bottlenecks.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要缺口是它是单时段、确定性基准研究，没有事故安全约束，因此对“security issues”和故障后安全裕度的覆盖弱于SCOPF类模型。 / Main gap: it is a single-period deterministic benchmarking study without contingency security constraints, so its coverage of security issues and post-fault security margins is weaker than SCOPF-type models.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 该模型与需求有一定一致性：它面向TSO-DSO协调和局部灵活性清算，能输出线路潮流、母线电压、负荷削减和柔性负荷动作，并明确用于缓解拥塞与改善电压。 / This model has some consistency with the requirement: it targets TSO-DSO coordination and local flexibility clearing, outputs line flows, bus voltages, load shedding, and flexible-load actions, and is explicitly used to relieve congestion and improve voltages.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要缺口是它更偏多时段市场清算与协调，而不是专门做数据中心式局部瓶颈诊断；此外未包含无功灵活性，可能削弱对电压/无功瓶颈的刻画。 / Main gap: it is oriented toward multi-period market clearing and coordination rather than dedicated data-center-style bottleneck diagnosis; additionally, it lacks reactive power flexibility, which may weaken voltage/reactive bottleneck representation.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 该模型与需求基本一致：它在不确定负荷和可再生出力下进行AC OPF，并提供概率保证、线路潮流和电压约束，适合识别容量瓶颈、过载风险和安全边界。 / This model is broadly consistent with the requirement: it performs AC OPF under uncertain loads and renewable generation with probabilistic guarantees, plus line-flow and voltage constraints, making it suitable for identifying capacity bottlenecks, overload risk, and security margins.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要缺口是它更偏概率鲁棒可行性与风险控制，而不是直接输出局部拥塞诊断；对数据中心式集中负荷的局部瓶颈识别仍需结合具体网络场景。 / Main gap: it focuses on probabilistic feasibility and risk control rather than directly producing local congestion diagnostics; identifying bottlenecks for data-center-like concentrated loads still depends on the specific network scenario.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 该模型与需求有一定一致性：它是配电网OPF，包含DistFlow/支路潮流、线路容量和电压边界，能够用于识别配电侧局部拥塞与容量瓶颈。 / This model has some consistency with the requirement: it is a distribution-grid OPF with DistFlow/branch-flow physics, line capacity, and voltage bounds, which can be used to identify distribution-side local congestion and capacity bottlenecks.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要缺口是其核心关注点是离散有载调压控制与损耗/可行性改进，而不是数据中心负荷增长的局部安全评估；对显式安全约束和多时段瓶颈演化覆盖有限。 / Main gap: its core focus is discrete LTC control and loss/feasibility improvement rather than local security assessment for data-center load growth; coverage of explicit security constraints and multi-period bottleneck evolution is limited.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 该模型与需求部分一致：它是实时OPF，显式包含发电成本最小化、功率平衡、电压边界和线路潮流限制，可用于快速判断拥塞或安全越限。 / This model is partially consistent with the requirement: it is a real-time OPF with explicit cost minimization, power balance, voltage bounds, and branch-flow limits, useful for quickly detecting congestion or security violations.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 主要缺口是它输出的是实时调度动作，不是专门的拥塞定位或瓶颈归因工具；对局部高密度负荷引发的细粒度瓶颈分析能力有限。 / Main gap: it outputs real-time dispatch actions rather than dedicated congestion localization or bottleneck attribution; its fine-grained analysis of concentrated-load bottlenecks is limited.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 该模型与需求有一定一致性：它处理机会约束OPF，并对电压或线路潮流施加概率约束，适合在负荷波动和不确定性下识别线路拥塞、容量边界和安全风险。 / This model has some consistency with the requirement: it handles chance-constrained OPF and imposes probabilistic constraints on voltages or line flows, making it suitable for identifying line congestion, capacity boundaries, and security risks under load variability and uncertainty.

top_rows.Strengths: 问题定义清晰，和“安全问题/容量瓶颈”高度对齐；对输电网在线分析很合适。 / Clear problem definition closely aligned with security and capacity bottlenecks; very suitable for transmission-grid online analysis.

top_rows.Objective text: Minimize total generation cost, defined as the sum of quadratic generator cost functions over the base case
top_rows.Constraint text: Equality constraints enforce AC power balance for base case and contingencies; inequality constraints enforce generator capacity, bus-voltage bounds, and transmission-line flow limits
top_rows.Parameter text: Bus voltage magnitudes and angles; generator active and reactive powers; base-case control variables vg and pg; contingency index k; contingency line outages; load states p and q; Lagrange multipliers; slack variables; learning rate
