consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型直接把备用约束纳入 AC-OPF，并联合优化发电与备用分配，能够满足在低风低光、设备故障或高负荷时期需要足够发电/备用/容量机制来保障供电安全的核心要求。 / English explanation: This model directly embeds reserve constraints into AC-OPF and co-optimizes generation with reserve allocation, which fits the core requirement of having sufficient generation/reserves/capacity mechanisms during low-wind, low-solar, outage, or high-load periods to ensure supply security.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是单时段建模，未显式刻画跨时段储能充放电或长期资源补足过程，因此对持续性供给安全的表达不如多时段模型完整。 / English explanation: Main gap: it is a single-period formulation, so it does not explicitly model inter-temporal storage charging/discharging or longer-horizon resource replenishment, making sustained adequacy less fully represented than in multi-period models.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型明确包含 N-1 事故约束、发电机容量、母线电压和线路潮流限制，适合在设备故障或高负荷压力下维持安全可行运行，符合“确保供电安全”的要求。 / English explanation: This model explicitly includes N-1 contingency constraints, generator capacity, bus-voltage limits, and line-flow limits, making it suitable for maintaining secure feasible operation under equipment failures or high-load stress, which matches the requirement to ensure supply security.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它是静态单时刻预防式 SCOPF，主要覆盖事故后的安全可行性，不直接建模低风低光下的长期资源充裕性、储能时序补偿或多时段备用演化。 / English explanation: It is a static single-point preventive SCOPF; it mainly covers post-contingency security feasibility and does not directly model long-term adequacy under low-wind/low-solar conditions, storage time-coupling, or evolving reserves.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型直接面向多时段安全约束 OPF，并包含备用、爬坡、储能、机组启停与故障约束，能够通过跨时段调度支撑低风低光和高负荷时期的供电安全。 / English explanation: This model directly addresses multi-step security-constrained OPF and includes reserves, ramping, storage, unit commitment, and contingency constraints, enabling cross-temporal scheduling to support supply security during low-wind/low-solar and high-load periods.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要限制是分解式两阶段求解，解决质量会随场景和备用充裕度变化；在超大规模系统中可能牺牲部分全局最优性。 / English explanation: Main limitation: it uses a decomposition-based two-stage solver, so solution quality varies by scenario and reserve abundance; in very large systems it may sacrifice some global optimality.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型包含安全层、备用约束、故障/后故障约束与爬坡约束，并面向实时序列调度，能够在扰动或参数不准确时维持供电安全，和需求高度相关。 / English explanation: This model includes a safety layer, reserve constraints, contingency/post-contingency constraints, and ramping constraints, and it is designed for sequential real-time dispatch, so it is highly relevant for maintaining supply security under disturbances or parameter inaccuracies.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要限制是安全层依赖线性化潮流近似，复杂网络或强非线性工况下可能需要更保守的限制；同时不直接建模储能。 / English explanation: Main limitation: the safety layer relies on linearized power-flow approximation, so complex networks or strongly nonlinear operating points may require conservative limits; it also does not directly model storage.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型显式包含旋转备用、储能充放电、风光不确定性与电压稳定约束，能够通过备用和储能在低风低光或高峰负荷时保障供电安全，满足需求中的关键机制。 / English explanation: This model explicitly includes spinning reserve, storage charge/discharge, wind/PV uncertainty, and voltage-stability constraints, so it can ensure supply security through reserves and storage during low-wind/low-solar periods or peak load, matching the key mechanisms in the requirement.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它面向孤岛微电网且为 24 小时多时段调度，适用边界更偏向微电网场景；同时不直接针对大电网输电级安全约束。 / English explanation: It is designed for isolated microgrids with 24-hour multi-period scheduling, so its applicability is more microgrid-oriented; it is also not directly aimed at transmission-level security constraints in large grids.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型联合机组组合与潮流可行性，并显式包含储能作为平衡/备用资源，能够在低风低光或高负荷时通过热机、PV 和抽水蓄能支撑供电安全，方向上符合需求。 / English explanation: This model jointly optimizes unit commitment and power-flow feasibility, and explicitly includes storage as a balancing/backup resource, so it can support supply security during low-wind/low-solar or high-load periods via thermal units, PV, and pumped hydro storage.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它是 24 小时日前规划，且不含显式随机/鲁棒不确定性建模；对突发故障或长期资源紧张的安全裕度刻画较弱。 / English explanation: It is a 24-hour day-ahead planner and does not include explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty modeling; its security margin under sudden outages or prolonged resource scarcity is weaker.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型同时考虑日前与实时 OPF，包含风电、光伏、负荷波动、爬坡约束和备用约束，能够通过调度与备用机制提升低风低光或高负荷时的供电可靠性。 / English explanation: This model jointly considers day-ahead and real-time OPF, including wind/PV/load variability, ramp limits, and reserve constraints, so it can improve supply reliability through dispatch and reserve mechanisms during low-wind/low-solar or high-load periods.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它主要依赖预测值和固定参与因子处理波动，没有显式随机或鲁棒优化，因此对极端缺风缺光或突发故障的安全裕度刻画有限。 / English explanation: It mainly relies on forecasts and fixed participation factors to handle variability, without explicit stochastic or robust optimization, so its security margin under extreme renewable shortfall or sudden outages is limited.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型把需求响应、储能、风光不确定性和负荷削减纳入 AC-OPF，能够通过灵活负荷与储能缓解供需紧张并提升可靠性，和需求有较强相关性。 / English explanation: This model integrates demand response, storage, renewable uncertainty, and load shedding into AC-OPF, so it can relieve supply stress and improve reliability through flexible loads and storage, which is strongly relevant to the requirement.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它更偏向需求侧调节与成本/峰值削减，而不是专门的备用充足性或故障后安全约束；且为 24 小时日前调度，适合日内而非更长周期的容量保障。 / English explanation: It is more focused on demand-side adjustment and cost/peak reduction than on explicit reserve adequacy or post-contingency security; it is also a 24-hour day-ahead schedule, so it fits intraday planning rather than longer-horizon capacity assurance.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型面向不确定负荷与可再生出力下的概率鲁棒 AC-OPF，能以概率保证减少越限和失供风险，适合低风低光与负荷波动场景下的安全运行。 / English explanation: This model targets probabilistically robust AC-OPF under uncertain loads and renewable generation, providing probabilistic guarantees that help reduce violations and supply-risk under low-wind/low-solar and load-variation scenarios.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它主要解决单时段鲁棒调度，不直接提供跨时段储能或备用调度；并且其精确性只对受限网络类别成立。 / English explanation: It mainly addresses single-period robust dispatch and does not directly provide inter-temporal storage or reserve scheduling; its exactness is only proven for a restricted network class.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型显式把风电、光伏不确定性以及备用/惩罚成本纳入 OPF，能够通过常规机组与备用安排支撑低风低光时期的供需平衡，满足需求中的一部分。 / English explanation: This model explicitly incorporates wind/PV uncertainty and reserve/penalty costs into OPF, so it can support supply-demand balance during low-wind/low-solar periods through conventional generation and reserve scheduling, satisfying part of the requirement.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它是单时段静态 OPF，虽然有备用建模，但没有多期储能或显式容量充裕性约束来直接刻画长时段供给安全。 / English explanation: It is a single-period static OPF; although it models reserves, it lacks multi-period storage or explicit adequacy constraints to directly represent long-duration supply security.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型是机会约束 OPF，显式处理风电不确定性，并对供需约束、母线电压和线路潮流施加概率约束，能够在可再生波动下提供供电安全边界。 / English explanation: This model is a chance-constrained OPF that explicitly handles wind uncertainty and imposes probabilistic constraints on supply-demand balance, bus voltages, and line flows, providing a security boundary under renewable variability.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它采用线性化潮流而非完整 AC OPF，且重点是多区域分布式与保密计算，不直接建模储能、备用或故障后的显式恢复机制。 / English explanation: It uses linearized power flow rather than full AC OPF, and its focus is multi-regional distributed confidential computation; it does not directly model storage, reserves, or explicit post-fault recovery mechanisms.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型是多时段 OPF，并显式包含储能、可调负荷、负荷削减与柔性采购，能够通过跨时段调节和储能支撑供电安全，和需求有一定匹配。 / English explanation: This model is a multi-period OPF and explicitly includes storage, flexible loads, load shedding, and flexibility procurement, so it can support supply security through cross-period balancing and storage, which is reasonably aligned with the requirement.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它的重点是 TSO-DSO 灵活性市场清算与协调，而不是专门针对低风低光、干旱或设备故障下的充裕性评估；且明确未包含无功灵活性。 / English explanation: Its focus is flexibility market clearing and TSO-DSO coordination rather than adequacy assessment under low-wind/low-solar, drought, or equipment-failure conditions; it also explicitly does not include reactive power flexibility.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型直接包含多时段储能与光伏规划，并通过时间耦合的储能充放电提升低风低光或高负荷时段的供电保障，和需求中的“容量机制/储能机制”相关。 / English explanation: This model directly includes multi-period storage and PV planning, and its time-coupled storage charging/discharging can improve supply assurance during low-wind/low-solar or high-load periods, which is related to the requested capacity/storage mechanisms.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它更偏向规划层面的储能/光伏选址定容，而不是实时备用或故障安全约束；场景重点是低压社区网络，外推到输电级安全约束时适用性会变弱。 / English explanation: It is more of a planning model for storage/PV sizing and placement than a real-time reserve or contingency-security model; its focus is a low-voltage community network, so applicability weakens when extrapolated to transmission-level security constraints.

consistency_removed.consistency_check: 中文说明：该条目是在线优化综述而不是可直接求解的单一 OPF 模型，虽然覆盖储能、需求响应、备用和多时间尺度运行，但不满足“候选模型应能直接用于该类供需安全调度”的要求。 / English explanation: This entry is a survey of online optimization methods rather than a single solvable OPF model; although it covers storage, demand response, reserves, and multi-timescale operation, it does not meet the requirement that the candidate should directly serve this kind of supply-security dispatch task.
consistency_removed.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是缺少一个可直接执行的具体优化模型与明确的单次调度输出，因此更适合作为方法参考而非直接候选。 / English explanation: Main gap: it lacks a directly executable concrete optimization model and explicit dispatch outputs, so it is better as a methodological reference than a direct candidate.

consistency_result.overall_summary: 中文说明：总体上，多数候选都与“在低风低光、故障或高负荷时通过发电、备用、储能或容量机制保障供电安全”这一要求相符，尤其是带备用、N-1 安全、多时段储能或机组组合的模型；但综述类条目和偏配电网控制/选址规划的条目与“可直接用于供需安全调度”的匹配度较低。 / English explanation: Overall, most candidates align with the requirement of ensuring supply security during low-wind/low-solar, outage, or high-load periods through generation, reserves, storage, or capacity mechanisms, especially models with reserves, N-1 security, multi-period storage, or unit commitment; however, survey-style entries and those focused on distribution-grid control or planning have lower fit for directly usable supply-security dispatch.

top_rows.Recommendation reason: 该模型最贴合“低风低光、故障或高负荷时需要跨时段保障供电安全”的核心需求，因为它同时覆盖多时段、安全约束、备用、爬坡、储能与机组启停。 / This model best matches the core need to secure supply across time during low-wind/low-solar, outages, or high-load periods because it jointly covers multi-step operation, security constraints, reserves, ramping, storage, and unit commitment.
top_rows.Matched needs: 多时段调度 / multi-period scheduling；备用与爬坡约束 / reserve and ramping constraints；储能与启停 / storage and unit commitment；故障与后故障安全 / contingency and post-contingency security；适合供电安全保障 / suitable for supply-security assurance.
top_rows.Strengths: 覆盖面最完整，既能处理跨时段资源调配，也能处理安全约束与备用分配。 / Broadest coverage: it handles inter-temporal resource allocation as well as security constraints and reserve allocation. 适合大规模系统，强调可扩展性与高质量可行解。 / Suitable for large-scale systems, emphasizing scalability and high-quality feasible solutions.
top_rows.Limitations: 采用分解式两阶段求解，超大规模或备用偏紧场景下可能牺牲部分全局最优性。 / Uses a decomposition-based two-stage solver, so very large or reserve-tight cases may sacrifice some global optimality.
top_rows.Objective text: Maximize total market surplus z over device powers, bus voltage angles, and switching variables.
top_rows.Constraint text: Equality constraints G enforce power-balance and AC/DC network equations; inequality constraints H cover voltage limits, real/reactive power limits, reserves, ramping, switching, contingency, and device operation constraints.
top_rows.Parameter text: Device power pjt, bus voltage angle θit, switching status ujt, shunt conductance gshjt, branch flow limits smaxj, reserve factors σscrn, ramp-up Pru, ramp-down Prd, and mismatch penalty pit.
top_rows.Mathematical problem types: MixedIntegerLinearProgrammingProblem | Mixed-Integer Linear Programming Problem; NonlinearProgrammingProblem | Nonlinear Programming Problem

data_properties.hasModelName: Real Time Sequential Security Constrained OPF
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Real-Time Sequential Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow: A Hybrid Knowledge-Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning Approach
data_properties.hasAuthor: Zhongkai Yi; Xue Wang; Cheng Yang; Chao Yang; Mengyang Niu; Wotao Yin
data_properties.hasInstitution: Alibaba DAMO Academy; Alibaba US; Tsinghua University; Harbin Institute of Technology
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve sequential real-time security-constrained optimal power flow with fast dispatch decisions under inaccurate environmental parameters.
data_properties.hasMotivation: ACOPF is nonconvex, time-coupled by ramping limits, and difficult to solve quickly and safely when system parameters are inaccurate or contingencies are unexperienced.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Sequential security-constrained AC optimal power flow for real-time operation with generator active/reactive dispatch and network security limits.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning method produce safe real-time OPF dispatches efficiently without relying on accurate environmental models?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Safe generator active and reactive power dispatch commands; resulting bus voltage magnitudes and branch active/reactive power flows within limits.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning with a safety-layer projection model and inactive-constraint identification.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow formulation with nonlinear nodal injections, branch flows, voltage magnitudes, and ramping-coupled generator limits.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Sequential multi-step dispatch with future load forecasts and ramping-coupled time dependence.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Real-time operation over time slots; forecasting horizon T steps.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Infinite-horizon sequential decision process terminated by grid failure/non-convergence.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses reinforcement learning for inaccurate environments and updates safety-layer parameters from latest measurements.

data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the New England 39-bus system with Monte Carlo testing over 10,000 samples and comparison against nominal OPF and a prior probabilistic AC-OPF method.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method greatly reduced infeasible samples and line-flow violations versus nominal OPF, while using far fewer scenario samples than the compared parameterized approach.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Can incorporate N-1 security constraints and outage probabilities within the same scenario framework.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve security-constrained AC optimal power flow efficiently using a machine-learning-aided approach.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Full AC OPF is highly nonlinear and non-convex, making large-scale security-constrained solving computationally challenging.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Security-constrained AC optimal power flow with switched shunt security constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a machine-learning-aided method predict key OPF variables and avoid running a physics-based OPF solver while preserving feasibility?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Bus voltage magnitudes and voltage angles; derived current injections, complex/real power injections, generator dispatch settings, and branch power flows.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid machine-learning-aided OPF using multi-input multi-output random forest plus physics-based network equations.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with bus admittance matrix, current injection, apparent power, and nodal power balance.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period steady-state OPF.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Not specified; load samples from hourly ERCOT profile used for training/testing.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per case.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: No explicit uncertainty model; trained on sampled load cases.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained AC transmission OPF with generators, buses, branches, and switched shunts.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Multi-input multi-output random forest predicts voltages, then network equations recover remaining variables.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported zero constraint violation for the proposed method and much faster solution time than MATPOWER MIPS.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Load demand inputs Pd and Qd are used as predictors; no demand response model.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, with generator costs represented by individual piece-wise linear cost functions.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Voltage magnitude and angle bounds; generator active/reactive power bounds; switched shunt susceptance bounds; real and reactive nodal power balance equations; branch apparent power flow limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Bus voltage magnitudes vi and angles θi; generator outputs pg and qg; switched shunt susceptance bcs; real/reactive demands pd and qd; branch flow limit sf; bus admittance matrix Y; generator cost cg.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: RF is trained on converged MATPOWER solutions; case I predicts v and θ then computes injections and costs via network equations; case II predicts all OPF variables directly.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on a 500-bus GO competition network using 8,760 load samples; compared against MATPOWER MIPS and a pure ML baseline.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method closely matches MIPS voltage solutions, satisfies network constraints, and reduces total solution time from 2030.4 s to 35.26 s.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: fast and feasible OPF approximation without running a physics-based solver. Limitation: pure end-to-end ML still causes many equality-constraint violations.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Potentially useful for post-contingency analysis with many network topologies and load profiles.

data_properties.usesParameter: Penalty parameter ρ; voltage and power tolerances εV and εP; RES availability p̄RES; ESS SoC EESS,Ti and thresholds; charging/discharging efficiencies nch, ndisch; nodal price prk; load-curtailment factors aCL, bCL, cCL; priority factors priorRES and priorESS.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Each DCU solves its local nodal subproblem, exchanges voltage copies with neighbors, updates consensus voltages and dual variables, and stops when voltage convergence and total power balance are satisfied.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on modified IEEE 14, 30, 57, and 118-node systems, including sequential and physically distributed HPC-cluster implementations.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The algorithm converges in a few hundred iterations, remains scalable across network sizes, and can dispatch diverse DER under different ANM schemes with acceptable voltage deviations from centralized solutions.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: distributed, modular, scalable, privacy-preserving, fast. Limitations: relies on linearized OPF, assumes normal communication operation, and communication time can dominate total execution time.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Suitable for system-level control of DER-dominated MTDC grids and adaptable to equivalent AC-grid OPF-for-ANM formulations.

data_properties.hasModelName: Real Time Lagrangian Deep Reinforcement Learning
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Real-Time Optimal Power Flow: A Lagrangian Based Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach
data_properties.hasAuthor: Ziming Yan; Yan Xu
data_properties.hasInstitution: School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Real-time optimal power flow decision-making under operating constraints using deep reinforcement learning.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Need faster OPF to respond to rapid uncertainties from renewable generation and stochastic loads.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Real-time OPF with generator cost minimization subject to power balance, limits, ramping, voltage, and line-flow constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a Lagrangian-based deep reinforcement learning agent produce near-optimal RT-OPF decisions in real time while satisfying constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generator active power dispatch and generator voltage magnitude setpoints; resulting operating cost and constraint-compliant operating points.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Deep reinforcement learning with Lagrangian relaxation and continuous-action control.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with reactive power, voltage magnitudes, and line-flow limits.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single dispatch interval repeated over real-time intervals.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Per-interval real-time optimization.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses real-time load and renewable variability as state inputs; no explicit stochastic optimization.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Generator limits, ramping limits, bus voltage limits, and branch apparent-power limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Deep deterministic policy gradient with analytically derived deterministic gradient and Lagrangian penalties.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported high solution optimality, constraint compliance, and large time savings versus IP method.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Real-time net load input includes active and reactive demand; no explicit demand response control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost over each dispatch interval, using generator fuel cost functions.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Nodal active and reactive power balance; generator active-power bounds with ramping limits; bus voltage magnitude bounds; branch apparent-power flow limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Active and reactive load, previous generator output, generator cost coefficients, ramp-up/down limits, voltage limits, branch flow limits, admittance matrix entries, learning rate, memory buffer size.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Offline training of a DNN actor with replay memory and exploration noise; online inference outputs [P_G^t, V_G^t] for RT-OPF.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Tested on a modified IEEE 118-bus system with random net-load variation; compared against IP, DC OPF, and supervised learning.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method achieved near-IP optimal cost, satisfied operating constraints, and ran in real time with about 99.8% average time saving over IP.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: real-time operation, constraint-aware learning, good optimality. Limitation: evaluated on one test system and relies on trained data-driven policy.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Continuous-action DRL formulation for RT-OPF; critic network not used.

data_properties.hasModelName: Neural Networks Encoding Dynamic Security Constrained AC OPF
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Neural Networks for Encoding Dynamic Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow
data_properties.hasAuthor: Ilgiz Murzakhanov; Andreas Venzke; George S. Misyris; Spyros Chatzivasileiadis
data_properties.hasInstitution: Technical University of Denmark
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Encode dynamic security constraints into a tractable optimization model for AC optimal power flow.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Directly including dynamic security constraints makes AC-OPF intractable; the paper seeks a scalable alternative.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: AC optimal power flow with N-1 security and small-signal stability constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can neural networks encode the feasible space of dynamic security-constrained AC-OPF so it can be solved as a MILP?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Cost-optimal generator dispatch satisfying N-1 security and small-signal stability, with corresponding bus voltages and line flows.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Classification neural network encodes feasible operating points; exact mixed-integer reformulation with ReLU activations.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power flow balance for the intact system; contingency-wise AC constraints for N-1 security.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single operating point; no multi-period horizon.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single snapshot dispatch.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: None explicit; random cost-function test instances only.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: N-1 security and small-signal stability constraints on an IEEE 14-bus system.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Neural-network feasibility encoding, exact MILP reformulation, and iterative linearization of power losses.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported 99% test accuracy; feasibility improved to 100% with epsilon adjustment.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost of the intact system state.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Generator active/reactive limits, voltage magnitude limits, line-flow limits, AC power balance, preventive generator set-point equality across contingencies, eigenvalue-based small-signal stability damping ratio constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator active and reactive limits, voltage limits, line-flow limits, contingency set C, damping threshold gamma_min, neural-network weights and biases, ReLU bounds, epsilon conservativeness parameter, loss-linearization threshold rho.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Train a ReLU classification network on feasible/infeasible operating points, reformulate it exactly as MILP, and iteratively linearize AC losses to solve MILPs with Gurobi.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 14-bus system with 45,000 labeled samples; 99% test accuracy; compared against AC-OPF and N-1 security-constrained AC-OPF.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The approach obtained cost-optimal solutions satisfying both static and dynamic security constraints; epsilon increased feasibility to 100% with small cost increase.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: tractable MILP approximation and improved feasibility. Limitations: approximation error may cause optimality loss and separate networks are needed for different grids.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Uses a conservative feasibility margin epsilon to trade off feasibility and optimality.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Real-Time Sequential Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow: A Hybrid Knowledge-Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning Approach
data_properties.hasAuthor: Zhongkai Yi; Xue Wang; Cheng Yang; Chao Yang; Mengyang Niu; Wotao Yin
data_properties.hasInstitution: Alibaba DAMO Academy; Alibaba US; Tsinghua University; Harbin Institute of Technology
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve sequential real-time security-constrained optimal power flow with fast dispatch decisions under inaccurate environmental parameters.
data_properties.hasMotivation: ACOPF is nonconvex, time-coupled by ramping limits, and difficult to solve quickly and safely when system parameters are inaccurate or contingencies are unexperienced.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Sequential security-constrained AC optimal power flow for real-time operation with generator active/reactive dispatch and network security limits.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning method produce safe real-time OPF dispatches efficiently without relying on accurate environmental models?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Safe generator active and reactive power dispatch commands; resulting bus voltage magnitudes and branch active/reactive power flows within limits.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning with a safety-layer projection model and inactive-constraint identification.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow formulation with nonlinear nodal injections, branch flows, voltage magnitudes, and ramping-coupled generator limits.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Sequential multi-step dispatch with future load forecasts and ramping-coupled time dependence.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Real-time operation over time slots; forecasting horizon T steps.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Infinite-horizon sequential decision process terminated by grid failure/non-convergence.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses reinforcement learning for inaccurate environments and updates safety-layer parameters from latest measurements.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained ACOPF with coordinated active and reactive power dispatch, voltage and branch-flow security limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Improved SAC with SAM, prioritized replay, adaptive entropy, hybrid safety layer, and inactive-constraint elimination.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Claims faster decision-making and reduced security violations with comparable economic performance.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Includes forecasted net load demand in the state; no explicit demand response control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize cumulative generation operating cost, with quadratic cost coefficients for each generator over time.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power-balance equations, branch active/reactive flow equations, generator active/reactive limits, branch flow limits, voltage magnitude limits, and ramping-coupled generator bounds; safety-layer projection also enforces linearized security constraints and power balance.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients; generator active/reactive bounds and ramping limits; bus voltages; line conductance/susceptance or resistance/reactance; branch flow limits; load demand and forecasted load; slack-bus limits; penalty coefficients; SAC temperature and learning rates.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Sequential decisions are produced by an improved soft actor-critic policy, then projected by a linear security layer initialized from linearized power-flow knowledge and updated with data; inactive constraints are removed analytically.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 30-bus and larger systems, including contingency and parameter-error scenarios, with comparisons against penalty, constrained-policy, and pure data-driven safety-layer baselines.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The method maintains voltages and branch flows within safe ranges, reduces violation times in early training and contingencies, and scales to larger systems with low decision time.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: safe real-time dispatch, better robustness to inaccurate models, and high computational efficiency. Limitation: safety layer uses linearized power-flow approximation and may need conservative limits to offset approximation error.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper also evaluates scalability on 9-, 30-, 57-, 118-, and 1187-bus systems.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Online Optimization in Power Systems With High Penetration of Renewable Generation: Advances and Prospects
data_properties.hasAuthor: Zhaojian Wang; Wei Wei; John Zhen Fu Pang; Feng Liu; Bo Yang; Xinping Guan; Shengwei Mei
data_properties.hasInstitution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Tsinghua University; Institute of High Performance Computing (A*STAR), Singapore
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Review and compare online optimization techniques for power-system operation under high renewable penetration.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Increasing renewable variability and controllable loads make offline optimization less reliable for real-time power-system operation.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: How to classify and apply online optimization methods to dynamic control, single-period OPF/voltage regulation, and multi-period energy management problems.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Which online optimization paradigms are most suitable for different power-system time scales and operational settings?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Not applicable; this is a review paper rather than a solved OPF model.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Review of optimization-guided dynamic control, feedback optimization, Lyapunov optimization, and online convex optimization.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Discusses AC bus-injection and branch-flow models; linearized DC power flow and DistFlow approximations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Covers single-period and multi-period formulations, plus fast dynamic-control time scales.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Seconds to minutes for dynamic control; single-period and multi-period decision settings.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period and multi-period; some Lyapunov examples use finite or infinite horizons.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Addresses renewable variability and uncertainty through online decision-making without relying on forecasts or historical distributions.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Frequency control, voltage regulation, OPF, economic dispatch, energy storage scheduling, demand response, and power markets.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Compares feedback-based, primal-dual, ADMM, Newton-Raphson, Lyapunov, and OCO methods; discusses distributed and asynchronous variants.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Emphasizes fast response, tracking of time-varying conditions, and reduced computational burden.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Includes controllable loads, demand response, electric vehicles, and load-side frequency control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Examples include minimizing generation cost in OPF, regulation cost in frequency control, and long-term average cost in Lyapunov/OCO formulations.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Power-flow equations, voltage limits, generation and reactive-power bounds, power-balance constraints, line congestion, storage SoC and charging/discharging limits, ramping and other coupled constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generation cost coefficients ai, bi; voltage bounds vi; power injection bounds Pi, Qi; line parameters rij, xij, Bij; storage queue/SoC Qt; Lyapunov weight ρ; stepsize η; control gains.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: The paper reviews algorithmic frameworks and representative formulations; it does not present a single new solved OPF instance.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: No dedicated validation of a new OPF model; cites prior experimental and numerical studies in the reviewed literature.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: Online optimization is useful for volatile power systems because it can track changing conditions and avoid reliance on inaccurate forecasts.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: fast, measurement-driven, and suitable for time-varying systems. Limitations: problem-dependent, often lacks a unified theory, and some methods need communication or predictions.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper is a survey and taxonomy of online optimization methods in power systems.
data_properties.hasSourceFileName: Online Optimization in Power Systems With.pdf

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve large-scale security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps efficiently under strict time limits.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Large SCOPF instances contain millions of continuous/integer variables and nonlinear nonconvex constraints, making them difficult to solve within challenge time limits.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps, including AC power flow, contingencies, reserves, device switching, and ramping constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a decomposition-based hybrid solver scale multi-timestep SCOPF to very large grids while maintaining high-quality feasible solutions?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation and consumption dispatch, device switching status, bus voltage angles, AC power-flow feasible operating point, and reserve allocations.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Two-stage DC/AC decomposition with sequential optimization for large networks.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: DC module uses linearized/MILP approximations; AC module solves full nonlinear AC power-flow equations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Multiple time steps; sequential stage-wise optimization for large horizons.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Time-step based control horizon; exact interval length not specified.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Control horizon divided into stages for networks over 2000 buses.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Contingency constraints included; no stochastic or robust uncertainty model stated.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained AC OPF with reserves, ramping, device uptime/downtime, and switching constraints.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Problem reformulation, McCormick relaxation, slack variables, clique constraints, analytical derivatives, vectorization, and sequential bound updates.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for scalability and strict time limits on very large instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consumption devices represented with bid blocks and power consumption bounds.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus z over device powers, bus voltage angles, and switching variables.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints G enforce power-balance and AC/DC network equations; inequality constraints H cover voltage limits, real/reactive power limits, reserves, ramping, switching, contingency, and device operation constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Device power pjt, bus voltage angle θit, switching status ujt, shunt conductance gshjt, branch flow limits smaxj, reserve factors σscrn, ramp-up Pru, ramp-down Prd, and mismatch penalty pit.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: DC subproblem solved as MILP with Gurobi; AC subproblem solved as NLP with IPOPT; large cases use sequential stage-wise optimization and selective contingency inclusion.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on 300+ scenarios across 73 to 8316-bus networks from ARPA-E GO challenge datasets.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The approach achieved high scaled scores in most scenarios, with average scores around 0.983 on Scenario Set 3 and 0.9992 on Scenario Set 2, while meeting time limits.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: scalable, robust, high-quality solutions, full AC formulation. Limitation: solution quality varies by scenario and depends on available reserve abundance; large cases require sequential decomposition.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Applied to ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets and testing platform.

data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, with generator costs represented by individual piece-wise linear cost functions.

data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method closely matches MIPS voltage solutions, satisfies network constraints, and reduces total solution time from 2030.4 s to 35.26 s.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: fast and feasible OPF approximation without running a physics-based solver. Limitation: pure end-to-end ML still causes many equality-constraint violations.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Co-optimize energy dispatch and operating reserve allocation in AC power system operation.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Conventional reserve scheduling or simplified ED-based approaches neglect full AC network constraints and can cause infeasibility, voltage insecurity, congestion, and suboptimality.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Single-period reserve-constrained AC optimal power flow with device energy/reserve co-optimization, AC network limits, and zonal reserve requirements.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can reserve models be efficiently incorporated into AC OPF and solved accurately for large-scale systems?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation and consumption dispatch, device reserve allocations, bus voltage magnitudes and angles, AC branch power flows, shunt steps, transformer tap ratios and phase shifts, and reserve shortfall amounts.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Single-period nonlinear AC OPF with co-optimized energy and real/reactive reserve scheduling.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Full AC branch flow equations with voltage magnitudes/angles, transformer tap ratios, phase shifting, and shunt modeling.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses predefined zonal reserve requirements; no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes producing and consuming devices, real/reactive reserves, zonal reserve zones, shunts, transformers, and branch overload penalties.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Accelerated primal-dual interior point method with symmetric Jacobian, Cholesky factorization, direct step-size update, and tailored initialization.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for faster and more stable solution of large-scale RCOPF instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consuming devices participate in energy and reserve provision.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus: device consumption benefit minus generation cost, imbalance penalties, branch overload penalties, reserve offer costs, zonal reserve shortfall penalties, and reactive reserve costs.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints enforce device definitions, reserve cost definitions, AC branch flow equations, bus real/reactive power balances, and zonal reserve requirements; inequalities bound device outputs, reserve capabilities, voltage magnitudes, transformer settings, branch apparent flows, shunt steps, and reserve requirements.
data_properties.usesParameter: Offer/bid block prices, imbalance penalty costs, branch overload penalty cost, reserve marginal costs, branch conductance/susceptance, shunt coefficients, device power limits, reserve capability limits, zonal reserve requirements and scaling factors, branch flow limits, voltage/tap/phase bounds.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Solved by A-PDIPM using perturbed KKT conditions, symmetric Jacobian construction, pivoted Cholesky factorization, matrix reordering/scaling, direct feasibility-preserving step sizes, and problem-specific primal/dual initialization.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on 73-bus to 23,643-bus GO3-derived cases; compared with pre-reserve/post-reserve OPF and IPOPT.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: RCOPF produced converged secure solutions and higher market surplus than simplified reserve allocation approaches; A-PDIPM reduced iterations and runtime, especially on large cases.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: accurate AC co-optimization with reserves and improved computational efficiency. Limitation: single-period formulation and some scenarios still allow reserve shortfalls when economically optimal.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Derived from DOE ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets.

data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: PEVs improve voltage stability margin; wind uncertainty reduces it; voltage-stability constraints alter optimal dispatch and PEV parking-lot capacity; stochastic modeling lowers energy loss versus deterministic wind.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: jointly captures UC, OPF, stochastic wind, voltage stability, ESS, and PEVs. Limitation: relies on scenario-based wind modeling and simplified PEV battery behavior.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Loading margin is treated as a scenario-dependent variable.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Probabilistically Robust AC Optimal Power Flow
data_properties.hasAuthor: Mohammadreza Chamanbaz; Fabrizio Dabbene; Constantino M. Lagoa
data_properties.hasInstitution: iTrust Center for Research in Cyber Security, Singapore University of Technology and Design; CNR-IEIIT, Torino, Italy; Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Penn State University
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Minimize generation cost in AC optimal power flow while satisfying network constraints under uncertain loads and renewable generation with probabilistic guarantees.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Classical OPF dispatch is rigid and can become inefficient or infeasible under renewable and load uncertainty, causing overloads and outages.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Robust and chance-constrained AC optimal power flow with uncertain loads and renewable generators.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can AC-OPF be solved efficiently under uncertainty while limiting the probability of violating generation and transmission constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal controllable generation dispatch, generator voltage magnitudes, deployment vector, and corresponding bus voltage and line-flow-feasible operating point.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Scenario-with-certificates formulation combined with convex SDP relaxation of AC power flow.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with voltage-magnitude and line-flow constraints via lifted matrix W.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period OPF repeated over hourly demand scenarios in experiments.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per solve; 24 hourly solves in simulation.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Probabilistic uncertainty in loads and renewable generation using scenario with certificates and chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes renewable generators, uncertain loads, generator participation factors, voltage limits, and transmission limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Convex relaxation plus randomized scenario-with-certificates sampling.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: A priori probabilistic guarantee on constraint-violation risk; exact for a restricted class of networks.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Uncertain loads are explicitly modeled and balanced through generator deployment factors.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost f(u); in the penalized variant, worst-case cost adds reactive-power and line-loss penalties.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power balance equalities; generator active/reactive limits; voltage magnitude bounds; line-voltage-difference or apparent-flow limits; deployment factors sum to one and remain nonnegative.
data_properties.usesParameter: Uncertain complex load and renewable deviations δ; deployment vector α; bus-voltage matrix W split into Wu and Wx; risk levels ε and β; line admittances ylm; voltage and power limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Uses SDP lifting W=VV* and scenario-with-certificates sampling to solve a convex program; implemented with YALMIP and Mosek.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the New England 39-bus system with Monte Carlo testing over 10,000 samples and comparison against nominal OPF and a prior probabilistic AC-OPF method.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method greatly reduced infeasible samples and line-flow violations versus nominal OPF, while using far fewer scenario samples than the compared parameterized approach.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Can incorporate N-1 security constraints and outage probabilities within the same scenario framework.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Formulate and solve a single-objective OPF for hybrid AC/DC networks with VSC-MTDC links and renewable sources.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Need for cost-effective, secure AC/DC grid operation with renewable integration and limited prior OPF work on VSC-MTDC systems.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Single-objective OPF on a modified IEEE 30-bus hybrid AC/DC network with thermal generators, renewables, and VSC-MTDC links.
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal fuel cost, fuel cost with valve-point effect, fuel cost with emission-carbon tax, voltage deviation, and active power loss values; corresponding optimal dispatch and voltage profiles.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid AC/DC OPF with VSC-MTDC transmission lines and renewable energy sources.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance, DC power balance, line-flow loss terms, and VSC converter constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period steady-state optimization.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating point.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Reserve and penalty cost modeling for stochastic wind, solar PV/small-hydro, and wind-tidal generation.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Modified IEEE 30-bus AC/DC network with thermal generators, wind, solar PV, small-hydro, tidal, transformers, and VSC-MTDC grids.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: FDB-SFS metaheuristic with diffusion and FDB-based updating.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Compared across 30 runs; FDB-SFS showed best objective values and robust convergence.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: None reported.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize fuel cost; fuel cost with valve-point effect; fuel cost plus emission-carbon tax; voltage deviation; or active power loss, depending on the case.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC active/reactive power balance, DC power balance, generator active/reactive and voltage limits, load-bus voltage limits, line apparent-power limits, transformer tap limits, and VSC/DC voltage-power limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Thermal cost and emission coefficients; valve-point coefficients; renewable direct/reserve/penalty cost coefficients; Weibull, Lognormal, and Gumbel distribution parameters; generator, voltage, line, tap, and VSC bounds.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: FDB-SFS, SFS, AGDE, MPA, and ASO were run for 200 iterations and 30 trials on the modified IEEE 30-bus system using MATACDC power-flow analysis.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Simulation results were checked against constraint limits and compared statistically using Wilcoxon and Friedman tests.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: FDB-SFS achieved the best results in all five cases, including lowest fuel cost, voltage deviation, and active power loss.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: integrates VSC-MTDC and multiple renewables in one OPF. Limitation: single-objective, static formulation; future work suggests multiobjective and dynamic OPF.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Future work proposed multiobjective optimization and dynamic OPF with load uncertainties.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与用户需求高度一致，已将动态安全约束纳入 AC-OPF，并明确包含小信号稳定与 N-1 安全，能够覆盖高新能源与变流器并网下“不能只看静态经济性”的核心诉求。 / English explanation: Highly consistent with the user need; it embeds dynamic security constraints into AC-OPF and explicitly includes small-signal stability and N-1 security, covering the core requirement to go beyond static economics under high renewable and converter-interfaced penetration.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是更偏向小信号稳定与静态单时段调度，未显式建模更广义的振荡全过程、失步机理或保护动作联动。 / English explanation: Main gap is that it focuses more on small-signal stability and static single-period dispatch, without explicit modeling of broader oscillation dynamics, loss-of-synchronism mechanisms, or protection-action coordination.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与需求较一致，已把频率安全、RoCoF 和 frequency nadir 纳入调度，且面向低惯量电网，符合新能源高渗透后需要考虑动态稳定的方向。 / English explanation: Consistent with the requirement; it incorporates frequency security, RoCoF, and frequency nadir into dispatch and targets low-inertia grids, aligning with the need to consider dynamic stability under high renewable penetration.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：覆盖重点是频率动态安全，而非更广义的振荡模态、失步过程或保护动作；同时采用单时段 DC 潮流，动态暂态刻画能力有限。 / English explanation: The focus is frequency dynamic security rather than broader oscillatory modes, loss-of-synchronism processes, or protection actions; it also uses single-period DC power flow, limiting transient dynamic representation.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：总体符合用户对实时安全与稳定约束的需求，具备多步序列调度、AC 约束和安全层投影，适合高新能源场景下的快速安全运行。 / English explanation: Overall fits the user's need for real-time security and stability constraints, with multi-step sequential dispatch, AC constraints, and a safety-layer projection suitable for fast secure operation in high-renewable settings.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要不足是稳定性处理依赖线性化安全层与近似潮流，对低惯量振荡、失步和保护动作的细粒度动态机理覆盖不足。 / English explanation: Main limitation is that stability handling relies on a linearized safety layer and approximate power flow, which is insufficient for fine-grained dynamic mechanisms such as low-inertia oscillations, loss of synchronism, and protection actions.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：作为综述，它与用户强调的高新能源下在线优化、动态控制和频率/电压调节方向一致，能作为方法层面的匹配。 / English explanation: As a survey, it aligns with the user's emphasis on online optimization, dynamic control, and frequency/voltage regulation under high renewables, making it a method-level match.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它不是可直接求解的单一 OPF 模型，不能直接给出具体调度结果，也不能直接联合求解失稳或保护动作。 / English explanation: It is not a directly solvable single OPF model, so it cannot provide case-specific dispatch results or directly co-solve instability and protection actions.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与需求较一致，具备多时间步安全约束、备用、爬坡和设备切换，适合高新能源渗透下的动态运行优化，而不只是静态经济性。 / English explanation: Fairly consistent with the requirement; it includes multi-time-step security constraints, reserves, ramping, and device switching, making it suitable for dynamic operational optimization under high renewable penetration rather than only static economics.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是仍以多步静态优化与分解求解为主，没有显式建模低惯量振荡、失步或保护动作等连续动态过程。 / English explanation: Main gap is that it remains a multi-step static optimization/decomposition approach and does not explicitly model continuous dynamic processes such as low-inertia oscillations, loss of synchronism, or protection actions.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与用户需求部分一致，已考虑 N-1 安全约束和故障后可行性，说明它不只是静态经济调度。 / English explanation: Partially consistent with the user need; it considers N-1 security constraints and post-contingency feasibility, showing it is not merely static economic dispatch.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：但它主要仍是静态稳态安全约束优化，没有直接建模振荡、失步、低惯量频率动态或保护逻辑，因此对“动态稳定”的覆盖偏弱。 / English explanation: However, it is still mainly a static steady-state security-constrained optimization and does not directly model oscillations, loss of synchronism, low-inertia frequency dynamics, or protection logic, so its dynamic-stability coverage is weak.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与需求有一定一致性，因为它考虑可再生波动、实时/日前调度、爬坡约束以及电压稳定指标，明显超出纯经济 OPF。 / English explanation: Somewhat consistent with the requirement because it considers renewable variability, day-ahead/real-time scheduling, ramp constraints, and a voltage stability index, clearly going beyond pure economic OPF.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：但它主要关注电压稳定与区间内波动管理，没有直接建模振荡、失步、低惯量频率动态或保护动作，因此动态稳定覆盖不完整。 / English explanation: But it mainly focuses on voltage stability and intra-interval variability management, without direct modeling of oscillations, loss of synchronism, low-inertia frequency dynamics, or protection actions, so dynamic-stability coverage is incomplete.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与需求部分一致，属于安全约束 OPF，包含电压/潮流/无功补偿等安全约束，适合高渗透新能源下的安全调度辅助。 / English explanation: Partially consistent; it is a security-constrained OPF with voltage/flow/reactive-compensation security constraints, useful for secure dispatch support under high renewable penetration.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：但它主要覆盖静态安全约束，没有直接建模低惯量、振荡、失步或保护动作，因此与用户强调的动态稳定主题关联较弱。 / English explanation: However, it mainly covers static security constraints and does not directly model low inertia, oscillations, loss of synchronism, or protection actions, so its connection to the user's dynamic-stability emphasis is weak.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与需求有一定一致性，因为它把备用约束与完整 AC 网络约束联合优化，能体现高新能源场景下的安全裕度与运行可行性。 / English explanation: Somewhat consistent because it co-optimizes reserve constraints with full AC network constraints, reflecting security margins and operational feasibility in high-renewable scenarios.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：但它是单时段模型，重点在备用与市场盈余，不直接处理动态稳定、振荡、失步或保护动作。 / English explanation: But it is a single-period model focused on reserves and market surplus, and it does not directly address dynamic stability, oscillations, loss of synchronism, or protection actions.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与需求部分一致，已把电压稳定约束、风电不确定性、储能和 PEV 协同调度纳入，说明它不只看静态成本。 / English explanation: Partially consistent; it includes voltage stability constraints, wind uncertainty, storage, and coordinated PEV scheduling, showing it is not limited to static cost.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：但它主要面向孤岛微电网的电压稳定，而不是输电网中的振荡、失步、低惯量频率动态或保护动作，适用场景与用户重点不完全一致。 / English explanation: However, it mainly targets voltage stability in isolated microgrids rather than transmission-grid oscillations, loss of synchronism, low-inertia frequency dynamics, or protection actions, so the application context is not fully aligned with the user's focus.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与需求有一定一致性，因为它面向不确定负荷和可再生出力，通过概率约束与鲁棒 AC OPF 处理新能源波动风险。 / English explanation: Somewhat consistent because it addresses uncertain loads and renewable generation through chance-constrained and robust AC OPF, handling renewable-variability risk.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：但它关注的是概率可行性与线路/电压约束风险，而不是动态稳定、低惯量振荡或失步后的保护联动，因此对用户强调的动态机理覆盖不足。 / English explanation: But it focuses on probabilistic feasibility and line/voltage constraint risk rather than dynamic stability, low-inertia oscillations, or protection coordination after loss of synchronism, so it does not fully cover the user's dynamic-mechanism emphasis.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与需求有部分一致性，因为它面向含 VSC-MTDC 与可再生能源的混合 AC/DC 系统，考虑了变流器接口资源下的运行约束。 / English explanation: Partially consistent because it targets hybrid AC/DC systems with VSC-MTDC and renewables, considering operational constraints under converter-interfaced resources.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：但它仍是单时段静态 OPF，目标以经济性/损耗/电压偏差为主，没有直接包含动态稳定、振荡、失步或保护动作。 / English explanation: However, it remains a single-period static OPF with objectives centered on economics/losses/voltage deviation, and it does not directly include dynamic stability, oscillations, loss of synchronism, or protection actions.

validated_output.group_summary: 本组中最契合用户需求的是多时段含储能的调度/OPF模型：Hybrid_UC_OPF_Renewable_Integrated_Power_Systems 与 Multi_Period_Hybrid_AC_DC_OPF。前者更贴近“储能吸收波动并参与日前能量管理”，后者更强于“多时段 + 电压/潮流 + 储能/柔性负荷联合优化”。Online_Optimization_in_Power_Systems 仅作为方法综述保留，适合作为参考但不是可直接执行的 OPF 模型。 / The best matches are the multi-period storage-inclusive scheduling/OPF models: Hybrid_UC_OPF_Renewable_Integrated_Power_Systems and Multi_Period_Hybrid_AC_DC_OPF. data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Stochastic energy management of isolated microgrids with coordinated UC-OPF under voltage stability constraints.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Wind power uncertainty and PEV integration can affect microgrid voltage stability and secure operation.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Coordinated unit commitment and optimal power flow for isolated microgrids with wind, PV, ESS, and PEVs under stochastic voltage-stability limits.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How do wind uncertainty and PEVs affect voltage stability margin and optimal EMS scheduling in isolated microgrids?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generator on/off status and dispatch, ESS charge/discharge schedule, PEV charging/discharging schedule, bus voltages, branch flows, and loading margin.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Stochastic scenario-based UC-OPF with voltage-stability-constrained EMS.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with bus voltage magnitudes/angles and branch apparent-power limits.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Multi-period hourly scheduling over 24 hours.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: 24 hours
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Scenario-based stochastic wind-power modeling using Weibull-derived scenarios.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Isolated microgrid with diesel generators, wind turbines, PV units, ESS, and PEV parking lots.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Coordinated UC and OPF solved as MINLP in GAMS; DICOPT with relaxed MINLP warm start.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Validated on a modified CIGRE benchmark microgrid; DICOPT reported as most efficient solver.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: PEV parking lots modeled with charging/discharging limits and energy constraints.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total operating cost: quadratic generation cost plus start-up and shut-down costs over all time intervals and scenarios.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Active/reactive power balance; generator output limits; ramp-up/down limits; minimum up/down times; start-up/shut-down logic; spinning reserve; branch flow and voltage limits; L-index voltage-stability limit; wind/PV output relations; ESS SOC and charge/discharge limits; PEV energy, charging/discharging, and parking-lot capacity limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients ag, bg, cg, Csupg, Csdng; reserve requirement RESt; voltage limits Vmin/Vmax; branch limits Smaxij; L-index limit Llimt; wind scenario probabilities πs and mean wind speeds vs; PEV capacities and efficiencies; ESS capacities and efficiencies; ramp rates Rupg/Rdng; minimum up/down times Tupg/Tdng.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Formulated as a stochastic MINLP in GAMS and solved with commercial MINLP solvers; DICOPT used with an initial relaxed NLP solution from CONOPT.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Tested on a modified CIGRE microgrid benchmark with five wind scenarios and compared across cases with/without PEVs and voltage-stability constraints.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: PEVs improve voltage stability margin; wind uncertainty reduces it; voltage-stability constraints alter optimal dispatch and PEV parking-lot capacity; stochastic modeling lowers energy loss versus deterministic wind.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: jointly captures UC, OPF, stochastic wind, voltage stability, ESS, and PEVs. Limitation: relies on scenario-based wind modeling and simplified PEV battery behavior.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Loading margin is treated as a scenario-dependent variable.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Optimize unit commitment and power flow feasibility for renewable-integrated power systems with PV and pumped hydro storage.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Intermittent PV output creates scheduling and power-flow feasibility challenges that require flexible generation management.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Day-ahead UC-OPF scheduling for a modified IEEE 30-bus system with thermal generators, PV, and pumped hydro storage.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid MINLP–PSO approach produce a cost-effective UC schedule while satisfying power-flow constraints under varying PV outputs?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal hourly generator dispatch, PV and PHS operating schedules, bus voltages, line flows, and total operational cost/penalty values.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid two-stage UC then OPF refinement; MINLP scheduling followed by PSO-assisted Newton-Raphson feasibility correction.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with bus voltage, reactive power, and line capacity constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: 24-hour day-ahead planning horizon with hourly load and PV profiles.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: 24 hours.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Varying PV outputs are tested, but no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model is formulated.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Modified IEEE 30-bus system with thermal generators, PV at bus 6, and PHS at bus 25.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: SCIP-MINLP initial solve, Newton-Raphson feasibility check, then PSO refinement for violated hours.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reduces power-flow violations by more than 99% and lowers penalty from 302,210.9 to 2,128.49.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Hourly load profile is fixed; no demand response or flexible demand model is included.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total operational cost over 24 hours, including thermal fuel cost, start-up and shut-down cost, and PHS operating cost.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Generator active and reactive limits, minimum up/down times, ramp-rate limits, PHS storage/capacity bounds, power balance, bus voltage limits, and transmission line capacity limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Quadratic fuel-cost coefficients a, b, c; generator min/max active and reactive limits; minimum up/down times; ramp rates; PHS capacity, efficiency, initial storage, O&M cost; penalty weights for voltage, power, reactive power, line, ramp, and NR convergence violations.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: SCIP solves UC first; Newton-Raphson checks feasibility; PSO optimizes only hours with violations using a penalty-based fitness function.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Tested on a modified IEEE 30-bus system with 24-hour load and PV data; OPF refinement substantially reduced violations and penalties.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: UC alone gave the lowest cost but infeasible power flow; OPF refinement slightly increased cost while making the schedule technically feasible.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: balances economic dispatch and feasibility with large penalty reduction. Limitation: no explicit stochastic uncertainty model; PSO is applied only after detecting violations.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: PHS operates mainly as a balancing/backup resource with relatively low output.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Reserve Constrained AC Optimal Power Flow Using Accelerated Primal-Dual Interior Point Method
data_properties.hasAuthor: Yehong Peng; Yong Fu
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Co-optimize energy dispatch and operating reserve allocation in AC power system operation.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Conventional reserve scheduling or simplified ED-based approaches neglect full AC network constraints and can cause infeasibility, voltage insecurity, congestion, and suboptimality.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Single-period reserve-constrained AC optimal power flow with device energy/reserve co-optimization, AC network limits, and zonal reserve requirements.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can reserve models be efficiently incorporated into AC OPF and solved accurately for large-scale systems?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation and consumption dispatch, device reserve allocations, bus voltage magnitudes and angles, AC branch power flows, shunt steps, transformer tap ratios and phase shifts, and reserve shortfall amounts.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Single-period nonlinear AC OPF with co-optimized energy and real/reactive reserve scheduling.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Full AC branch flow equations with voltage magnitudes/angles, transformer tap ratios, phase shifting, and shunt modeling.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses predefined zonal reserve requirements; no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes producing and consuming devices, real/reactive reserves, zonal reserve zones, shunts, transformers, and branch overload penalties.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Accelerated primal-dual interior point method with symmetric Jacobian, Cholesky factorization, direct step-size update, and tailored initialization.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for faster and more stable solution of large-scale RCOPF instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consuming devices participate in energy and reserve provision.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus: device consumption benefit minus generation cost, imbalance penalties, branch overload penalties, reserve offer costs, zonal reserve shortfall penalties, and reactive reserve costs.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints enforce device definitions, reserve cost definitions, AC branch flow equations, bus real/reactive power balances, and zonal reserve requirements; inequalities bound device outputs, reserve capabilities, voltage magnitudes, transformer settings, branch apparent flows, shunt steps, and reserve requirements.
data_properties.usesParameter: Offer/bid block prices, imbalance penalty costs, branch overload penalty cost, reserve marginal costs, branch conductance/susceptance, shunt coefficients, device power limits, reserve capability limits, zonal reserve requirements and scaling factors, branch flow limits, voltage/tap/phase bounds.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Solved by A-PDIPM using perturbed KKT conditions, symmetric Jacobian construction, pivoted Cholesky factorization, matrix reordering/scaling, direct feasibility-preserving step sizes, and problem-specific primal/dual initialization.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on 73-bus to 23,643-bus GO3-derived cases; compared with pre-reserve/post-reserve OPF and IPOPT.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: RCOPF produced converged secure solutions and higher market surplus than simplified reserve allocation approaches; A-PDIPM reduced iterations and runtime, especially on large cases.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: accurate AC co-optimization with reserves and improved computational efficiency. Limitation: single-period formulation and some scenarios still allow reserve shortfalls when economically optimal.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Derived from DOE ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve large-scale security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps efficiently under strict time limits.

data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation and consumption dispatch, device switching status, bus voltage angles, AC power-flow feasible operating point, and reserve allocations.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Two-stage DC/AC decomposition with sequential optimization for large networks.

data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Multiple time steps; sequential stage-wise optimization for large horizons.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Time-step based control horizon; exact interval length not specified.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Control horizon divided into stages for networks over 2000 buses.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Contingency constraints included; no stochastic or robust uncertainty model stated.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained AC OPF with reserves, ramping, device uptime/downtime, and switching constraints.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Problem reformulation, McCormick relaxation, slack variables, clique constraints, analytical derivatives, vectorization, and sequential bound updates.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for scalability and strict time limits on very large instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consumption devices represented with bid blocks and power consumption bounds.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus z over device powers, bus voltage angles, and switching variables.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints G enforce power-balance and AC/DC network equations; inequality constraints H cover voltage limits, real/reactive power limits, reserves, ramping, switching, contingency, and device operation constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Device power pjt, bus voltage angle θit, switching status ujt, shunt conductance gshjt, branch flow limits smaxj, reserve factors σscrn, ramp-up Pru, ramp-down Prd, and mismatch penalty pit.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: DC subproblem solved as MILP with Gurobi; AC subproblem solved as NLP with IPOPT; large cases use sequential stage-wise optimization and selective contingency inclusion.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on 300+ scenarios across 73 to 8316-bus networks from ARPA-E GO challenge datasets.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The approach achieved high scaled scores in most scenarios, with average scores around 0.983 on Scenario Set 3 and 0.9992 on Scenario Set 2, while meeting time limits.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: scalable, robust, high-quality solutions, full AC formulation. Limitation: solution quality varies by scenario and depends on available reserve abundance; large cases require sequential decomposition.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Applied to ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets and testing platform.

data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses forecasted solar, wind, and load variability within intervals; no explicit stochastic or robust formulation.

data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Compared conventional and proposed RT-OPF/DA-OPF on IEEE 30-bus test system using 60-min RT and 24-h DA schedules.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed approach reduced RT total cost and increased DA profit while keeping optimization size unchanged and improving voltage stability.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Size and place community energy storage and photovoltaic systems in a low-voltage district using multi-period optimal power flow.
