data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Review and compare online optimization techniques for power-system operation under high renewable penetration.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Increasing renewable variability and controllable loads make offline optimization less reliable for real-time power-system operation.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: How to classify and apply online optimization methods to dynamic control, single-period OPF/voltage regulation, and multi-period energy management problems.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Which online optimization paradigms are most suitable for different power-system time scales and operational settings?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Not applicable; this is a review paper rather than a solved OPF model.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Review of optimization-guided dynamic control, feedback optimization, Lyapunov optimization, and online convex optimization.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Discusses AC bus-injection and branch-flow models; linearized DC power flow and DistFlow approximations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Covers single-period and multi-period formulations, plus fast dynamic-control time scales.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Seconds to minutes for dynamic control; single-period and multi-period decision settings.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period and multi-period; some Lyapunov examples use finite or infinite horizons.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Addresses renewable variability and uncertainty through online decision-making without relying on forecasts or historical distributions.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Frequency control, voltage regulation, OPF, economic dispatch, energy storage scheduling, demand response, and power markets.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Compares feedback-based, primal-dual, ADMM, Newton-Raphson, Lyapunov, and OCO methods; discusses distributed and asynchronous variants.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Emphasizes fast response, tracking of time-varying conditions, and reduced computational burden.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Includes controllable loads, demand response, electric vehicles, and load-side frequency control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Examples include minimizing generation cost in OPF, regulation cost in frequency control, and long-term average cost in Lyapunov/OCO formulations.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Power-flow equations, voltage limits, generation and reactive-power bounds, power-balance constraints, line congestion, storage SoC and charging/discharging limits, ramping and other coupled constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generation cost coefficients ai, bi; voltage bounds vi; power injection bounds Pi, Qi; line parameters rij, xij, Bij; storage queue/SoC Qt; Lyapunov weight ρ; stepsize η; control gains.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: The paper reviews algorithmic frameworks and representative formulations; it does not present a single new solved OPF instance.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: No dedicated validation of a new OPF model; cites prior experimental and numerical studies in the reviewed literature.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: Online optimization is useful for volatile power systems because it can track changing conditions and avoid reliance on inaccurate forecasts.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: fast, measurement-driven, and suitable for time-varying systems. Limitations: problem-dependent, often lacks a unified theory, and some methods need communication or predictions.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper is a survey and taxonomy of online optimization methods in power systems.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Benchmark and compare distribution-grid OPF formulations for feasibility, optimality, and scalability.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Distribution OPF is nonconvex and different relaxations/approximations can be infeasible, inexact, or poorly scalable.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Distribution grid optimal power flow under loss minimization, PV hosting maximization, and voltage deviation minimization.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How do NLP, convex relaxation, and linearized D-OPF formulations compare in feasibility, optimality, and scalability across problem types and feeder sizes?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation dispatch, DG active/reactive power dispatch, bus voltage profiles, branch power flows/current magnitudes, and PV hosting capacity.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Deterministic, continuous, single-period benchmarking of multiple D-OPF formulations.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Bus injection and branch flow formulations; nonlinear, SOCP, SDP, and LinDistFlow variants.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period steady-state.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: None; deterministic formulation.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Radial distribution feeders with DGs, capacitor banks, voltage regulators, and substation bus.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Numerical benchmarking and visualization of feasible solution spaces; comparison across formulations and feeder sizes.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Assesses feasibility gap, exactness, solve time, scalability, and AC-feasibility.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Constant-power loads; no explicit demand response or flexible demand.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total power loss; maximize PV hosting capacity; minimize sum of voltage deviations from a setpoint.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC or approximate power-balance equations; voltage magnitude limits; branch current or apparent-power limits; DG apparent-power/reactive-power limits; PV unity-power-factor or reactive-power-control constraints; convex-relaxation PSD/rank or cone constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Load demands pL,i and qL,i; line impedances rij and xij; admittance Yij; voltage limits Vmin/Vmax; voltage setpoint vset; DG ratings sratedDG,i and pDG,max; branch current rating Iratedij; substation voltage Vsub.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Solved with IPOPT, Knitro, Gurobi, CVX, MOSEK, and CPLEX on 123-, 730-, and 2522-node feeders; validated with OpenDSS and MATPOWER.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Compared against OpenDSS substation power flows and MATPOWER; small cases matched closely for exact formulations, while relaxed/linear models were checked for feasibility gaps.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: SOCP and SDP are exact for loss minimization but often inexact for PV hosting and voltage-deviation objectives; NLP-BIM scales better than NLP-BFM; LinDistFlow can misestimate losses, voltages, and PV hosting.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: comprehensive, implementation-centric comparison across formulations and feeder sizes. Limitation: balanced single-phase, deterministic, single-period study; unbalanced multi-phase and richer PV-hosting constraints are not fully addressed.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Reserve Constrained AC Optimal Power Flow Using Accelerated Primal-Dual Interior Point Method
data_properties.hasAuthor: Yehong Peng; Yong Fu
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Co-optimize energy dispatch and operating reserve allocation in AC power system operation.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Conventional reserve scheduling or simplified ED-based approaches neglect full AC network constraints and can cause infeasibility, voltage insecurity, congestion, and suboptimality.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Single-period reserve-constrained AC optimal power flow with device energy/reserve co-optimization, AC network limits, and zonal reserve requirements.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can reserve models be efficiently incorporated into AC OPF and solved accurately for large-scale systems?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation and consumption dispatch, device reserve allocations, bus voltage magnitudes and angles, AC branch power flows, shunt steps, transformer tap ratios and phase shifts, and reserve shortfall amounts.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Single-period nonlinear AC OPF with co-optimized energy and real/reactive reserve scheduling.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Full AC branch flow equations with voltage magnitudes/angles, transformer tap ratios, phase shifting, and shunt modeling.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses predefined zonal reserve requirements; no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes producing and consuming devices, real/reactive reserves, zonal reserve zones, shunts, transformers, and branch overload penalties.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Accelerated primal-dual interior point method with symmetric Jacobian, Cholesky factorization, direct step-size update, and tailored initialization.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for faster and more stable solution of large-scale RCOPF instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consuming devices participate in energy and reserve provision.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus: device consumption benefit minus generation cost, imbalance penalties, branch overload penalties, reserve offer costs, zonal reserve shortfall penalties, and reactive reserve costs.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints enforce device definitions, reserve cost definitions, AC branch flow equations, bus real/reactive power balances, and zonal reserve requirements; inequalities bound device outputs, reserve capabilities, voltage magnitudes, transformer settings, branch apparent flows, shunt steps, and reserve requirements.
data_properties.usesParameter: Offer/bid block prices, imbalance penalty costs, branch overload penalty cost, reserve marginal costs, branch conductance/susceptance, shunt coefficients, device power limits, reserve capability limits, zonal reserve requirements and scaling factors, branch flow limits, voltage/tap/phase bounds.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Solved by A-PDIPM using perturbed KKT conditions, symmetric Jacobian construction, pivoted Cholesky factorization, matrix reordering/scaling, direct feasibility-preserving step sizes, and problem-specific primal/dual initialization.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on 73-bus to 23,643-bus GO3-derived cases; compared with pre-reserve/post-reserve OPF and IPOPT.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: RCOPF produced converged secure solutions and higher market surplus than simplified reserve allocation approaches; A-PDIPM reduced iterations and runtime, especially on large cases.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: accurate AC co-optimization with reserves and improved computational efficiency. Limitation: single-period formulation and some scenarios still allow reserve shortfalls when economically optimal.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Derived from DOE ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets.

data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Multi-regional interconnected grid with dispatchable generators, wind farms, loads, voltages, and line flows.

data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported exact optimality relative to centralized benchmark and high accuracy across system sizes and load levels.

data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The method achieves distributed CC-OPF without revealing confidential data and without optimality loss relative to the benchmark.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: exact optimality, no parameter tuning, confidentiality preservation. Limitation: relies on linearized power flow and is not directly full AC OPF.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Applicable to AGC-aware CC-OPF with deterministic participation factors and extendable to joint-chance-constrained OPF.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Minimize generation cost in AC optimal power flow while satisfying network constraints under uncertain loads and renewable generation with probabilistic guarantees.

data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Robust and chance-constrained AC optimal power flow with uncertain loads and renewable generators.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can AC-OPF be solved efficiently under uncertainty while limiting the probability of violating generation and transmission constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal controllable generation dispatch, generator voltage magnitudes, deployment vector, and corresponding bus voltage and line-flow-feasible operating point.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Scenario-with-certificates formulation combined with convex SDP relaxation of AC power flow.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with voltage-magnitude and line-flow constraints via lifted matrix W.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period OPF repeated over hourly demand scenarios in experiments.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per solve; 24 hourly solves in simulation.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Probabilistic uncertainty in loads and renewable generation using scenario with certificates and chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes renewable generators, uncertain loads, generator participation factors, voltage limits, and transmission limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Convex relaxation plus randomized scenario-with-certificates sampling.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: A priori probabilistic guarantee on constraint-violation risk; exact for a restricted class of networks.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Uncertain loads are explicitly modeled and balanced through generator deployment factors.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost f(u); in the penalized variant, worst-case cost adds reactive-power and line-loss penalties.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power balance equalities; generator active/reactive limits; voltage magnitude bounds; line-voltage-difference or apparent-flow limits; deployment factors sum to one and remain nonnegative.
data_properties.usesParameter: Uncertain complex load and renewable deviations δ; deployment vector α; bus-voltage matrix W split into Wu and Wx; risk levels ε and β; line admittances ylm; voltage and power limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Uses SDP lifting W=VV* and scenario-with-certificates sampling to solve a convex program; implemented with YALMIP and Mosek.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the New England 39-bus system with Monte Carlo testing over 10,000 samples and comparison against nominal OPF and a prior probabilistic AC-OPF method.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method greatly reduced infeasible samples and line-flow violations versus nominal OPF, while using far fewer scenario samples than the compared parameterized approach.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Can incorporate N-1 security constraints and outage probabilities within the same scenario framework.

data_properties.hasModelName: Distributed System Level Control MTDC Grids
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Distributed OPF Algorithm for System-Level Control of Active Multi-Terminal DC Distribution Grids
data_properties.hasAuthor: Asimenia Korompili; Petros Pandis; Antonello Monti
data_properties.hasInstitution: Institute for Automation of Complex Power Systems, E.ON Energy Research Center, RWTH Aachen University, Aachen, Germany
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Distributed OPF-based system-level control of MTDC distribution grids with DER coordination.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Need fast, scalable, modular, privacy-preserving control for MTDC grids with high DER integration and changing operating conditions.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Distributed solution of a nodal OPF-for-ANM problem for MTDC grids using ADMM and sequential convex approximation.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a distributed OPF algorithm coordinate diverse DER and provide nodal voltage set-points fast enough for system-level control in MTDC grids?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal nodal voltage set-points and DER power dispatch set-points; in simulations, nodal voltages and conventional DER power outputs are reported.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Distributed, modular nodal formulation with ADMM coordination and local convexified subproblems.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Nodal DC power-flow formulation with current, power-flow, and voltage variables; nonlinear power equations linearized by first-order Taylor approximation.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Repeated at each control period.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period, receding control-period optimization.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses measured available RES power and current ESS SoC; no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Multi-terminal DC distribution grids with DER, ESS, controllable loads, and interlinking converters.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: ADMM with sequential convex approximation and an added initialization step for time-varying DER parameters.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Evaluated for convergence speed, parallel computation time, communication time, scalability, and online cluster execution.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Controllable loads can curtail demand with quadratic curtailment costs and bounds.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize conventional DER operating costs plus ADMM consensus penalty terms; ANM schemes add RES priority terms, ESS virtual-cost terms, or load-curtailment cost terms.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Nodal current, line-current, nodal power balance, nonlinear power-flow equalities, and bounds on generation, line flows, voltages, ESS energy, ESS charge/discharge exclusivity, and load curtailment.
data_properties.usesParameter: Penalty parameter ρ; voltage and power tolerances εV and εP; RES availability p̄RES; ESS SoC EESS,Ti and thresholds; charging/discharging efficiencies nch, ndisch; nodal price prk; load-curtailment factors aCL, bCL, cCL; priority factors priorRES and priorESS.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Each DCU solves its local nodal subproblem, exchanges voltage copies with neighbors, updates consensus voltages and dual variables, and stops when voltage convergence and total power balance are satisfied.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on modified IEEE 14, 30, 57, and 118-node systems, including sequential and physically distributed HPC-cluster implementations.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The algorithm converges in a few hundred iterations, remains scalable across network sizes, and can dispatch diverse DER under different ANM schemes with acceptable voltage deviations from centralized solutions.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: distributed, modular, scalable, privacy-preserving, fast. Limitations: relies on linearized OPF, assumes normal communication operation, and communication time can dominate total execution time.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Suitable for system-level control of DER-dominated MTDC grids and adaptable to equivalent AC-grid OPF-for-ANM formulations.

data_properties.hasInstitution: Dogus University; Duzce University; Bandirma Onyedi Eylul University; Karadeniz Technical University
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Formulate and solve a single-objective OPF for hybrid AC/DC networks with VSC-MTDC links and renewable sources.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Need for cost-effective, secure AC/DC grid operation with renewable integration and limited prior OPF work on VSC-MTDC systems.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Single-objective OPF on a modified IEEE 30-bus hybrid AC/DC network with thermal generators, renewables, and VSC-MTDC links.
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal fuel cost, fuel cost with valve-point effect, fuel cost with emission-carbon tax, voltage deviation, and active power loss values; corresponding optimal dispatch and voltage profiles.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid AC/DC OPF with VSC-MTDC transmission lines and renewable energy sources.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance, DC power balance, line-flow loss terms, and VSC converter constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period steady-state optimization.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating point.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Reserve and penalty cost modeling for stochastic wind, solar PV/small-hydro, and wind-tidal generation.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Modified IEEE 30-bus AC/DC network with thermal generators, wind, solar PV, small-hydro, tidal, transformers, and VSC-MTDC grids.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: FDB-SFS metaheuristic with diffusion and FDB-based updating.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Compared across 30 runs; FDB-SFS showed best objective values and robust convergence.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: None reported.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize fuel cost; fuel cost with valve-point effect; fuel cost plus emission-carbon tax; voltage deviation; or active power loss, depending on the case.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC active/reactive power balance, DC power balance, generator active/reactive and voltage limits, load-bus voltage limits, line apparent-power limits, transformer tap limits, and VSC/DC voltage-power limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Thermal cost and emission coefficients; valve-point coefficients; renewable direct/reserve/penalty cost coefficients; Weibull, Lognormal, and Gumbel distribution parameters; generator, voltage, line, tap, and VSC bounds.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: FDB-SFS, SFS, AGDE, MPA, and ASO were run for 200 iterations and 30 trials on the modified IEEE 30-bus system using MATACDC power-flow analysis.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Simulation results were checked against constraint limits and compared statistically using Wilcoxon and Friedman tests.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: FDB-SFS achieved the best results in all five cases, including lowest fuel cost, voltage deviation, and active power loss.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: integrates VSC-MTDC and multiple renewables in one OPF. Limitation: single-objective, static formulation; future work suggests multiobjective and dynamic OPF.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Future work proposed multiobjective optimization and dynamic OPF with load uncertainties.

validated_output.group_summary: 本组中最契合的是需求响应与灵活负荷调度模型，其次是多时段安全约束调度和社区储能/光伏规划模型。它们都能覆盖分布式电网中用户侧资源参与调度的需求，但对“用户不愿共享完整用电数据”这一隐私约束，只有间接相关，缺少专门隐私保护机制。 / The strongest fit is the demand-response flexible-load scheduling model, followed by multi-step security-constrained dispatch and community storage/PV planning. data_properties.hasInstitution: ETH Zurich; Tsinghua University
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve multi-regional chance-constrained optimal power flow in a distributed, confidentiality-preserving way.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Regional ISOs in interconnected grids need coordinated CC-OPF but cannot disclose confidential generator, load, topology, and line data.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Centralized CC-OPF is unsuitable for multi-regional interconnected grids with confidential regional data.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can CC-OPF be solved exactly in a distributed manner while preserving each ISO’s confidential information?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal dispatchable generation schedules across regions; associated bus voltage and line-flow constraint satisfaction under chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Uses decoupled linearized power flow to express voltages and line flows as linear functions of injections.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Multi-period day-ahead dispatch over T time slots.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Time slots; case studies use 24 hourly periods.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Day-ahead, 24 time slots in experiments.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Chance constraints with wind-power uncertainty modeled by Gaussian mixture distributions.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Multi-regional interconnected grid with dispatchable generators, wind farms, loads, voltages, and line flows.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Transformation-based encryption plus accelerated average consensus and privacy-preserving average consensus.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported exact optimality relative to centralized benchmark and high accuracy across system sizes and load levels.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost: sum over regions and time of quadratic and linear dispatchable-generation costs.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Capacity bounds, ramp-rate limits, supply-demand chance constraint, and chance constraints on voltages or line flows converted to deterministic inequalities.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generation cost coefficients, generator capacity bounds, ramp-rate bounds, wind-power quantiles from GMMs, chance limits εb and αS, and DLPF mapping coefficients.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Convert chance constraints to deterministic form, encrypt regional variables and coefficients, compute coupled coefficients and aggregated constants via distributed consensus, solve transformed QP, then decrypt regional optimal dispatch.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on multiple IEEE and PEGASE test systems; proposed method matched centralized solutions with very small relative errors.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The method achieves distributed CC-OPF without revealing confidential data and without optimality loss relative to the benchmark.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: exact optimality, no parameter tuning, confidentiality preservation. Limitation: relies on linearized power flow and is not directly full AC OPF.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Applicable to AGC-aware CC-OPF with deterministic participation factors and extendable to joint-chance-constrained OPF.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Estimating Global Variables in Multi-agent Distributed OPF with Unreliable Communication
data_properties.hasAuthor: Masoud Bashari; Mikhak Samadi; Javad Zare; Ashkan Rahimi-Kian
data_properties.hasInstitution: IEMS Group Ltd.; University of Ottawa
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve distributed optimal power flow under unreliable communication by estimating exchanged global variables.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Communication link disruptions can prevent consensus exchange in distributed OPF and degrade convergence and feasibility.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Distributed OPF across multiple regions with lost or interrupted communication links between agents.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can predictive estimation of missing consensus messages preserve feasible D-OPF convergence when communication is interrupted?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Regional bus voltage magnitudes and phase angles, weighted-average global bus voltages, and convergence of D-OPF results across iterations.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Multi-agent distributed OPF with coordinator-agent consensus and predictive estimation of missing exchanged variables.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Region-based OPF coupled through tie-line voltage consensus and line power-flow equations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Iterative multi-region consensus over repeated ADMM iterations.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Handles unreliable communication by estimating missing consensus messages with a trained DFNN.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: IEEE 14-bus transmission network partitioned into three regions with PV units and a BESS.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Extended ADMM combined with a shallow feedforward neural-network estimator for missing messages.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Faster convergence to actual global variables and feasible D-OPF results under interrupted links.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost for each region/sub-network.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Regional OPF constraints are enforced through bus-voltage and tie-line coupling; line power flows are updated from estimated voltages and consensus variables.
data_properties.usesParameter: Bus voltage magnitudes and phase angles, tie-line voltages, line impedances, line currents, regional loads S_i,j^t, PV units, and BESS size.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: IEEE 14-bus case split into three areas; ADMM iterations compute regional OPF, estimate missing voltages with DFNN, average exchanged voltages, and update line flows.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Compared three scenarios: normal communication, lost bus-5 communication, and lost communication recovered by estimation; tested on IEEE 14-bus case.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: With DFNN-based estimation, interrupted-link cases converged closer to global voltages and faster than the unrecovered communication-loss case.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: improves distributed OPF feasibility and convergence under communication loss. Limitation: estimator still shows biased error and needs more training data.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: ANN/DFNN estimator trained on OPF data generated from 90%–100% loading scenarios.

data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a distributed OPF algorithm coordinate diverse DER and provide nodal voltage set-points fast enough for system-level control in MTDC grids?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal nodal voltage set-points and DER power dispatch set-points; in simulations, nodal voltages and conventional DER power outputs are reported.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Distributed, modular nodal formulation with ADMM coordination and local convexified subproblems.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Nodal DC power-flow formulation with current, power-flow, and voltage variables; nonlinear power equations linearized by first-order Taylor approximation.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Repeated at each control period.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period, receding control-period optimization.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses measured available RES power and current ESS SoC; no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Multi-terminal DC distribution grids with DER, ESS, controllable loads, and interlinking converters.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: ADMM with sequential convex approximation and an added initialization step for time-varying DER parameters.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Evaluated for convergence speed, parallel computation time, communication time, scalability, and online cluster execution.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Controllable loads can curtail demand with quadratic curtailment costs and bounds.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize conventional DER operating costs plus ADMM consensus penalty terms; ANM schemes add RES priority terms, ESS virtual-cost terms, or load-curtailment cost terms.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Nodal current, line-current, nodal power balance, nonlinear power-flow equalities, and bounds on generation, line flows, voltages, ESS energy, ESS charge/discharge exclusivity, and load curtailment.
data_properties.usesParameter: Penalty parameter ρ; voltage and power tolerances εV and εP; RES availability p̄RES; ESS SoC EESS,Ti and thresholds; charging/discharging efficiencies nch, ndisch; nodal price prk; load-curtailment factors aCL, bCL, cCL; priority factors priorRES and priorESS.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Each DCU solves its local nodal subproblem, exchanges voltage copies with neighbors, updates consensus voltages and dual variables, and stops when voltage convergence and total power balance are satisfied.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on modified IEEE 14, 30, 57, and 118-node systems, including sequential and physically distributed HPC-cluster implementations.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The algorithm converges in a few hundred iterations, remains scalable across network sizes, and can dispatch diverse DER under different ANM schemes with acceptable voltage deviations from centralized solutions.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: distributed, modular, scalable, privacy-preserving, fast. Limitations: relies on linearized OPF, assumes normal communication operation, and communication time can dominate total execution time.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Suitable for system-level control of DER-dominated MTDC grids and adaptable to equivalent AC-grid OPF-for-ANM formulations.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Online Optimization in Power Systems With High Penetration of Renewable Generation: Advances and Prospects
data_properties.hasAuthor: Zhaojian Wang; Wei Wei; John Zhen Fu Pang; Feng Liu; Bo Yang; Xinping Guan; Shengwei Mei
data_properties.hasInstitution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Tsinghua University; Institute of High Performance Computing (A*STAR), Singapore
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Review and compare online optimization techniques for power-system operation under high renewable penetration.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Increasing renewable variability and controllable loads make offline optimization less reliable for real-time power-system operation.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: How to classify and apply online optimization methods to dynamic control, single-period OPF/voltage regulation, and multi-period energy management problems.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Which online optimization paradigms are most suitable for different power-system time scales and operational settings?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Not applicable; this is a review paper rather than a solved OPF model.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Review of optimization-guided dynamic control, feedback optimization, Lyapunov optimization, and online convex optimization.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Discusses AC bus-injection and branch-flow models; linearized DC power flow and DistFlow approximations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Covers single-period and multi-period formulations, plus fast dynamic-control time scales.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Seconds to minutes for dynamic control; single-period and multi-period decision settings.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period and multi-period; some Lyapunov examples use finite or infinite horizons.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Addresses renewable variability and uncertainty through online decision-making without relying on forecasts or historical distributions.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Frequency control, voltage regulation, OPF, economic dispatch, energy storage scheduling, demand response, and power markets.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Compares feedback-based, primal-dual, ADMM, Newton-Raphson, Lyapunov, and OCO methods; discusses distributed and asynchronous variants.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Emphasizes fast response, tracking of time-varying conditions, and reduced computational burden.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Includes controllable loads, demand response, electric vehicles, and load-side frequency control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Examples include minimizing generation cost in OPF, regulation cost in frequency control, and long-term average cost in Lyapunov/OCO formulations.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Power-flow equations, voltage limits, generation and reactive-power bounds, power-balance constraints, line congestion, storage SoC and charging/discharging limits, ramping and other coupled constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generation cost coefficients ai, bi; voltage bounds vi; power injection bounds Pi, Qi; line parameters rij, xij, Bij; storage queue/SoC Qt; Lyapunov weight ρ; stepsize η; control gains.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: The paper reviews algorithmic frameworks and representative formulations; it does not present a single new solved OPF instance.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: No dedicated validation of a new OPF model; cites prior experimental and numerical studies in the reviewed literature.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: Online optimization is useful for volatile power systems because it can track changing conditions and avoid reliance on inaccurate forecasts.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: fast, measurement-driven, and suitable for time-varying systems. Limitations: problem-dependent, often lacks a unified theory, and some methods need communication or predictions.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper is a survey and taxonomy of online optimization methods in power systems.
data_properties.hasSourceFileName: Online Optimization in Power Systems With.pdf

data_properties.hasModelName: Scalable Security Constrained Multi Step OPF
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Scalable Solutions for Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow With Multiple Time Steps
data_properties.hasAuthor: Hussein Sharadga; Javad Mohammadi; Constance Crozier; Kyri Baker
data_properties.hasInstitution: Texas A&M International University; University of Texas at Austin; Georgia Institute of Technology; University of Colorado Boulder
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve large-scale security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps efficiently under strict time limits.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Large SCOPF instances contain millions of continuous/integer variables and nonlinear nonconvex constraints, making them difficult to solve within challenge time limits.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps, including AC power flow, contingencies, reserves, device switching, and ramping constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a decomposition-based hybrid solver scale multi-timestep SCOPF to very large grids while maintaining high-quality feasible solutions?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation and consumption dispatch, device switching status, bus voltage angles, AC power-flow feasible operating point, and reserve allocations.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Two-stage DC/AC decomposition with sequential optimization for large networks.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: DC module uses linearized/MILP approximations; AC module solves full nonlinear AC power-flow equations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Multiple time steps; sequential stage-wise optimization for large horizons.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Time-step based control horizon; exact interval length not specified.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Control horizon divided into stages for networks over 2000 buses.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Contingency constraints included; no stochastic or robust uncertainty model stated.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained AC OPF with reserves, ramping, device uptime/downtime, and switching constraints.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Problem reformulation, McCormick relaxation, slack variables, clique constraints, analytical derivatives, vectorization, and sequential bound updates.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for scalability and strict time limits on very large instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consumption devices represented with bid blocks and power consumption bounds.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus z over device powers, bus voltage angles, and switching variables.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints G enforce power-balance and AC/DC network equations; inequality constraints H cover voltage limits, real/reactive power limits, reserves, ramping, switching, contingency, and device operation constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Device power pjt, bus voltage angle θit, switching status ujt, shunt conductance gshjt, branch flow limits smaxj, reserve factors σscrn, ramp-up Pru, ramp-down Prd, and mismatch penalty pit.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: DC subproblem solved as MILP with Gurobi; AC subproblem solved as NLP with IPOPT; large cases use sequential stage-wise optimization and selective contingency inclusion.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on 300+ scenarios across 73 to 8316-bus networks from ARPA-E GO challenge datasets.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The approach achieved high scaled scores in most scenarios, with average scores around 0.983 on Scenario Set 3 and 0.9992 on Scenario Set 2, while meeting time limits.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: scalable, robust, high-quality solutions, full AC formulation. Limitation: solution quality varies by scenario and depends on available reserve abundance; large cases require sequential decomposition.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Applied to ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets and testing platform.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Sizing and Placement of Community Energy Storage Systems using Multi-Period Optimal Power Flow
data_properties.hasAuthor: Marcel Böhringer; Soham Choudhury; Sebastian Weck; Jutta Hanson
data_properties.hasInstitution: Technical University of Darmstadt, Department of Electrical Power Supply with Integration of Renewable Energy (E5), Darmstadt, Germany
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Size and place community energy storage and photovoltaic systems in a low-voltage district using multi-period optimal power flow.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Improve district self-sufficiency and reduce costs while respecting network constraints and PV/storage interactions.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Optimal sizing of CES and PV, and optimal CES placement in a residential low-voltage network under cost scenarios and self-sufficiency constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How do PV sizing, CES sizing, feed-in tariffs, and self-sufficiency requirements affect optimal storage placement and district economics?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal PV installation size, optimal CES capacity, CES placement node, time-resolved grid import and export, and network losses.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Multi-period OPF with sizing variables for PV and CES and placement analysis.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Low-voltage network OPF with real and reactive power outputs, voltages, phase angles, and network constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Time-coupled multi-period formulation with inter-temporal storage energy balance.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Planning horizon over T periods; case study uses a day-resolved time series.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Residential low-voltage CIGRÉ network with PV, community storage, grid import/export, and self-sufficiency constraints.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Dimensioning strategy and receding-horizon placement strategy.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Placement mode minimizes network losses; sizing mode is cost-optimized.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Household load profiles are included and self-sufficiency limits grid import from community demand.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total imported-energy cost minus export revenue over time, plus amortized CES capacity cost and PV investment cost.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: CES energy balance, state-of-charge bounds, charge/discharge power limits, PV generation limits from irradiation and efficiency, self-sufficiency lower bound on grid import, and standard OPF network constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Grid import/export prices, CES CAPEX/OPEX, PV CAPEX/OPEX, interest rate, operating life, charging/discharging efficiencies, PV efficiency, irradiation profiles, household load profiles, and self-sufficiency rate.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Implemented in MATLAB R2019b with MATPOWER 7.0; MP-OPF adapted with added variables and constraints for the LV-CIGRÉ test grid.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the CIGRÉ low-voltage residential subnetwork using synthetic load profiles, PV irradiation profiles, and three cost scenarios.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: High feed-in tariffs favor maximum PV and no CES; lower costs favor larger CES and smaller PV; optimal CES placement shifts with self-sufficiency level toward central low-impedance nodes.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Captures time-coupled storage and placement effects in LV grids, but omits seasonal variation, heat pumps, EVs, and alternative storage technologies.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Uses self-sufficiency rate to progressively exclude grid-supplied households from CES placement consideration.

requirement.requirement_name: Computational Speed / Online Tractability and Accuracy and Physical Feasibility
requirement.requirement_text: Real-world OPF needs to be completed within the time scale of market clearing, real-time dispatch, or voltage control. Approximate models and ML predictions are fast, but they may violate AC power flow and security constraints. Therefore, physical feasibility must be guaranteed.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文：该模型显式保留 AC 功率平衡、支路潮流/DistFlow 物理和电压/线路约束，并以 SOCP/MINLP 处理离散调压器控制，适合需要物理可行性的配电网 OPF。/ English: This model explicitly keeps AC power balance, branch-flow/DistFlow physics, and voltage/line limits, and uses SOCP/MINLP for discrete tap control, making it suitable for physically feasible distribution OPF.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文：主要面向径向配电网与有载调压器，适用边界偏向单场景稳态配电 OPF，不是面向广域实时调度的通用高速在线框架。/ English: It is mainly for radial distribution feeders with load tap changers, so its boundary is single-snapshot steady-state distribution OPF rather than a general high-speed online framework for broader real-time dispatch.
supporting_evidence: hasConstraintFunction: "ACPowerBalanceConstraint; BranchFlowDistFlowPhysicsConstraint; LineFlowAndCapacityConstraint; VoltageAngleOperatingBoundaryConstraint"
hasMathematicalProblemType: "SecondOrderConeProgrammingProblem | Second-Order Cone Programming Problem"
hasMotivation: "Rounding relaxed discrete controls can cause infeasible or suboptimal DOPF solutions; MINLP formulations are computationally difficult."

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文：该模型面向多时段灵活性市场清算与 TSO-DSO 协调，包含 SOC-ACOPF、AC 功率平衡、线路限额和储能/负荷约束，强调可行调度而非纯 ML 预测。/ English: This model targets multi-period flexibility market clearing and TSO-DSO coordination, with SOC-ACOPF, AC power balance, line limits, and storage/load constraints, emphasizing feasible dispatch rather than pure ML prediction.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文：虽然具备物理约束与多时段能力，但采用 SOC 松弛，严格 AC 可行性依赖松弛精度；且其重点是市场清算与协调，不是毫秒级实时控制。/ English: It has physical constraints and multi-period capability, but relies on SOC relaxation, so strict AC feasibility depends on relaxation tightness; its focus is market clearing and coordination, not millisecond-level real-time control.
supporting_evidence: hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: "SOC-ACOPF for distribution; DC-OPF for transmission; convex relaxation with auxiliary variables."
hasConstraintFunction: "ACPowerBalanceConstraint; BranchFlowDistFlowPhysicsConstraint; LineFlowAndCapacityConstraint; EnergyStorageOperationConstraint"
hasPrimaryPurpose: "Model flexibility market clearing and TSO-DSO coordination using a hybrid AC/DC optimal power flow formulation."

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文：该模型把动态安全约束编码进可解的 MILP，并明确包含 AC 功率平衡、线路限额、电压边界以及 N-1/稳定性约束，目标是保持可行性同时加速求解。/ English: This model encodes dynamic security constraints into a tractable MILP and explicitly includes AC power balance, line limits, voltage bounds, and N-1/stability constraints, aiming to preserve feasibility while accelerating solution time.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文：它依赖神经网络分类与保守裕度来保证可行，存在近似误差带来的最优性损失；更适合离线训练后的快速求解，而非直接替代所有实时 OPF 场景。/ English: It depends on neural-network classification and a conservative margin to ensure feasibility, so approximation error can reduce optimality; it is better suited to fast post-training solving than as a universal replacement for all real-time OPF cases.
supporting_evidence: hasConstraintFunction: "ACPowerBalanceConstraint; LineFlowAndCapacityConstraint; VoltageAngleOperatingBoundaryConstraint; ContingencyPostContingencyOperationConstraint; StabilityConstraint"
hasPrimaryOutput: "Cost-optimal generator dispatch satisfying N-1 security and small-signal stability"
hasFindingsSummary: "epsilon increased feasibility to 100% with small cost increase."

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文：该模型在 24 小时时域内联合 UC 与 OPF，并在 OPF 精化中显式检查 AC 功率流可行性、电压和线路约束，适合需要计划-可行性一体化的场景。/ English: This model jointly handles UC and OPF over a 24-hour horizon and explicitly checks AC power-flow feasibility, voltage, and line constraints during OPF refinement, fitting planning-plus-feasibility use cases.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文：它是日前调度模型，时间粒度为小时级，且可行性修正发生在检测到违约后；因此不适合要求极短时间内直接给出实时可行解的场景。/ English: It is a day-ahead scheduling model with hourly granularity, and feasibility correction happens after violations are detected; thus it is not ideal when an immediately feasible real-time solution is required.
supporting_evidence: hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: "AC power-flow equations with bus voltage, reactive power, and line capacity constraints."
hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: "SCIP-MINLP initial solve, Newton-Raphson feasibility check, then PSO refinement for violated hours."
hasFindingsSummary: "OPF refinement slightly increased cost while making the schedule technically feasible."

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文：该模型使用凸 DistFlow、SOC 松弛和 Matpower 可行性检查来处理含离散 OLTC/电容器的径向网络，强调在物理约束下求得可行的无功调度。/ English: This model uses convex DistFlow, SOC relaxation, and Matpower feasibility checks for radial networks with discrete OLTC/capacitor devices, emphasizing feasible reactive dispatch under physical constraints.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文：它主要针对风电场集电网与主电压控制，且部分结果依赖松弛与外逼近精度；因此对一般输电网实时 OPF 的覆盖有限。/ English: It is mainly for wind-farm collector grids and primary voltage control, and some results depend on relaxation/outer-approximation accuracy; coverage for general transmission real-time OPF is limited.
supporting_evidence: hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: "Convex DistFlow with π-line model, variable-ratio transformers, SOC relaxation, and convexified voltage-drop equations."
hasConstraintFunction: "BranchFlowDistFlowPhysicsConstraint; LineFlowAndCapacityConstraint; VoltageAngleOperatingBoundaryConstraint; RenewableDEROutputConstraint"
hasModelValidationSummary: "Relaxation accuracy tested ... and feasibility checked with Matpower PF"

selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 方法依赖分解式两阶段求解，且大规模场景下解质量会随储备充裕度和场景而变化；不是单一一步到位的统一实时求解器。 / It relies on a decomposed two-stage workflow, and solution quality varies with scenario and reserve abundance; it is not a single-shot unified real-time solver.

selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 保证是概率型而非逐样本硬保证；且精确性只对受限网络类别成立，遇到更一般网络时可行性与最优性可能下降。 / Guarantees are probabilistic rather than hard per-sample guarantees; exactness is only proven for a restricted network class, so feasibility and optimality may degrade on more general grids.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve sequential real-time security-constrained optimal power flow with fast dispatch decisions under inaccurate environmental parameters.
data_properties.hasMotivation: ACOPF is nonconvex, time-coupled by ramping limits, and difficult to solve quickly and safely when system parameters are inaccurate or contingencies are unexperienced.

data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning method produce safe real-time OPF dispatches efficiently without relying on accurate environmental models?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Safe generator active and reactive power dispatch commands; resulting bus voltage magnitudes and branch active/reactive power flows within limits.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning with a safety-layer projection model and inactive-constraint identification.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow formulation with nonlinear nodal injections, branch flows, voltage magnitudes, and ramping-coupled generator limits.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Sequential multi-step dispatch with future load forecasts and ramping-coupled time dependence.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Real-time operation over time slots; forecasting horizon T steps.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Infinite-horizon sequential decision process terminated by grid failure/non-convergence.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses reinforcement learning for inaccurate environments and updates safety-layer parameters from latest measurements.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained ACOPF with coordinated active and reactive power dispatch, voltage and branch-flow security limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Improved SAC with SAM, prioritized replay, adaptive entropy, hybrid safety layer, and inactive-constraint elimination.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Claims faster decision-making and reduced security violations with comparable economic performance.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Includes forecasted net load demand in the state; no explicit demand response control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize cumulative generation operating cost, with quadratic cost coefficients for each generator over time.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power-balance equations, branch active/reactive flow equations, generator active/reactive limits, branch flow limits, voltage magnitude limits, and ramping-coupled generator bounds; safety-layer projection also enforces linearized security constraints and power balance.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients; generator active/reactive bounds and ramping limits; bus voltages; line conductance/susceptance or resistance/reactance; branch flow limits; load demand and forecasted load; slack-bus limits; penalty coefficients; SAC temperature and learning rates.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Sequential decisions are produced by an improved soft actor-critic policy, then projected by a linear security layer initialized from linearized power-flow knowledge and updated with data; inactive constraints are removed analytically.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 30-bus and larger systems, including contingency and parameter-error scenarios, with comparisons against penalty, constrained-policy, and pure data-driven safety-layer baselines.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The method maintains voltages and branch flows within safe ranges, reduces violation times in early training and contingencies, and scales to larger systems with low decision time.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: safe real-time dispatch, better robustness to inaccurate models, and high computational efficiency. Limitation: safety layer uses linearized power-flow approximation and may need conservative limits to offset approximation error.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper also evaluates scalability on 9-, 30-, 57-, 118-, and 1187-bus systems.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Minimize generation cost in AC optimal power flow while satisfying network constraints under uncertain loads and renewable generation with probabilistic guarantees.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Classical OPF dispatch is rigid and can become inefficient or infeasible under renewable and load uncertainty, causing overloads and outages.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Robust and chance-constrained AC optimal power flow with uncertain loads and renewable generators.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can AC-OPF be solved efficiently under uncertainty while limiting the probability of violating generation and transmission constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal controllable generation dispatch, generator voltage magnitudes, deployment vector, and corresponding bus voltage and line-flow-feasible operating point.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Scenario-with-certificates formulation combined with convex SDP relaxation of AC power flow.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with voltage-magnitude and line-flow constraints via lifted matrix W.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period OPF repeated over hourly demand scenarios in experiments.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per solve; 24 hourly solves in simulation.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Probabilistic uncertainty in loads and renewable generation using scenario with certificates and chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes renewable generators, uncertain loads, generator participation factors, voltage limits, and transmission limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Convex relaxation plus randomized scenario-with-certificates sampling.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: A priori probabilistic guarantee on constraint-violation risk; exact for a restricted class of networks.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Uncertain loads are explicitly modeled and balanced through generator deployment factors.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost f(u); in the penalized variant, worst-case cost adds reactive-power and line-loss penalties.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power balance equalities; generator active/reactive limits; voltage magnitude bounds; line-voltage-difference or apparent-flow limits; deployment factors sum to one and remain nonnegative.
data_properties.usesParameter: Uncertain complex load and renewable deviations δ; deployment vector α; bus-voltage matrix W split into Wu and Wx; risk levels ε and β; line admittances ylm; voltage and power limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Uses SDP lifting W=VV* and scenario-with-certificates sampling to solve a convex program; implemented with YALMIP and Mosek.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the New England 39-bus system with Monte Carlo testing over 10,000 samples and comparison against nominal OPF and a prior probabilistic AC-OPF method.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method greatly reduced infeasible samples and line-flow violations versus nominal OPF, while using far fewer scenario samples than the compared parameterized approach.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Can incorporate N-1 security constraints and outage probabilities within the same scenario framework.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Optimal reactive dispatch in a wind farm to reduce collector-grid losses while providing primary voltage control.

data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single operating point; repeated over many operating conditions.

data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period OPF per operating condition.

data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Linear outer approximation of SOC constraints using Ben-Tal–Nemirovski BTN relaxation.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Compared with Matpower; accuracy assessed by relaxation error and PF feasibility; faster for some cases but slower at higher BTN degree.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize active power exchange at the PCC, representing collector-grid losses, plus a penalty on reactive mismatch with the PCC setpoint.

data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Relaxation accuracy tested on six extreme operating cases and feasibility checked with Matpower PF; results compared against exact Matpower-based OPF across many clustered timesteps.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The relaxed model is often accurate when no reactive mismatch is expected, can outperform Matpower on a significant fraction of cases, and may be faster for moderate BTN degree.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: handles OLTC, shunt elements, and discrete banks in a convex framework; can be made arbitrarily accurate by increasing BTN degree. Limitation: accuracy degrades when loss minimization conflicts with reactive-setpoint tracking.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper studies a radial 78 MW wind farm with 39 DFIG turbines, 21 OLTC taps, and 7 static-unit states.

data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation dispatch, demand response schedule, EV charging/discharging schedule, HVAC power consumption schedule, bus voltage profile, line power flows, load shedding, and renewable curtailment.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Multi-objective AC OPF coordinated with demand response, EV and HVAC aggregators, ESS, and renewable generation.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power flow with active/reactive balance, bus voltages, line flow limits, and transmission impedance equations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: 24-hour scheduling with hourly intervals.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Scenario-based renewable uncertainty and LSTM-based load forecasting; EV energy and travel distance modeled with normal distribution.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Smart grid transmission network with thermal units, wind, solar, ESS, EVs, HVACs, and load shedding.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Solved as MINLP in GAMS with CONOPT3; TOPSIS used to select the preferred DR step.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Evaluated on modified IEEE 24-bus and IEEE 118-bus systems; reports cost, peak reduction, voltage variation, and execution time.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Demand response for large flexible loads plus aggregated EV and HVAC loads with comfort and participation limits.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total cost including generation cost, load shedding cost, and wind/solar curtailment cost; minimize voltage deviation; maximize DR revenue, peak reduction, and user convenience.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Thermal unit active/reactive limits and ramping; load shedding bounds; ESS and EV charge/discharge and energy limits; wind/solar availability and curtailment; AC power balance and line flow limits; DR bounds and constant power-factor load shifting; HVAC temperature dynamics and comfort bounds.
data_properties.usesParameter: Fuel-cost coefficients bg,cg; VOLL, VOLW, VOLS; generator limits Pg/Qg and ramp rates; line susceptance b and impedance Zij; load baselines PL0, QL0; DR factor α; ESS/EV efficiencies and capacities; renewable availabilities wt, st; HVAC thermal coefficients k1–k4; temperature limits; LMP λ.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Formulated in GAMS as a mixed-integer nonlinear program and solved with CONOPT3; scenario results were weighted by probabilities and ranked with TOPSIS.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 24-bus and 118-bus systems using 12 renewable scenarios and DR steps from 0% to 25%.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: At 20% DR, the model achieved the best TOPSIS outcome, reducing total cost and peak demand while keeping voltages within limits.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: integrates AC OPF, DR, EV/HVAC aggregators, storage, and uncertainty. Limitation: aggregator placement was assumed, not optimized.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Uses both active and reactive demand response with user-convenience and comfort-aware flexible-load scheduling.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型直接面向实时安全约束 OPF，强调在时间尺度内快速给出调度，并显式保留 AC 功率平衡、电压与支路限额等物理约束，整体与需求高度一致。/ English: This model directly targets real-time security-constrained OPF, emphasizes fast dispatch within operational time scales, and explicitly retains AC power balance, voltage, and branch-limit physics, so it aligns very well with the requirement.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：主要限制是物理可行性依赖线性化安全层投影与保守裕度，因此属于“强可行性导向但带近似”的方案，在极端工况下可能需要更保守设置。/ English: The main limitation is that feasibility relies on a linearized safety-layer projection and conservative margins, so it is a feasibility-oriented approximate approach that may need tighter conservatism in extreme cases.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型明确针对快速求解的安全约束 OPF，并包含 AC 潮流与 N-1 安全约束，能够满足“快速且考虑安全约束”的核心方向。/ English: This model explicitly targets fast security-constrained OPF and includes AC power flow with N-1 security constraints, matching the core need for fast, security-aware operation.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它是静态单时刻方案，不覆盖多时段市场清算或实时调度的时间耦合；同时在部分工况下仍可能出现无功功率违约，因此不是严格的全场景硬可行保证。/ English: It is a static single-snapshot method, so it does not cover multi-period market-clearing or real-time temporal coupling; it may also leave some reactive-power violations in certain contingencies, so it is not a strict hard-feasibility guarantee for all cases.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型面向多时段安全约束 OPF，并强调在严格时间限制下求解大规模问题，同时保留完整 AC 模块，具备满足运行时限与物理约束的潜力。/ English: This model targets multi-step security-constrained OPF and emphasizes solving large-scale problems under strict time limits while retaining a full AC module, so it has the potential to meet operational timing and physics requirements.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它采用分解式两阶段流程，且解质量受场景与备用充裕度影响；因此更像可扩展的规划求解器，而不是单一统一的实时硬保证方案。/ English: It uses a decomposed two-stage workflow and solution quality depends on scenario and reserve abundance; thus it is more of a scalable planning solver than a single unified real-time hard-guarantee method.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型直接求解 ACOPF，并通过物理信息学习与可行性校准提升输出可行性，符合“快速且尽量保持物理一致”的方向。/ English: This model directly addresses ACOPF and improves output feasibility through physics-informed learning and feasibility calibration, fitting the direction of fast solving with physical consistency.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：其可行性提升并非对所有测试都稳定收敛，因此在要求每次都必须给出可行解的严格实时场景中仍存在失败风险。/ English: Its feasibility improvement does not converge reliably on every test case, so there remains failure risk in strict real-time settings where every output must be feasible.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型保留了 AC 功率平衡、DistFlow 物理以及电压/线路约束，并通过 SOCP/MINLP 处理离散控制，具备物理可行性导向。/ English: This model preserves AC power balance, DistFlow physics, and voltage/line constraints, and uses SOCP/MINLP for discrete control, so it is physics-feasibility oriented.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它主要面向径向配电网与有载调压器，适用范围偏向单场景稳态配电 OPF，不是面向广域实时调度的通用高速框架。/ English: It is mainly for radial distribution feeders with load tap changers, so its scope is single-snapshot steady-state distribution OPF rather than a general high-speed framework for broad real-time dispatch.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型直接针对 AC OPF 中的不确定性与约束违背风险，并给出可行运行点与概率保证，和“避免违反 AC 与安全约束”的目标一致。/ English: This model directly addresses uncertainty and constraint-violation risk in AC OPF, providing feasible operating points with probabilistic guarantees, which is consistent with the goal of avoiding AC and security violations.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：其保证是概率型而非逐样本硬保证，且精确性只对受限网络类别成立，因此在更一般电网中不能视为绝对可行保证。/ English: The guarantee is probabilistic rather than per-sample hard feasibility, and exactness is only established for a restricted network class, so it cannot be treated as an absolute feasibility guarantee on general grids.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型面向多时段灵活性市场清算与 TSO-DSO 协调，包含 SOC-ACOPF、AC 功率平衡、线路限额和储能/负荷约束，具备运行可行性与时序能力。/ English: This model targets multi-period flexibility market clearing and TSO-DSO coordination, with SOC-ACOPF, AC power balance, line limits, and storage/load constraints, so it has operational feasibility and temporal capability.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它依赖 SOC 松弛，因此严格 AC 可行性取决于松弛精度；同时重点是市场清算与协调，不是毫秒级实时控制。/ English: It relies on SOC relaxation, so strict AC feasibility depends on relaxation tightness; its focus is market clearing and coordination rather than millisecond-level real-time control.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型显式使用 AC 功率平衡与线路/电压/发电约束，并以物理信息学习加速 OPF 求解，适合对速度敏感的近似可行求解。/ English: This model explicitly uses AC power balance and line/voltage/generator constraints, and accelerates OPF solving with physics-informed learning, making it suitable for speed-sensitive approximate feasible solving.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它本质上是数据驱动近似模型，物理可行性依赖训练与重构流程，不能像显式优化器那样天然保证每次输出都满足全部约束。/ English: It is fundamentally a data-driven approximation, so physical feasibility depends on training and reconstruction and is not inherently guaranteed for every output like an explicit optimizer.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型把动态安全约束编码进可解的 MILP，并显式包含 AC 功率平衡、线路限额、电压边界以及 N-1/稳定性约束，符合“快速且保留安全约束”的方向。/ English: This model encodes dynamic security constraints into a tractable MILP and explicitly includes AC power balance, line limits, voltage bounds, and N-1/stability constraints, matching the direction of fast solving with preserved security constraints.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它依赖神经网络分类与保守裕度来保证可行，存在近似误差带来的最优性损失；更适合离线训练后的快速求解，而非所有实时场景的通用硬保证。/ English: It relies on neural-network classification and conservative margins to ensure feasibility, so approximation error can reduce optimality; it is better suited to fast post-training solving than as a universal hard-guarantee method for all real-time cases.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型明确面向实时 OPF，在每个调度间隔内快速输出满足约束的发电与电压设定，和市场清算/实时调度时间尺度高度相关。/ English: This model explicitly targets real-time OPF and quickly outputs constraint-aware generation and voltage setpoints within each interval, which is highly relevant to market-clearing or real-time dispatch timescales.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它是训练后的数据驱动策略，对未见工况的可行性与最优性可能受限，因此不是对所有运行点都能直接给出硬可行保证。/ English: It is a trained data-driven policy, so feasibility and optimality may be limited on unseen operating conditions, meaning it does not directly provide hard feasibility guarantees for all operating points.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型通过 SOCP 松弛与循环角约束处理 AC OPF，强调可扩展性与求解效率，并保留了电压、潮流和角度相关物理约束。/ English: This model handles AC OPF through SOCP relaxation with cyclic angle constraints, emphasizing scalability and solve efficiency while retaining voltage, flow, and angle-related physics.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它主要适用于稳态输电网与凸目标，不直接面向 ML 预测、实时安全调度或更复杂的动态安全约束，因此与用户强调的实时物理可行性需求只有部分重合。/ English: It is mainly suited to steady-state transmission networks with convex objectives, and it does not directly address ML prediction, real-time security dispatch, or more complex dynamic security constraints, so it only partially overlaps with the user’s emphasis on real-time physical feasibility.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型联合 UC 与 OPF，并在 OPF 精化中显式检查 AC 功率流、电压和线路约束，能够提供物理可行性导向的计划结果。/ English: This model combines UC and OPF and explicitly checks AC power flow, voltage, and line constraints during OPF refinement, so it provides physics-feasibility-oriented planning results.

checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它主要针对风电场集电网与主电压控制，且部分结果依赖松弛与外逼近精度，因此对一般输电网实时 OPF 的覆盖有限。/ English: It is mainly for wind-farm collector grids and primary voltage control, and some results depend on relaxation and outer-approximation accuracy, so its coverage for general transmission real-time OPF is limited.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型通过 SOCP 松弛与循环角约束处理 AC OPF，强调可扩展性与求解效率，并保留了电压、潮流和角度相关物理约束。/ English: This model handles AC OPF through SOCP relaxation with cyclic angle constraints, emphasizing scalability and solve efficiency while retaining voltage, flow, and angle-related physics.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它主要适用于稳态输电网与凸目标，不直接面向 ML 预测、实时安全调度或更复杂的动态安全约束，因此与用户强调的实时物理可行性需求只有部分重合。/ English: It is mainly suited to steady-state transmission networks with convex objectives, and it does not directly address ML prediction, real-time security dispatch, or more complex dynamic security constraints, so it only partially overlaps with the user’s emphasis on real-time physical feasibility.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型联合 UC 与 OPF，并在 OPF 精化中显式检查 AC 功率流、电压和线路约束，能够提供物理可行性导向的计划结果。/ English: This model combines UC and OPF and explicitly checks AC power flow, voltage, and line constraints during OPF refinement, so it provides physics-feasibility-oriented planning results.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它是日前小时级调度模型，且可行性修正发生在违约后，因此不适合要求极短时间内直接输出实时可行解的场景。/ English: It is a day-ahead hourly scheduling model, and feasibility correction happens after violations are detected, so it is not suitable for scenarios requiring an immediately feasible real-time solution.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型虽然面向实时频率约束调度，但采用的是 DC 潮流而非完整 AC 潮流，因此无法满足用户对“必须保证 AC 潮流与安全约束物理可行性”的核心要求。/ English: Although this model targets real-time frequency-constrained dispatch, it uses DC power flow rather than full AC power flow, so it cannot satisfy the user’s core requirement of guaranteeing AC power-flow and security-constraint feasibility.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：其重点是频率安全而不是 AC 可行性，因而与用户要求存在明确偏离。/ English: Its focus is frequency security rather than AC feasibility, so it clearly deviates from the user requirement.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型使用凸 DistFlow、SOC 松弛和可行性检查来处理径向网络中的离散控制，具备物理约束与可行调度导向。/ English: This model uses convex DistFlow, SOC relaxation, and feasibility checks to handle discrete control in radial networks, so it is oriented toward physics-constrained feasible dispatch.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它主要针对风电场集电网与主电压控制，且部分结果依赖松弛与外逼近精度，因此对一般输电网实时 OPF 的覆盖有限。/ English: It is mainly for wind-farm collector grids and primary voltage control, and some results depend on relaxation and outer-approximation accuracy, so its coverage for general transmission real-time OPF is limited.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文：该模型包含完整 AC OPF 约束、线路/电压限制和多类设备协同调度，能够在运行层面提供物理可行的优化结果。/ English: This model includes full AC OPF constraints, line/voltage limits, and coordinated scheduling across multiple devices, so it can provide physically feasible optimization results at the operational level.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文：它更偏向日内/日前计划型 MINLP，小时级分辨率和复杂设备耦合使其不如专门实时 OPF 模型直接满足市场清算或实时调度的速度要求。/ English: It is more of an intraday/day-ahead planning MINLP, and its hourly resolution plus complex device coupling make it less direct for strict market-clearing or real-time dispatch speed requirements.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文：该模型直接面向实时安全约束 OPF，强调在时间尺度内快速给出调度，并显式保留 AC 功率平衡、电压与支路限额等物理约束，整体与需求高度一致。/ English: This model directly targets real-time security-constrained OPF, emphasizes fast dispatch within operational time scales, and explicitly retains AC power balance, voltage, and branch-limit physics, so it aligns very well with the requirement.
consistency_passed.violation_or_gap: 中文：主要限制是物理可行性依赖线性化安全层投影与保守裕度，因此属于“强可行性导向但带近似”的方案，在极端工况下可能需要更保守设置。/ English: The main limitation is that feasibility relies on a linearized safety-layer projection and conservative margins, so it is a feasibility-oriented approximate approach that may need tighter conservatism in extreme cases.

consistency_passed.consistency_check: 中文：该模型明确针对快速求解的安全约束 OPF，并包含 AC 潮流与 N-1 安全约束，能够满足“快速且考虑安全约束”的核心方向。/ English: This model explicitly targets fast security-constrained OPF and includes AC power flow with N-1 security constraints, matching the core need for fast, security-aware operation.
