data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve sequential real-time security-constrained optimal power flow with fast dispatch decisions under inaccurate environmental parameters.
data_properties.hasMotivation: ACOPF is nonconvex, time-coupled by ramping limits, and difficult to solve quickly and safely when system parameters are inaccurate or contingencies are unexperienced.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Sequential security-constrained AC optimal power flow for real-time operation with generator active/reactive dispatch and network security limits.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning method produce safe real-time OPF dispatches efficiently without relying on accurate environmental models?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Safe generator active and reactive power dispatch commands; resulting bus voltage magnitudes and branch active/reactive power flows within limits.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning with a safety-layer projection model and inactive-constraint identification.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow formulation with nonlinear nodal injections, branch flows, voltage magnitudes, and ramping-coupled generator limits.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Sequential multi-step dispatch with future load forecasts and ramping-coupled time dependence.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Real-time operation over time slots; forecasting horizon T steps.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Infinite-horizon sequential decision process terminated by grid failure/non-convergence.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses reinforcement learning for inaccurate environments and updates safety-layer parameters from latest measurements.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained ACOPF with coordinated active and reactive power dispatch, voltage and branch-flow security limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Improved SAC with SAM, prioritized replay, adaptive entropy, hybrid safety layer, and inactive-constraint elimination.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Claims faster decision-making and reduced security violations with comparable economic performance.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Includes forecasted net load demand in the state; no explicit demand response control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize cumulative generation operating cost, with quadratic cost coefficients for each generator over time.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power-balance equations, branch active/reactive flow equations, generator active/reactive limits, branch flow limits, voltage magnitude limits, and ramping-coupled generator bounds; safety-layer projection also enforces linearized security constraints and power balance.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients; generator active/reactive bounds and ramping limits; bus voltages; line conductance/susceptance or resistance/reactance; branch flow limits; load demand and forecasted load; slack-bus limits; penalty coefficients; SAC temperature and learning rates.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Sequential decisions are produced by an improved soft actor-critic policy, then projected by a linear security layer initialized from linearized power-flow knowledge and updated with data; inactive constraints are removed analytically.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 30-bus and larger systems, including contingency and parameter-error scenarios, with comparisons against penalty, constrained-policy, and pure data-driven safety-layer baselines.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The method maintains voltages and branch flows within safe ranges, reduces violation times in early training and contingencies, and scales to larger systems with low decision time.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: safe real-time dispatch, better robustness to inaccurate models, and high computational efficiency. Limitation: safety layer uses linearized power-flow approximation and may need conservative limits to offset approximation error.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper also evaluates scalability on 9-, 30-, 57-, 118-, and 1187-bus systems.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Co-optimize energy dispatch and operating reserve allocation in AC power system operation.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Conventional reserve scheduling or simplified ED-based approaches neglect full AC network constraints and can cause infeasibility, voltage insecurity, congestion, and suboptimality.

data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Full AC branch flow equations with voltage magnitudes/angles, transformer tap ratios, phase shifting, and shunt modeling.

data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses predefined zonal reserve requirements; no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes producing and consuming devices, real/reactive reserves, zonal reserve zones, shunts, transformers, and branch overload penalties.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Accelerated primal-dual interior point method with symmetric Jacobian, Cholesky factorization, direct step-size update, and tailored initialization.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for faster and more stable solution of large-scale RCOPF instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consuming devices participate in energy and reserve provision.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus: device consumption benefit minus generation cost, imbalance penalties, branch overload penalties, reserve offer costs, zonal reserve shortfall penalties, and reactive reserve costs.

data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Solved by A-PDIPM using perturbed KKT conditions, symmetric Jacobian construction, pivoted Cholesky factorization, matrix reordering/scaling, direct feasibility-preserving step sizes, and problem-specific primal/dual initialization.

data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: RCOPF produced converged secure solutions and higher market surplus than simplified reserve allocation approaches; A-PDIPM reduced iterations and runtime, especially on large cases.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: accurate AC co-optimization with reserves and improved computational efficiency. Limitation: single-period formulation and some scenarios still allow reserve shortfalls when economically optimal.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Derived from DOE ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Encode dynamic security constraints into a tractable optimization model for AC optimal power flow.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Directly including dynamic security constraints makes AC-OPF intractable; the paper seeks a scalable alternative.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: AC optimal power flow with N-1 security and small-signal stability constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can neural networks encode the feasible space of dynamic security-constrained AC-OPF so it can be solved as a MILP?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Cost-optimal generator dispatch satisfying N-1 security and small-signal stability, with corresponding bus voltages and line flows.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Classification neural network encodes feasible operating points; exact mixed-integer reformulation with ReLU activations.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power flow balance for the intact system; contingency-wise AC constraints for N-1 security.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single operating point; no multi-period horizon.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single snapshot dispatch.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: None explicit; random cost-function test instances only.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: N-1 security and small-signal stability constraints on an IEEE 14-bus system.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Neural-network feasibility encoding, exact MILP reformulation, and iterative linearization of power losses.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported 99% test accuracy; feasibility improved to 100% with epsilon adjustment.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost of the intact system state.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Generator active/reactive limits, voltage magnitude limits, line-flow limits, AC power balance, preventive generator set-point equality across contingencies, eigenvalue-based small-signal stability damping ratio constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator active and reactive limits, voltage limits, line-flow limits, contingency set C, damping threshold gamma_min, neural-network weights and biases, ReLU bounds, epsilon conservativeness parameter, loss-linearization threshold rho.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Train a ReLU classification network on feasible/infeasible operating points, reformulate it exactly as MILP, and iteratively linearize AC losses to solve MILPs with Gurobi.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 14-bus system with 45,000 labeled samples; 99% test accuracy; compared against AC-OPF and N-1 security-constrained AC-OPF.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The approach obtained cost-optimal solutions satisfying both static and dynamic security constraints; epsilon increased feasibility to 100% with small cost increase.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: tractable MILP approximation and improved feasibility. Limitations: approximation error may cause optimality loss and separate networks are needed for different grids.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Uses a conservative feasibility margin epsilon to trade off feasibility and optimality.

evidence_package.why_matched: 中文说明：它用机器学习快速预测OPF关键变量，并显著缩短求解时间，同时保持约束可行性，符合你对实时嵌入式优化的速度要求。虽然不是频率约束OPF，但其“学习近似+物理方程修正”的路线可借鉴到频率安全约束建模。 / English explanation: It uses machine learning to rapidly predict key OPF variables and greatly reduces solve time while preserving feasibility, matching the real-time speed requirement. Although not frequency-constrained OPF, its learning-plus-physics correction route is relevant for fast security-constrained modeling.
evidence_package.main_risk_or_gap: 中文说明：它只处理静态SCOPF和开关电容安全约束，没有频率动态、RoCoF或频率nadir建模。 / English explanation: It only handles static SCOPF and switched-shunt security constraints, with no frequency dynamics, RoCoF, or frequency-nadir modeling.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Machine Learning-Aided Security Constrained Optimal Power Flow
data_properties.hasAuthor: Jubeyer Rahman; Cong Feng; Jie Zhang
data_properties.hasInstitution: The University of Texas at Dallas
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve security-constrained AC optimal power flow efficiently using a machine-learning-aided approach.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Full AC OPF is highly nonlinear and non-convex, making large-scale security-constrained solving computationally challenging.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Security-constrained AC optimal power flow with switched shunt security constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a machine-learning-aided method predict key OPF variables and avoid running a physics-based OPF solver while preserving feasibility?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Bus voltage magnitudes and voltage angles; derived current injections, complex/real power injections, generator dispatch settings, and branch power flows.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid machine-learning-aided OPF using multi-input multi-output random forest plus physics-based network equations.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with bus admittance matrix, current injection, apparent power, and nodal power balance.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period steady-state OPF.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Not specified; load samples from hourly ERCOT profile used for training/testing.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per case.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: No explicit uncertainty model; trained on sampled load cases.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained AC transmission OPF with generators, buses, branches, and switched shunts.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Multi-input multi-output random forest predicts voltages, then network equations recover remaining variables.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported zero constraint violation for the proposed method and much faster solution time than MATPOWER MIPS.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Load demand inputs Pd and Qd are used as predictors; no demand response model.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, with generator costs represented by individual piece-wise linear cost functions.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Voltage magnitude and angle bounds; generator active/reactive power bounds; switched shunt susceptance bounds; real and reactive nodal power balance equations; branch apparent power flow limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Bus voltage magnitudes vi and angles θi; generator outputs pg and qg; switched shunt susceptance bcs; real/reactive demands pd and qd; branch flow limit sf; bus admittance matrix Y; generator cost cg.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: RF is trained on converged MATPOWER solutions; case I predicts v and θ then computes injections and costs via network equations; case II predicts all OPF variables directly.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on a 500-bus GO competition network using 8,760 load samples; compared against MATPOWER MIPS and a pure ML baseline.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method closely matches MIPS voltage solutions, satisfies network constraints, and reduces total solution time from 2030.4 s to 35.26 s.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: fast and feasible OPF approximation without running a physics-based solver. Limitation: pure end-to-end ML still causes many equality-constraint violations.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Potentially useful for post-contingency analysis with many network topologies and load profiles.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型与需求高度一致，直接面向实时频率约束OPF，并把RoCoF与frequency nadir作为调度约束嵌入FCOPF；同时用DNN替代慢速频率计算，符合“更准确估计且保持计算速度”的核心要求。 / English explanation: This model is highly consistent with the requirement: it directly targets real-time frequency-constrained OPF, embeds RoCoF and frequency nadir as dispatch constraints in FCOPF, and uses a DNN to replace slow frequency calculations, matching the core need for better accuracy with fast computation.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要限制在于采用单时段DC-OPF框架，且频率预测依赖仿真训练与混合整数ReLU线性化，实时部署时可能带来求解复杂度与泛化覆盖方面的风险。 / English explanation: The main limitations are a single-period DC-OPF framework and frequency prediction based on simulation-trained data with mixed-integer ReLU linearization, which can introduce solve-complexity and generalization-coverage risks in real-time deployment.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型满足“实时安全约束OPF”和快速调度的方向，但其核心约束集中在电压、潮流、备用和N-1安全，没有直接建模RoCoF或frequency nadir，因此不符合用户对低惯量频率安全FCOPF的明确要求。 / English explanation: This model fits the direction of real-time security-constrained OPF and fast dispatch, but its core constraints focus on voltage, flows, reserve, and N-1 security, without directly modeling RoCoF or frequency nadir, so it does not meet the user's explicit low-inertia frequency-security FCOPF requirement.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：缺少频率动态安全指标的直接约束，且安全层主要围绕线性化电网约束展开，不能满足“将RoCoF和频率nadir嵌入FCOPF”的核心目标。 / English explanation: It lacks direct constraints for frequency dynamic security indicators, and the safety layer is mainly built around linearized network constraints, so it cannot satisfy the core goal of embedding RoCoF and frequency nadir into FCOPF.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该文献是在线优化综述，强调秒到分钟级响应和多类电力系统在线方法，具有框架参考价值，但它不是一个可直接求解的FCOPF模型，也没有给出可嵌入RoCoF与frequency nadir约束的具体数学形式。 / English explanation: This work is a survey on online optimization, emphasizing second-to-minute response and various online methods for power systems. It is useful as a framework reference, but it is not a directly solvable FCOPF model and does not provide a concrete mathematical formulation for embedding RoCoF and frequency-nadir constraints.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：缺少可执行的FCOPF建模与频率安全约束表达，无法直接满足用户对实时频率约束OPF模型的需求。 / English explanation: It lacks an executable FCOPF formulation and explicit frequency-security constraints, so it cannot directly satisfy the user's need for a real-time frequency-constrained OPF model.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型确实把备用约束并入AC OPF，并关注快速准确求解，但其目标是能量与备用协同优化，没有直接包含RoCoF、frequency nadir或动态频率响应，因此与用户要求的频率约束OPF核心不一致。 / English explanation: This model does incorporate reserve constraints into AC OPF and focuses on fast, accurate solving, but its objective is energy-reserve co-optimization and it does not directly include RoCoF, frequency nadir, or dynamic frequency response, so it is not aligned with the core frequency-constrained OPF requirement.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：备用约束只能间接支持频率安全，不能替代对RoCoF和频率nadir的显式建模与约束嵌入。 / English explanation: Reserve constraints can only indirectly support frequency security and cannot replace explicit modeling and constraint embedding of RoCoF and frequency nadir.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型在方法上与“用学习模型近似难算动态约束并保持可解性”相符，但它针对的是N-1安全和小信号稳定性，而不是RoCoF与frequency nadir，因此对低惯量频率安全FCOPF的直接适配不足。 / English explanation: Methodologically, this model matches the idea of approximating hard dynamic constraints with learning while keeping tractability, but it targets N-1 security and small-signal stability rather than RoCoF and frequency nadir, so it is not directly suitable for low-inertia frequency-secure FCOPF.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：缺少频率动态指标的专门建模，且问题场景偏向静态单点与稳定性约束，不能满足用户对实时频率安全约束的明确需求。 / English explanation: It lacks dedicated modeling of frequency dynamic indicators and is oriented toward static single-point stability constraints, so it does not meet the user's explicit real-time frequency-security requirement.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：该模型强调机器学习加速SCOPF并保持可行性，符合实时求解速度诉求，但它处理的是静态SCOPF和开关电容安全约束，没有频率动态、RoCoF或frequency nadir建模，因此不满足用户的核心频率约束要求。 / English explanation: This model emphasizes machine-learning acceleration for SCOPF while preserving feasibility, which matches the real-time speed goal, but it handles static SCOPF and switched-shunt security constraints without frequency dynamics, RoCoF, or frequency-nadir modeling, so it does not satisfy the user's core frequency-constrained requirement.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它可以作为快速OPF近似思路参考，但不能直接用于将RoCoF和frequency nadir嵌入FCOPF。 / English explanation: It can serve as a reference for fast OPF approximation, but it cannot be directly used to embed RoCoF and frequency nadir into FCOPF.

top_rows.Requirement text: I need a real-time frequency-constrained OPF model for low-inertia modern power systems. As renewable energy and power-electronic devices are increasingly integrated, system inertia decreases, and generator trips can more easily cause rapid frequency drops. Therefore, OPF should not only consider economic cost and conventional power flow constraints, but also include RoCoF and frequency nadir as frequency security indicators in dispatch decisions. However, accurate frequency response calculation requires complex differential-algebraic equations or EMT simulation, which is too slow to be directly embedded into real-time OPF. Traditional linearized RoCoF constraints or simplified governor models are also not accurate enough. Therefore, a model is needed that can estimate RoCoF and frequency nadir more accurately while maintaining computational speed, and embed them as constraints into FCOPF.

requirement.requirement_name: Fast preventive SCOPF for volatile renewables
requirement.requirement_text: I need a model that can quickly solve preventive security-constrained OPF (preventive SCOPF) for power systems with high renewable volatility and rapidly changing operating points. In real grid operation, the system must be both economic and satisfy N-1 contingency security constraints. However, SCOPF must consider both the base case and multiple contingency cases, so its problem size is much larger than ordinary OPF, and traditional analytical optimization methods may be too slow for online applications. Although supervised learning and reinforcement learning can accelerate OPF / SCOPF, they may suffer from insufficient constraint satisfaction, inaccurate gradient estimation, or inadequate handling of N-1 security constraints. Therefore, a hybrid model combining the classical SCOPF physical model with data-driven methods is needed, so that it can quickly provide near-optimal online dispatch results while strictly satisfying security constraints.

Therefore, a hybrid model combining the classical SCOPF physical model with data-driven methods is needed, so that it can quickly provide near-optimal online dispatch results while strictly satisfying security constraints.

data_properties.hasAuthor: Ziming Yan; Yan Xu
data_properties.hasInstitution: Nanyang Technological University, Singapore
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Fast solution of preventive security-constrained optimal power flow using a hybrid data-driven DRL method
data_properties.hasMotivation: Conventional SCOPF solvers are computationally burdensome for online applications under contingencies and volatile operating conditions
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Preventive security-constrained optimal power flow with N-1 contingency constraints
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid model-assisted DRL method solve SCOPF rapidly while satisfying security constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal base-case dispatch decisions, including generator active power setpoints and generator-bus voltage setpoints, with contingency-feasible bus voltages and branch flows
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid data-driven, model-assisted deep reinforcement learning with primal-dual DDPG and interior-point/KKT gradient derivation
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations for base case and contingencies; sparse Jacobians and Hessians
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single operating point with multiple contingency scenarios
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Base case plus all considered contingencies
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Monte Carlo load-scenario generation for training data; no explicit stochastic optimization
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security constraints on generator limits, bus voltage magnitudes, and transmission line flows
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Closed-form actor gradients from KKT conditions; sparse matrix formulation; interior-point updates
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Real-time online inference after offline training; high-quality feasible solutions
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, defined as the sum of quadratic generator cost functions over the base case
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints enforce AC power balance for base case and contingencies; inequality constraints enforce generator capacity, bus-voltage bounds, and transmission-line flow limits
data_properties.usesParameter: Bus voltage magnitudes and angles; generator active and reactive powers; base-case control variables vg and pg; contingency index k; contingency line outages; load states p and q; Lagrange multipliers; slack variables; learning rate
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Offline supervised initialization followed by DRL training using power-flow evaluations, KKT-based Newton steps, and sparse Jacobian/Hessian calculations; online stage outputs SCOPF controls directly
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on modified IEEE 57-bus, modified IEEE 300-bus, and ACTIVSg2000 systems with Monte Carlo load scenarios and critical contingencies
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method achieves near-benchmark operating cost, satisfies security constraints much better than supervised learning, and is orders of magnitude faster than IPOPT-based SCOPF
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: fast, constraint-aware, scalable to larger systems. Limitations: still slightly higher cost than IPOPT and some reactive-power violations may remain under contingencies
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Preventive SCOPF; model-assisted RL; contingency filtering used in experiments

data_properties.hasModelName: Real Time Sequential Security Constrained OPF
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Real-Time Sequential Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow: A Hybrid Knowledge-Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning Approach
data_properties.hasAuthor: Zhongkai Yi; Xue Wang; Cheng Yang; Chao Yang; Mengyang Niu; Wotao Yin
data_properties.hasInstitution: Alibaba DAMO Academy; Alibaba US; Tsinghua University; Harbin Institute of Technology
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve sequential real-time security-constrained optimal power flow with fast dispatch decisions under inaccurate environmental parameters.
data_properties.hasMotivation: ACOPF is nonconvex, time-coupled by ramping limits, and difficult to solve quickly and safely when system parameters are inaccurate or contingencies are unexperienced.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Sequential security-constrained AC optimal power flow for real-time operation with generator active/reactive dispatch and network security limits.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning method produce safe real-time OPF dispatches efficiently without relying on accurate environmental models?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Safe generator active and reactive power dispatch commands; resulting bus voltage magnitudes and branch active/reactive power flows within limits.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning with a safety-layer projection model and inactive-constraint identification.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow formulation with nonlinear nodal injections, branch flows, voltage magnitudes, and ramping-coupled generator limits.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Sequential multi-step dispatch with future load forecasts and ramping-coupled time dependence.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Real-time operation over time slots; forecasting horizon T steps.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Infinite-horizon sequential decision process terminated by grid failure/non-convergence.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses reinforcement learning for inaccurate environments and updates safety-layer parameters from latest measurements.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained ACOPF with coordinated active and reactive power dispatch, voltage and branch-flow security limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Improved SAC with SAM, prioritized replay, adaptive entropy, hybrid safety layer, and inactive-constraint elimination.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Claims faster decision-making and reduced security violations with comparable economic performance.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Includes forecasted net load demand in the state; no explicit demand response control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize cumulative generation operating cost, with quadratic cost coefficients for each generator over time.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power-balance equations, branch active/reactive flow equations, generator active/reactive limits, branch flow limits, voltage magnitude limits, and ramping-coupled generator bounds; safety-layer projection also enforces linearized security constraints and power balance.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients; generator active/reactive bounds and ramping limits; bus voltages; line conductance/susceptance or resistance/reactance; branch flow limits; load demand and forecasted load; slack-bus limits; penalty coefficients; SAC temperature and learning rates.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Sequential decisions are produced by an improved soft actor-critic policy, then projected by a linear security layer initialized from linearized power-flow knowledge and updated with data; inactive constraints are removed analytically.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 30-bus and larger systems, including contingency and parameter-error scenarios, with comparisons against penalty, constrained-policy, and pure data-driven safety-layer baselines.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The method maintains voltages and branch flows within safe ranges, reduces violation times in early training and contingencies, and scales to larger systems with low decision time.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: safe real-time dispatch, better robustness to inaccurate models, and high computational efficiency. Limitation: safety layer uses linearized power-flow approximation and may need conservative limits to offset approximation error.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper also evaluates scalability on 9-, 30-, 57-, 118-, and 1187-bus systems.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Machine Learning-Aided Security Constrained Optimal Power Flow
data_properties.hasAuthor: Jubeyer Rahman; Cong Feng; Jie Zhang
data_properties.hasInstitution: The University of Texas at Dallas
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve security-constrained AC optimal power flow efficiently using a machine-learning-aided approach.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Full AC OPF is highly nonlinear and non-convex, making large-scale security-constrained solving computationally challenging.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Security-constrained AC optimal power flow with switched shunt security constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a machine-learning-aided method predict key OPF variables and avoid running a physics-based OPF solver while preserving feasibility?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Bus voltage magnitudes and voltage angles; derived current injections, complex/real power injections, generator dispatch settings, and branch power flows.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid machine-learning-aided OPF using multi-input multi-output random forest plus physics-based network equations.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with bus admittance matrix, current injection, apparent power, and nodal power balance.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period steady-state OPF.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Not specified; load samples from hourly ERCOT profile used for training/testing.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per case.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: No explicit uncertainty model; trained on sampled load cases.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained AC transmission OPF with generators, buses, branches, and switched shunts.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Multi-input multi-output random forest predicts voltages, then network equations recover remaining variables.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported zero constraint violation for the proposed method and much faster solution time than MATPOWER MIPS.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Load demand inputs Pd and Qd are used as predictors; no demand response model.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, with generator costs represented by individual piece-wise linear cost functions.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Voltage magnitude and angle bounds; generator active/reactive power bounds; switched shunt susceptance bounds; real and reactive nodal power balance equations; branch apparent power flow limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Bus voltage magnitudes vi and angles θi; generator outputs pg and qg; switched shunt susceptance bcs; real/reactive demands pd and qd; branch flow limit sf; bus admittance matrix Y; generator cost cg.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: RF is trained on converged MATPOWER solutions; case I predicts v and θ then computes injections and costs via network equations; case II predicts all OPF variables directly.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on a 500-bus GO competition network using 8,760 load samples; compared against MATPOWER MIPS and a pure ML baseline.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method closely matches MIPS voltage solutions, satisfies network constraints, and reduces total solution time from 2030.4 s to 35.26 s.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: fast and feasible OPF approximation without running a physics-based solver. Limitation: pure end-to-end ML still causes many equality-constraint violations.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Potentially useful for post-contingency analysis with many network topologies and load profiles.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve large-scale security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps efficiently under strict time limits.

data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Contingency constraints included; no stochastic or robust uncertainty model stated.

data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Problem reformulation, McCormick relaxation, slack variables, clique constraints, analytical derivatives, vectorization, and sequential bound updates.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for scalability and strict time limits on very large instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consumption devices represented with bid blocks and power consumption bounds.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus z over device powers, bus voltage angles, and switching variables.

data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The approach achieved high scaled scores in most scenarios, with average scores around 0.983 on Scenario Set 3 and 0.9992 on Scenario Set 2, while meeting time limits.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: scalable, robust, high-quality solutions, full AC formulation. Limitation: solution quality varies by scenario and depends on available reserve abundance; large cases require sequential decomposition.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Applied to ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets and testing platform.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Online Optimization in Power Systems With High Penetration of Renewable Generation: Advances and Prospects
data_properties.hasAuthor: Zhaojian Wang; Wei Wei; John Zhen Fu Pang; Feng Liu; Bo Yang; Xinping Guan; Shengwei Mei
data_properties.hasInstitution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Tsinghua University; Institute of High Performance Computing (A*STAR), Singapore
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Review and compare online optimization techniques for power-system operation under high renewable penetration.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Increasing renewable variability and controllable loads make offline optimization less reliable for real-time power-system operation.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: How to classify and apply online optimization methods to dynamic control, single-period OPF/voltage regulation, and multi-period energy management problems.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Which online optimization paradigms are most suitable for different power-system time scales and operational settings?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Not applicable; this is a review paper rather than a solved OPF model.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Review of optimization-guided dynamic control, feedback optimization, Lyapunov optimization, and online convex optimization.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Discusses AC bus-injection and branch-flow models; linearized DC power flow and DistFlow approximations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Covers single-period and multi-period formulations, plus fast dynamic-control time scales.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Seconds to minutes for dynamic control; single-period and multi-period decision settings.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period and multi-period; some Lyapunov examples use finite or infinite horizons.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Addresses renewable variability and uncertainty through online decision-making without relying on forecasts or historical distributions.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Frequency control, voltage regulation, OPF, economic dispatch, energy storage scheduling, demand response, and power markets.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Compares feedback-based, primal-dual, ADMM, Newton-Raphson, Lyapunov, and OCO methods; discusses distributed and asynchronous variants.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Emphasizes fast response, tracking of time-varying conditions, and reduced computational burden.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Includes controllable loads, demand response, electric vehicles, and load-side frequency control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Examples include minimizing generation cost in OPF, regulation cost in frequency control, and long-term average cost in Lyapunov/OCO formulations.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Power-flow equations, voltage limits, generation and reactive-power bounds, power-balance constraints, line congestion, storage SoC and charging/discharging limits, ramping and other coupled constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generation cost coefficients ai, bi; voltage bounds vi; power injection bounds Pi, Qi; line parameters rij, xij, Bij; storage queue/SoC Qt; Lyapunov weight ρ; stepsize η; control gains.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: The paper reviews algorithmic frameworks and representative formulations; it does not present a single new solved OPF instance.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: No dedicated validation of a new OPF model; cites prior experimental and numerical studies in the reviewed literature.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: Online optimization is useful for volatile power systems because it can track changing conditions and avoid reliance on inaccurate forecasts.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: fast, measurement-driven, and suitable for time-varying systems. Limitations: problem-dependent, often lacks a unified theory, and some methods need communication or predictions.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper is a survey and taxonomy of online optimization methods in power systems.
data_properties.hasSourceFileName: Online Optimization in Power Systems With.pdf

evidence_package.why_matched: 支持可再生波动下的快速实时/日前调度，并通过参与因子减少每个时间段的优化负担，适合高波动运行点快速更新 / Supports fast real-time and day-ahead dispatch under renewable variability, using participation factors to reduce per-interval optimization burden, which helps with rapidly changing operating points.
evidence_package.main_risk_or_gap: 主要是 DA/RT-OPF 而非 preventive SCOPF；没有明确的 N-1 事故约束或多事故安全校核，因此对严格安全约束场景覆盖不足 / It is DA/RT-OPF rather than preventive SCOPF; it does not explicitly include N-1 contingency constraints or multi-contingency security checks, so coverage for strict security-constrained operation is limited.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Day-Ahead and Real Time Optimal Power Flow considering Renewable Energy Resources
data_properties.hasAuthor: S. Surender Reddy; P.R. Bijwe
data_properties.hasInstitution: Woosong University; Indian Institute of Technology Delhi
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: To schedule generation economically while maintaining security in day-ahead and real-time OPF with renewable variability.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Conventional DA-OPF and RT-OPF use static snapshots and ignore renewable/load variability within scheduling intervals.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Optimal power flow for thermal-wind-solar systems with renewable variability, voltage, reactive power, line-flow, and ramp constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can participation factors evaluated once at the start of each interval capture intra-interval renewable variability without increasing optimization dimensionality?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generator dispatch schedules, renewable generation schedules, interval costs/profits, and voltage stability index values.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Single optimization with 'best-fit' participation factors over sub-interval variability.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with voltage magnitude/angle, reactive power, and line-flow constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Day-ahead and real-time multi-interval scheduling with 15-min and 1-min sub-intervals.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: RT-OPF: 1 min sub-intervals within 10-min intervals; DA-OPF: 15 min sub-sub-intervals within 1 h intervals.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: RT-OPF over 60 min; DA-OPF over 24 h.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses forecasted solar, wind, and load variability within intervals; no explicit stochastic or robust formulation.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Thermal generators with wind and solar PV injections, AGC participation factors, ramp limits, and voltage stability index.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Evaluates 'best-fit' participation factors once to avoid separate optimization for every sub-interval.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported lower total cost and improved voltage stability versus conventional interval-by-interval OPF.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Forecasted load demand varies within sub-intervals and is included in imbalance calculations.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost over RT sub-intervals; maximize total profit over DA intervals as revenue minus generation cost.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Active and reactive nodal power balance, generator output limits with ramp-up/down limits, renewable output caps, bus-voltage limits, line-flow limits, and demand-supply balance constraint in DA-OPF.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients; energy price; wind and solar direct cost coefficients; bus admittance Gij/Bij; ramp limits; voltage and line-flow limits; forecasted load, wind, and solar outputs; participation factors.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: MATLAB Optimization Toolbox FMINCON was used on the IEEE 30-bus system with wind at bus 11 and solar PV at bus 13.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Compared conventional and proposed RT-OPF/DA-OPF on IEEE 30-bus test system using 60-min RT and 24-h DA schedules.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed approach reduced RT total cost and increased DA profit while keeping optimization size unchanged and improving voltage stability.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: captures intra-interval variability with little added computational burden. Limitation: relies on forecast availability and fixed participation factors within each interval.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Voltage stability was assessed using the L-index/VSEI.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与用户需求高度一致，明确是预防式 SCOPF，包含 N-1 事故约束，并面向快速在线求解；同时采用经典电网物理模型与数据驱动强化学习的混合方案，符合“混合模型”方向。 / English explanation: Highly consistent with the user need: it is explicitly preventive SCOPF, includes N-1 contingency constraints, targets fast online solving, and uses a hybrid classical power-system model plus data-driven reinforcement learning, matching the requested hybrid direction.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要缺口是它仍属于近似学习型求解器，极端工况下可能出现少量无功约束违背，因此对“严格满足安全约束”的保证不如显式优化求解那样强。 / English explanation: Main gap: it remains an approximate learning-based solver, and small reactive-power violations may occur under extreme conditions, so the guarantee of strict security feasibility is weaker than an explicit optimizer.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：总体符合用户对快速、在线、带安全约束的 OPF/SCOPF 的需求，并且明确采用混合知识-数据驱动方法与安全层投影，适合高波动和快速变化工况。 / English explanation: Overall consistent with the need for fast, online, security-constrained OPF/SCOPF, and it explicitly uses a hybrid knowledge-data-driven method with a safety-layer projection, which suits volatile and rapidly changing operating points.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：它更偏向序列式实时调度而非单次预防式 SCOPF；安全层依赖线性化近似，在强非线性或极端工况下可能需要更保守的设置。 / English explanation: It is more of a sequential real-time dispatcher than a single-shot preventive SCOPF; the safety layer relies on linearized approximations and may require conservative settings under strong nonlinearity or extreme operating points.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：它确实是安全约束 AC OPF 的混合机器学习方法，并强调可行性与快速求解，因此与“快速在线调度”有一定一致性。 / English explanation: It is indeed a hybrid machine-learning method for security-constrained AC OPF and emphasizes feasibility and fast solving, so it aligns to some extent with fast online dispatch.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要不足是它更偏静态单时段问题，且重点安全约束是 switched shunt；对高可再生波动、快速变化运行点以及显式 N-1 多事故预防式 SCOPF 的覆盖不够直接。 / English explanation: Main limitation: it is more of a static single-period problem, with security focused on switched shunt constraints; coverage of high renewable volatility, rapidly changing operating points, and explicit N-1 multi-contingency preventive SCOPF is not direct enough.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：它满足安全约束、AC 电网约束、事故约束和快速求解的方向，并且适合高波动下的多时间步在线/准在线调度。 / English explanation: It matches the direction of security constraints, AC network constraints, contingency constraints, and fast solving, and it is suitable for multi-step online or near-online dispatch under volatility.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：但它核心是多时间步分解式求解，更偏工程化的大规模调度框架，而不是用户所强调的单次预防式 SCOPF 的统一混合模型；同时目标函数也不是典型的纯成本最小化表述。 / English explanation: However, its core is a decomposition-based multi-step solver, more of an engineered large-scale dispatch framework than the unified hybrid preventive SCOPF model the user emphasized; its objective is also not the typical pure cost-minimization formulation.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：它明确包含 N-1 安全约束，并把安全可行域编码为可解 MILP，说明在严格安全约束方面具有较强一致性。 / English explanation: It explicitly includes N-1 security constraints and encodes the feasible region into a solvable MILP, showing strong consistency with strict security requirements.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：但它更偏动态安全约束编码与离线可行域建模，主要在小规模系统和小信号稳定约束上验证；对高可再生波动下的快速在线重算与大规模泛化不够贴合。 / English explanation: But it is more of an offline feasibility-encoding framework for dynamic security constraints, validated mainly on a small system with small-signal stability constraints; it is less aligned with fast online re-solving under high renewable volatility and large-scale generalization.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：它与安全约束 OPF 和事故鲁棒求解相关，且明确考虑 N-k 安全场景，因此在“安全性”和“学习型加速”方面有一定相关性。 / English explanation: It is related to security-constrained OPF and contingency-robust solving, and it explicitly considers N-k security scenarios, so it has some relevance to security and learning-based acceleration.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：但它更偏鲁棒学习框架，未清晰体现用户要求的“经典 SCOPF 物理模型 + 数据驱动方法”的混合在线预防式 N-1 调度机制，也不够聚焦快速可行的在线输出。 / English explanation: However, it is more of a robust learning framework and does not clearly realize the user’s requested hybrid of classical SCOPF physics plus data-driven methods for preventive N-1 online dispatch, nor does it focus enough on fast feasible online outputs.

requirement.requirement_text: I need a large-scale AC-OPF convex optimization model suitable for meshed transmission networks. Traditional AC-OPF is non-convex and computationally difficult, making it hard to guarantee global optimality in large-scale systems. Linear approximations such as DC-OPF are fast, but sacrifice accuracy. SOCP-OPF, as a convex relaxation method, has good computational efficiency. However, in meshed transmission networks, traditional SOCP models may fail to correctly recover voltage angles, because voltage angle differences around a closed loop must satisfy cyclic constraints, meaning that the sum of angle differences around a closed loop should be zero. Existing solutions are either computationally expensive or not suitable for large-scale meshed systems. Therefore, an OPF model is needed that can directly consider cyclic angle constraints within the SOCP framework, so that it can maintain SOCP scalability and computational efficiency while improving angle recovery accuracy and the physical consistency of power flow solutions in meshed transmission networks.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: A Second-Order Cone Programming (SOCP) Based Optimal Power Flow (OPF) Model With Cyclic Constraints for Power Transmission Systems

data_properties.hasInstitution: The University of North Carolina at Charlotte; Florida International University
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve AC optimal power flow for meshed transmission networks with cyclic angle constraints using an SOCP relaxation.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Existing SOCP-OPF models can violate cyclic angle constraints in meshed networks, reducing exactness.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: AC optimal power flow in meshed power transmission systems with cyclic angle recovery constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a convex SOCP-OPF formulation enforce cyclic angle constraints in meshed transmission networks while remaining scalable and exact?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generator dispatch, bus voltage magnitudes and angles, branch power flows, and current flows.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Branch-flow SOCP relaxation with convex envelope for angle differences and graph-theory-based mesh cycle extraction.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Branch flow model with relaxed voltage/current phases, quadratic equality converted to second-order cone inequality.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period steady-state OPF.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: One operating snapshot.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: None.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Meshed transmission networks; dangling radial branches handled separately.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Convex envelope for angle recovery plus pre-extracted mesh-cycle information as a model parameter.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Computationally efficient and scalable; lower convergence time than NLP and SDP on large networks.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Fixed loads at buses; no demand response or flexible demand modeled.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize network power losses or minimize quadratic real generation cost; the model allows a convex objective f(x).
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Power balance equations, branch-flow voltage relation, conic relaxation, cyclic angle constraints, generator limits, voltage limits, and current-flow limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Branch resistance/reactance, admittance matrix elements, generator cost coefficients, bus voltage limits, current limits, and mesh-cycle information.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Implemented in MATLAB with MOSEK; tested on IEEE 14-, 57-, 118-, 500-, and 2736-bus systems and compared with MATPOWER NLP and SDP solutions.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Results matched benchmark OPF solutions closely; solution gaps and voltage deviations were very small, and cyclic constraints were satisfied.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed SOCP-OPF is tight for meshed networks when cyclic constraints are imposed, yields globally optimal solutions for convex objectives, and improves convergence time.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: exact cyclic-angle handling, scalability, and efficiency. Limitation: formulated only for convex objectives and steady-state transmission OPF.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Future work extends the model to mixed-integer OPF and contingency analysis for unbalanced networks.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Minimize generation cost in AC optimal power flow while satisfying network constraints under uncertain loads and renewable generation with probabilistic guarantees.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Classical OPF dispatch is rigid and can become inefficient or infeasible under renewable and load uncertainty, causing overloads and outages.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Robust and chance-constrained AC optimal power flow with uncertain loads and renewable generators.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can AC-OPF be solved efficiently under uncertainty while limiting the probability of violating generation and transmission constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal controllable generation dispatch, generator voltage magnitudes, deployment vector, and corresponding bus voltage and line-flow-feasible operating point.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Scenario-with-certificates formulation combined with convex SDP relaxation of AC power flow.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with voltage-magnitude and line-flow constraints via lifted matrix W.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period OPF repeated over hourly demand scenarios in experiments.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per solve; 24 hourly solves in simulation.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Probabilistic uncertainty in loads and renewable generation using scenario with certificates and chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes renewable generators, uncertain loads, generator participation factors, voltage limits, and transmission limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Convex relaxation plus randomized scenario-with-certificates sampling.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: A priori probabilistic guarantee on constraint-violation risk; exact for a restricted class of networks.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Uncertain loads are explicitly modeled and balanced through generator deployment factors.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost f(u); in the penalized variant, worst-case cost adds reactive-power and line-loss penalties.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power balance equalities; generator active/reactive limits; voltage magnitude bounds; line-voltage-difference or apparent-flow limits; deployment factors sum to one and remain nonnegative.
data_properties.usesParameter: Uncertain complex load and renewable deviations δ; deployment vector α; bus-voltage matrix W split into Wu and Wx; risk levels ε and β; line admittances ylm; voltage and power limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Uses SDP lifting W=VV* and scenario-with-certificates sampling to solve a convex program; implemented with YALMIP and Mosek.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the New England 39-bus system with Monte Carlo testing over 10,000 samples and comparison against nominal OPF and a prior probabilistic AC-OPF method.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method greatly reduced infeasible samples and line-flow violations versus nominal OPF, while using far fewer scenario samples than the compared parameterized approach.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Can incorporate N-1 security constraints and outage probabilities within the same scenario framework.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Predicting AC Optimal Power Flows: Combining Deep Learning and Lagrangian Dual Methods
data_properties.hasAuthor: Ferdinando Fioretto; Terrence W.K. Mak; Pascal Van Hentenryck
data_properties.hasInstitution: Georgia Institute of Technology; Syracuse University
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Predict AC optimal power flow setpoints from load conditions using deep learning.
data_properties.hasMotivation: AC-OPF is nonlinear, nonconvex, and repeatedly solved under changing conditions; faster accurate approximations are needed.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Predict generator dispatch and bus voltage magnitudes for AC-OPF while respecting physical and engineering constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can deep learning approximate AC optimal power flow solutions accurately and feasibly by exploiting OPF structure and Lagrangian duality?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Predicted generator active power setpoints and bus voltage magnitudes; in the extended model also voltage angles and reactive generation, with derived load flows.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Deep neural network with constraint-violation penalties, hot-start inputs, and Lagrangian dual multiplier updates.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power flow equations with Ohm’s law, line flow limits, and Kirchhoff current balance.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period, repeated operational snapshots; hot-start from a related prior state.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses hot-start states and evaluates on load variations; no explicit stochastic optimization.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Transmission-network AC-OPF on IEEE and NESTA benchmark systems.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Violation-based Lagrangian relaxation with subgradient updates and hot-start weight reuse.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported high prediction accuracy and large runtime speedups over AC-OPF and DC approximation.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Inputs are active and reactive load demands; no explicit demand response or flexible load modeling.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize squared prediction error for voltage magnitude, voltage angle, active generation, and reactive generation, plus weighted constraint-violation penalties.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Voltage magnitude bounds, angle-difference bounds, generator active/reactive limits, line apparent-power limits, AC power-flow equations, and nodal active/reactive power balance.
data_properties.usesParameter: Load demands pd, qd; hot-start state pd0, qd0, pg0, qg0, v0, θ0; admittance entries gij, bij; bounds on v, θ, pg, qg, and line limits Sfmax; Lagrangian multipliers λc.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Trained feed-forward ReLU subnetworks for v, θ, pg, qg using SGD/Adam and subgradient updates of Lagrangian multipliers.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on NESTA IEEE 14, 30, 39, 57, 73, 89, 118, 162, 189, and 300-bus cases with 80/20 splits.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: Constraint-aware and hot-start models improved prediction accuracy; the full Lagrangian-dual model was most accurate and fastest.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: very accurate and much faster than AC-OPF/DC-OPF. Limitation: relies on similar historical/hot-start states and benchmark-sized training data.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper also evaluates load-flow feasibility restoration and dispatch-cost closeness to AC-OPF solutions.

data_properties.hasModelName: Hybrid AC DC Network VSC MTDC Renewables
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Optimal Power Flow for Hybrid AC/DC Electrical Networks Configured With VSC-MTDC Transmission Lines and Renewable Energy Sources
data_properties.hasAuthor: Hüseyin Bakır; Ugur Guvenc; Serhat Duman; Hamdi Tolga Kahraman
data_properties.hasInstitution: Dogus University; Duzce University; Bandirma Onyedi Eylul University; Karadeniz Technical University
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Formulate and solve a single-objective OPF for hybrid AC/DC networks with VSC-MTDC links and renewable sources.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Need for cost-effective, secure AC/DC grid operation with renewable integration and limited prior OPF work on VSC-MTDC systems.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Single-objective OPF on a modified IEEE 30-bus hybrid AC/DC network with thermal generators, renewables, and VSC-MTDC links.
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal fuel cost, fuel cost with valve-point effect, fuel cost with emission-carbon tax, voltage deviation, and active power loss values; corresponding optimal dispatch and voltage profiles.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid AC/DC OPF with VSC-MTDC transmission lines and renewable energy sources.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance, DC power balance, line-flow loss terms, and VSC converter constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period steady-state optimization.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating point.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Reserve and penalty cost modeling for stochastic wind, solar PV/small-hydro, and wind-tidal generation.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Modified IEEE 30-bus AC/DC network with thermal generators, wind, solar PV, small-hydro, tidal, transformers, and VSC-MTDC grids.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: FDB-SFS metaheuristic with diffusion and FDB-based updating.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Compared across 30 runs; FDB-SFS showed best objective values and robust convergence.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: None reported.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize fuel cost; fuel cost with valve-point effect; fuel cost plus emission-carbon tax; voltage deviation; or active power loss, depending on the case.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC active/reactive power balance, DC power balance, generator active/reactive and voltage limits, load-bus voltage limits, line apparent-power limits, transformer tap limits, and VSC/DC voltage-power limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Thermal cost and emission coefficients; valve-point coefficients; renewable direct/reserve/penalty cost coefficients; Weibull, Lognormal, and Gumbel distribution parameters; generator, voltage, line, tap, and VSC bounds.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: FDB-SFS, SFS, AGDE, MPA, and ASO were run for 200 iterations and 30 trials on the modified IEEE 30-bus system using MATACDC power-flow analysis.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Simulation results were checked against constraint limits and compared statistically using Wilcoxon and Friedman tests.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: FDB-SFS achieved the best results in all five cases, including lowest fuel cost, voltage deviation, and active power loss.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: integrates VSC-MTDC and multiple renewables in one OPF. Limitation: single-objective, static formulation; future work suggests multiobjective and dynamic OPF.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Future work proposed multiobjective optimization and dynamic OPF with load uncertainties.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与用户需求高度一致，直接面向网状输电网的 AC-OPF，并在 SOCP 框架内显式加入循环相角约束，兼顾可扩展性与角度恢复精度。 / English explanation: Highly consistent with the user need; it directly targets meshed transmission AC-OPF and explicitly incorporates cyclic angle constraints within an SOCP framework, preserving scalability while improving angle recovery accuracy.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要适用于单时段稳态输电 OPF，若用户后续需要多时段、随机性或更复杂附加约束，则适用范围会收窄。 / English explanation: It is mainly a single-period steady-state transmission OPF; applicability narrows if multi-period, stochastic, or additional complex constraints are required.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：它属于 AC-OPF 的凸化方法并关注不确定性下的可行性，但核心是 SDP 松弛而非 SOCP，且没有直接把网状网络的闭环相角循环约束作为模型重点，因此与用户要求的 SOCP 内显式 cyclic angle constraints 不匹配。 / English explanation: It is a convexified AC-OPF method focused on feasibility under uncertainty, but its core is SDP relaxation rather than SOCP, and it does not directly center on closed-loop cyclic angle constraints in meshed networks, so it does not match the requested SOCP-based cyclic-angle formulation.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：关键缺口是 SOCP 框架缺失，以及未直接处理网状输电网的循环相角恢复问题；其不确定性建模也不是用户需求重点。 / English explanation: The key gaps are the absence of an SOCP framework and no direct treatment of cyclic angle recovery in meshed transmission networks; its uncertainty modeling is also outside the user’s main focus.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：虽然使用 SOCP 松弛，但模型面向径向配电网的馈线重构，并显式要求无环结构，这与用户需要的“大规模网状输电网 + 循环相角约束”方向相反。 / English explanation: Although it uses SOCP relaxation, the model is for radial distribution feeder reconfiguration and explicitly enforces loop-free topology, which is the opposite of the user’s need for large-scale meshed transmission networks with cyclic angle constraints.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：领域对象不符（配电网而非输电网），且拓扑约束排除了闭环结构，因此无法满足网状系统中的角度循环恢复需求。 / English explanation: The domain is mismatched (distribution rather than transmission), and the topology constraints exclude closed loops, so it cannot satisfy cyclic angle recovery needs in meshed systems.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：它强调大规模可扩展 OPF，但核心是多时段安全约束调度与 DC/AC 分解，并非在 SOCP 框架中直接处理网状输电网的循环相角约束，因此只能算部分相关。 / English explanation: It emphasizes scalable large-scale OPF, but its core is multi-step security-constrained dispatch with DC/AC decomposition, not direct handling of cyclic angle constraints in an SOCP framework for meshed transmission networks, so it is only partially related.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：关键缺口是缺少 SOCP 角度循环约束建模，且问题重心偏向多时段安全约束与分解求解，而非用户所需的单纯 SOCP-OPF 角度恢复增强。 / English explanation: The key gaps are the lack of SOCP cyclic-angle modeling and a focus on multi-step security-constrained decomposition rather than the requested SOCP-OPF angle-recovery enhancement.

checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：与用户要求的“SOCP 凸优化模型”存在方法论不符，且缺少对网状闭环相角恢复的直接建模。 / English explanation: It conflicts methodologically with the requested “SOCP convex optimization model” and lacks direct modeling of cyclic angle recovery in meshed networks.

top_rows.Requirement text: I need a large-scale AC-OPF convex optimization model suitable for meshed transmission networks. Traditional AC-OPF is non-convex and computationally difficult, making it hard to guarantee global optimality in large-scale systems. Linear approximations such as DC-OPF are fast, but sacrifice accuracy. SOCP-OPF, as a convex relaxation method, has good computational efficiency. However, in meshed transmission networks, traditional SOCP models may fail to correctly recover voltage angles, because voltage angle differences around a closed loop must satisfy cyclic constraints, meaning that the sum of angle differences around a closed loop should be zero. Existing solutions are either computationally expensive or not suitable for large-scale meshed systems. Therefore, an OPF model is needed that can directly consider cyclic angle constraints within the SOCP framework, so that it can maintain SOCP scalability and computational efficiency while improving angle recovery accuracy and the physical consistency of power flow solutions in meshed transmission networks.

requirement.requirement_text: I need a stochastic UC-OPF model for an isolated microgrid energy management system (EMS). In isolated microgrids, wind power, photovoltaics, energy storage, diesel generators, and plug-in electric vehicles coexist. Since the system capacity is small and support capability is weak, wind power uncertainty can more easily affect voltage stability and operational security. Existing studies often only add voltage stability constraints to OPF, or fail to treat loading margin as a time- and scenario-dependent variable. They also often do not sufficiently consider the role of PEVs in mitigating microgrid voltage stability problems. Therefore, an EMS model coordinating unit commitment and optimal power flow is needed. It should consider stochastic wind scenarios and jointly determine unit commitment, power dispatch, ESS charging/discharging, PEV charging/discharging, and parking lot capacity, while explicitly guaranteeing voltage stability margin so that isolated microgrids can still operate safely under uncertain renewable energy conditions.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: A Stochastic Voltage Stability Constrained EMS for Isolated Microgrids in the Presence of PEVs Using a Coordinated UC-OPF Framework
data_properties.hasAuthor: Saman Nikkhah; Mohamad-Amin Nasr; Abbas Rabiee
data_properties.hasInstitution: Newcastle University; Amirkabir University of Technology; University of Zanjan
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Stochastic energy management of isolated microgrids with coordinated UC-OPF under voltage stability constraints.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Wind power uncertainty and PEV integration can affect microgrid voltage stability and secure operation.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Coordinated unit commitment and optimal power flow for isolated microgrids with wind, PV, ESS, and PEVs under stochastic voltage-stability limits.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How do wind uncertainty and PEVs affect voltage stability margin and optimal EMS scheduling in isolated microgrids?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generator on/off status and dispatch, ESS charge/discharge schedule, PEV charging/discharging schedule, bus voltages, branch flows, and loading margin.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Stochastic scenario-based UC-OPF with voltage-stability-constrained EMS.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with bus voltage magnitudes/angles and branch apparent-power limits.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Multi-period hourly scheduling over 24 hours.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: 24 hours
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Scenario-based stochastic wind-power modeling using Weibull-derived scenarios.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Isolated microgrid with diesel generators, wind turbines, PV units, ESS, and PEV parking lots.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Coordinated UC and OPF solved as MINLP in GAMS; DICOPT with relaxed MINLP warm start.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Validated on a modified CIGRE benchmark microgrid; DICOPT reported as most efficient solver.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: PEV parking lots modeled with charging/discharging limits and energy constraints.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total operating cost: quadratic generation cost plus start-up and shut-down costs over all time intervals and scenarios.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Active/reactive power balance; generator output limits; ramp-up/down limits; minimum up/down times; start-up/shut-down logic; spinning reserve; branch flow and voltage limits; L-index voltage-stability limit; wind/PV output relations; ESS SOC and charge/discharge limits; PEV energy, charging/discharging, and parking-lot capacity limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients ag, bg, cg, Csupg, Csdng; reserve requirement RESt; voltage limits Vmin/Vmax; branch limits Smaxij; L-index limit Llimt; wind scenario probabilities πs and mean wind speeds vs; PEV capacities and efficiencies; ESS capacities and efficiencies; ramp rates Rupg/Rdng; minimum up/down times Tupg/Tdng.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Formulated as a stochastic MINLP in GAMS and solved with commercial MINLP solvers; DICOPT used with an initial relaxed NLP solution from CONOPT.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Tested on a modified CIGRE microgrid benchmark with five wind scenarios and compared across cases with/without PEVs and voltage-stability constraints.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: PEVs improve voltage stability margin; wind uncertainty reduces it; voltage-stability constraints alter optimal dispatch and PEV parking-lot capacity; stochastic modeling lowers energy loss versus deterministic wind.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: jointly captures UC, OPF, stochastic wind, voltage stability, ESS, and PEVs. Limitation: relies on scenario-based wind modeling and simplified PEV battery behavior.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Loading margin is treated as a scenario-dependent variable.

data_properties.hasModelName: Hybrid UC OPF Renewable Integrated Power Systems
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Hybrid UC–OPF Optimization for Renewable-Integrated Power Systems
data_properties.hasAuthor: Muhammad Nurul Hadi; Ramdhan Halid Siregar; Rakhmad Syafutra Lubis
data_properties.hasInstitution: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Universitas Syiah Kuala, Banda Aceh, Indonesia
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Optimize unit commitment and power flow feasibility for renewable-integrated power systems with PV and pumped hydro storage.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Intermittent PV output creates scheduling and power-flow feasibility challenges that require flexible generation management.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Day-ahead UC-OPF scheduling for a modified IEEE 30-bus system with thermal generators, PV, and pumped hydro storage.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid MINLP–PSO approach produce a cost-effective UC schedule while satisfying power-flow constraints under varying PV outputs?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal hourly generator dispatch, PV and PHS operating schedules, bus voltages, line flows, and total operational cost/penalty values.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid two-stage UC then OPF refinement; MINLP scheduling followed by PSO-assisted Newton-Raphson feasibility correction.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with bus voltage, reactive power, and line capacity constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: 24-hour day-ahead planning horizon with hourly load and PV profiles.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: 24 hours.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Varying PV outputs are tested, but no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model is formulated.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Modified IEEE 30-bus system with thermal generators, PV at bus 6, and PHS at bus 25.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: SCIP-MINLP initial solve, Newton-Raphson feasibility check, then PSO refinement for violated hours.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reduces power-flow violations by more than 99% and lowers penalty from 302,210.9 to 2,128.49.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Hourly load profile is fixed; no demand response or flexible demand model is included.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total operational cost over 24 hours, including thermal fuel cost, start-up and shut-down cost, and PHS operating cost.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Generator active and reactive limits, minimum up/down times, ramp-rate limits, PHS storage/capacity bounds, power balance, bus voltage limits, and transmission line capacity limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Quadratic fuel-cost coefficients a, b, c; generator min/max active and reactive limits; minimum up/down times; ramp rates; PHS capacity, efficiency, initial storage, O&M cost; penalty weights for voltage, power, reactive power, line, ramp, and NR convergence violations.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: SCIP solves UC first; Newton-Raphson checks feasibility; PSO optimizes only hours with violations using a penalty-based fitness function.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Tested on a modified IEEE 30-bus system with 24-hour load and PV data; OPF refinement substantially reduced violations and penalties.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: UC alone gave the lowest cost but infeasible power flow; OPF refinement slightly increased cost while making the schedule technically feasible.
