data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Probabilistically Robust AC Optimal Power Flow
data_properties.hasAuthor: Mohammadreza Chamanbaz; Fabrizio Dabbene; Constantino M. Lagoa
data_properties.hasInstitution: iTrust Center for Research in Cyber Security, Singapore University of Technology and Design; CNR-IEIIT, Torino, Italy; Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Penn State University
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Minimize generation cost in AC optimal power flow while satisfying network constraints under uncertain loads and renewable generation with probabilistic guarantees.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Classical OPF dispatch is rigid and can become inefficient or infeasible under renewable and load uncertainty, causing overloads and outages.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Robust and chance-constrained AC optimal power flow with uncertain loads and renewable generators.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can AC-OPF be solved efficiently under uncertainty while limiting the probability of violating generation and transmission constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal controllable generation dispatch, generator voltage magnitudes, deployment vector, and corresponding bus voltage and line-flow-feasible operating point.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Scenario-with-certificates formulation combined with convex SDP relaxation of AC power flow.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with voltage-magnitude and line-flow constraints via lifted matrix W.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period OPF repeated over hourly demand scenarios in experiments.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per solve; 24 hourly solves in simulation.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Probabilistic uncertainty in loads and renewable generation using scenario with certificates and chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes renewable generators, uncertain loads, generator participation factors, voltage limits, and transmission limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Convex relaxation plus randomized scenario-with-certificates sampling.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: A priori probabilistic guarantee on constraint-violation risk; exact for a restricted class of networks.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Uncertain loads are explicitly modeled and balanced through generator deployment factors.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost f(u); in the penalized variant, worst-case cost adds reactive-power and line-loss penalties.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power balance equalities; generator active/reactive limits; voltage magnitude bounds; line-voltage-difference or apparent-flow limits; deployment factors sum to one and remain nonnegative.
data_properties.usesParameter: Uncertain complex load and renewable deviations δ; deployment vector α; bus-voltage matrix W split into Wu and Wx; risk levels ε and β; line admittances ylm; voltage and power limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Uses SDP lifting W=VV* and scenario-with-certificates sampling to solve a convex program; implemented with YALMIP and Mosek.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the New England 39-bus system with Monte Carlo testing over 10,000 samples and comparison against nominal OPF and a prior probabilistic AC-OPF method.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method greatly reduced infeasible samples and line-flow violations versus nominal OPF, while using far fewer scenario samples than the compared parameterized approach.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Can incorporate N-1 security constraints and outage probabilities within the same scenario framework.

requirement.requirement_name: Hybrid UC and OPF correction for PV
requirement.requirement_text: A hybrid model combining UC unit commitment scheduling and OPF power flow correction is needed for 24-hour dispatch after PV integration. UC alone may achieve low cost, but it may violate voltage, line, and power flow constraints, so PSO–NR OPF is needed to correct infeasible periods.

data_properties.hasModelName: Hybrid UC OPF Renewable Integrated Power Systems
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Hybrid UC–OPF Optimization for Renewable-Integrated Power Systems
data_properties.hasAuthor: Muhammad Nurul Hadi; Ramdhan Halid Siregar; Rakhmad Syafutra Lubis
data_properties.hasInstitution: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Universitas Syiah Kuala, Banda Aceh, Indonesia
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Optimize unit commitment and power flow feasibility for renewable-integrated power systems with PV and pumped hydro storage.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Intermittent PV output creates scheduling and power-flow feasibility challenges that require flexible generation management.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Day-ahead UC-OPF scheduling for a modified IEEE 30-bus system with thermal generators, PV, and pumped hydro storage.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid MINLP–PSO approach produce a cost-effective UC schedule while satisfying power-flow constraints under varying PV outputs?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal hourly generator dispatch, PV and PHS operating schedules, bus voltages, line flows, and total operational cost/penalty values.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid two-stage UC then OPF refinement; MINLP scheduling followed by PSO-assisted Newton-Raphson feasibility correction.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with bus voltage, reactive power, and line capacity constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: 24-hour day-ahead planning horizon with hourly load and PV profiles.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: 24 hours.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Varying PV outputs are tested, but no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model is formulated.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Modified IEEE 30-bus system with thermal generators, PV at bus 6, and PHS at bus 25.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: SCIP-MINLP initial solve, Newton-Raphson feasibility check, then PSO refinement for violated hours.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reduces power-flow violations by more than 99% and lowers penalty from 302,210.9 to 2,128.49.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Hourly load profile is fixed; no demand response or flexible demand model is included.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total operational cost over 24 hours, including thermal fuel cost, start-up and shut-down cost, and PHS operating cost.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Generator active and reactive limits, minimum up/down times, ramp-rate limits, PHS storage/capacity bounds, power balance, bus voltage limits, and transmission line capacity limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Quadratic fuel-cost coefficients a, b, c; generator min/max active and reactive limits; minimum up/down times; ramp rates; PHS capacity, efficiency, initial storage, O&M cost; penalty weights for voltage, power, reactive power, line, ramp, and NR convergence violations.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: SCIP solves UC first; Newton-Raphson checks feasibility; PSO optimizes only hours with violations using a penalty-based fitness function.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Tested on a modified IEEE 30-bus system with 24-hour load and PV data; OPF refinement substantially reduced violations and penalties.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: UC alone gave the lowest cost but infeasible power flow; OPF refinement slightly increased cost while making the schedule technically feasible.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve large-scale security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps efficiently under strict time limits.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Large SCOPF instances contain millions of continuous/integer variables and nonlinear nonconvex constraints, making them difficult to solve within challenge time limits.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps, including AC power flow, contingencies, reserves, device switching, and ramping constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a decomposition-based hybrid solver scale multi-timestep SCOPF to very large grids while maintaining high-quality feasible solutions?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation and consumption dispatch, device switching status, bus voltage angles, AC power-flow feasible operating point, and reserve allocations.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Two-stage DC/AC decomposition with sequential optimization for large networks.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: DC module uses linearized/MILP approximations; AC module solves full nonlinear AC power-flow equations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Multiple time steps; sequential stage-wise optimization for large horizons.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Time-step based control horizon; exact interval length not specified.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Control horizon divided into stages for networks over 2000 buses.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Contingency constraints included; no stochastic or robust uncertainty model stated.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained AC OPF with reserves, ramping, device uptime/downtime, and switching constraints.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Problem reformulation, McCormick relaxation, slack variables, clique constraints, analytical derivatives, vectorization, and sequential bound updates.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for scalability and strict time limits on very large instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consumption devices represented with bid blocks and power consumption bounds.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus z over device powers, bus voltage angles, and switching variables.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints G enforce power-balance and AC/DC network equations; inequality constraints H cover voltage limits, real/reactive power limits, reserves, ramping, switching, contingency, and device operation constraints.
data_properties.usesParameter: Device power pjt, bus voltage angle θit, switching status ujt, shunt conductance gshjt, branch flow limits smaxj, reserve factors σscrn, ramp-up Pru, ramp-down Prd, and mismatch penalty pit.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: DC subproblem solved as MILP with Gurobi; AC subproblem solved as NLP with IPOPT; large cases use sequential stage-wise optimization and selective contingency inclusion.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on 300+ scenarios across 73 to 8316-bus networks from ARPA-E GO challenge datasets.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The approach achieved high scaled scores in most scenarios, with average scores around 0.983 on Scenario Set 3 and 0.9992 on Scenario Set 2, while meeting time limits.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: scalable, robust, high-quality solutions, full AC formulation. Limitation: solution quality varies by scenario and depends on available reserve abundance; large cases require sequential decomposition.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Applied to ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets and testing platform.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Minimize generation cost in AC optimal power flow while satisfying network constraints under uncertain loads and renewable generation with probabilistic guarantees.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Classical OPF dispatch is rigid and can become inefficient or infeasible under renewable and load uncertainty, causing overloads and outages.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Robust and chance-constrained AC optimal power flow with uncertain loads and renewable generators.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can AC-OPF be solved efficiently under uncertainty while limiting the probability of violating generation and transmission constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal controllable generation dispatch, generator voltage magnitudes, deployment vector, and corresponding bus voltage and line-flow-feasible operating point.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Scenario-with-certificates formulation combined with convex SDP relaxation of AC power flow.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with voltage-magnitude and line-flow constraints via lifted matrix W.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period OPF repeated over hourly demand scenarios in experiments.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per solve; 24 hourly solves in simulation.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Probabilistic uncertainty in loads and renewable generation using scenario with certificates and chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes renewable generators, uncertain loads, generator participation factors, voltage limits, and transmission limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Convex relaxation plus randomized scenario-with-certificates sampling.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: A priori probabilistic guarantee on constraint-violation risk; exact for a restricted class of networks.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Uncertain loads are explicitly modeled and balanced through generator deployment factors.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost f(u); in the penalized variant, worst-case cost adds reactive-power and line-loss penalties.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power balance equalities; generator active/reactive limits; voltage magnitude bounds; line-voltage-difference or apparent-flow limits; deployment factors sum to one and remain nonnegative.
data_properties.usesParameter: Uncertain complex load and renewable deviations δ; deployment vector α; bus-voltage matrix W split into Wu and Wx; risk levels ε and β; line admittances ylm; voltage and power limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Uses SDP lifting W=VV* and scenario-with-certificates sampling to solve a convex program; implemented with YALMIP and Mosek.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the New England 39-bus system with Monte Carlo testing over 10,000 samples and comparison against nominal OPF and a prior probabilistic AC-OPF method.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method greatly reduced infeasible samples and line-flow violations versus nominal OPF, while using far fewer scenario samples than the compared parameterized approach.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Can incorporate N-1 security constraints and outage probabilities within the same scenario framework.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Real-Time Sequential Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow: A Hybrid Knowledge-Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning Approach
data_properties.hasAuthor: Zhongkai Yi; Xue Wang; Cheng Yang; Chao Yang; Mengyang Niu; Wotao Yin
data_properties.hasInstitution: Alibaba DAMO Academy; Alibaba US; Tsinghua University; Harbin Institute of Technology
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve sequential real-time security-constrained optimal power flow with fast dispatch decisions under inaccurate environmental parameters.
data_properties.hasMotivation: ACOPF is nonconvex, time-coupled by ramping limits, and difficult to solve quickly and safely when system parameters are inaccurate or contingencies are unexperienced.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Sequential security-constrained AC optimal power flow for real-time operation with generator active/reactive dispatch and network security limits.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning method produce safe real-time OPF dispatches efficiently without relying on accurate environmental models?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Safe generator active and reactive power dispatch commands; resulting bus voltage magnitudes and branch active/reactive power flows within limits.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning with a safety-layer projection model and inactive-constraint identification.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow formulation with nonlinear nodal injections, branch flows, voltage magnitudes, and ramping-coupled generator limits.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Sequential multi-step dispatch with future load forecasts and ramping-coupled time dependence.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Real-time operation over time slots; forecasting horizon T steps.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Infinite-horizon sequential decision process terminated by grid failure/non-convergence.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses reinforcement learning for inaccurate environments and updates safety-layer parameters from latest measurements.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained ACOPF with coordinated active and reactive power dispatch, voltage and branch-flow security limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Improved SAC with SAM, prioritized replay, adaptive entropy, hybrid safety layer, and inactive-constraint elimination.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Claims faster decision-making and reduced security violations with comparable economic performance.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Includes forecasted net load demand in the state; no explicit demand response control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize cumulative generation operating cost, with quadratic cost coefficients for each generator over time.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power-balance equations, branch active/reactive flow equations, generator active/reactive limits, branch flow limits, voltage magnitude limits, and ramping-coupled generator bounds; safety-layer projection also enforces linearized security constraints and power balance.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients; generator active/reactive bounds and ramping limits; bus voltages; line conductance/susceptance or resistance/reactance; branch flow limits; load demand and forecasted load; slack-bus limits; penalty coefficients; SAC temperature and learning rates.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Sequential decisions are produced by an improved soft actor-critic policy, then projected by a linear security layer initialized from linearized power-flow knowledge and updated with data; inactive constraints are removed analytically.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 30-bus and larger systems, including contingency and parameter-error scenarios, with comparisons against penalty, constrained-policy, and pure data-driven safety-layer baselines.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The method maintains voltages and branch flows within safe ranges, reduces violation times in early training and contingencies, and scales to larger systems with low decision time.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: safe real-time dispatch, better robustness to inaccurate models, and high computational efficiency. Limitation: safety layer uses linearized power-flow approximation and may need conservative limits to offset approximation error.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper also evaluates scalability on 9-, 30-, 57-, 118-, and 1187-bus systems.

top_rows.Requirement text: A hybrid model combining UC unit commitment scheduling and OPF power flow correction is needed for 24-hour dispatch after PV integration. UC alone may achieve low cost, but it may violate voltage, line, and power flow constraints, so PSO–NR OPF is needed to correct infeasible periods.

top_rows.Objective text: Minimize total operational cost over 24 hours, including thermal fuel cost, start-up and shut-down cost, and PHS operating cost.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文：该模型直接面向多时间步安全约束 OPF，包含 AC 潮流、备用、爬坡和切换约束，适合做 D-OPF 基准比较框架中的高维、时序与安全性对照。它还明确使用 DC/MILP 与 AC/NLP 分解，便于与不同近似/精确模型在可行性、最优性和可扩展性上比较。 / English: This model directly targets multi-step security-constrained OPF with AC power flow, reserves, ramping, and switching constraints, making it suitable as a benchmark component for comparing feasibility, optimality, and scalability across D-OPF formulations. Its DC/MILP plus AC/NLP decomposition also supports side-by-side comparison with approximate and exact models.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文：它更偏向安全约束与多步调度，不是专门为 NLP、SOCP、SDP、LinDistFlow 的统一基准设计；若要覆盖多种松弛形式，还需额外组织对照实验。 / English: It is oriented toward security-constrained multi-step scheduling rather than a dedicated unified benchmark for NLP, SOCP, SDP, and LinDistFlow; extra experimental orchestration would still be needed to cover those formulations.
supporting_evidence: hasSolvedProblem: Security-constrained optimal power flow with multiple time steps, including AC power flow, contingencies, reserves, device switching, and ramping constraints.
hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: DC module uses linearized/MILP approximations; AC module solves full nonlinear AC power-flow equations.
hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for scalability and strict time limits on very large instances.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文：该模型明确以 AC-OPF 预测为目标，并在 IEEE/NESTA 多个测试系统上比较运行速度与可行性，适合作为基准框架中的数据驱动近似类对照。它包含 AC 潮流、线路限额、节点功率平衡和电压/相角约束，能用于检验近似解是否保持物理可行。 / English: This model explicitly predicts AC-OPF setpoints and is evaluated on multiple IEEE/NESTA systems with speed and feasibility comparisons, making it a strong data-driven approximation baseline. It includes AC power flow, line limits, nodal balance, and voltage/angle constraints, which helps test whether approximate solutions remain physically feasible.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文：它主要是单时段预测型方法，不覆盖多种目标函数下的统一求解流程，也不直接提供 SOCP/SDP/LinDistFlow 等松弛模型的横向基准。 / English: It is mainly a single-period prediction approach, so it does not provide a unified solving workflow across multiple objective functions or a direct benchmark for SOCP/SDP/LinDistFlow relaxations.
supporting_evidence: hasPrimaryPurpose: Predict AC optimal power flow setpoints from load conditions using deep learning.
hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on NESTA IEEE 14, 30, 39, 57, 73, 89, 118, 162, 189, and 300-bus cases with 80/20 splits.
hasFurtherProperty: The paper also evaluates load-flow feasibility restoration and dispatch-cost closeness to AC-OPF solutions.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文：该模型是 AC-OPF 的概率鲁棒/机会约束版本，明确使用 SDP 松弛与场景证书方法，适合纳入基准框架来对比松弛模型的可行性与保守性。它直接关注不确定负荷和可再生出力下的约束违背风险，这与比较不同 D-OPF 形式的可行性差异高度相关。 / English: This is a probabilistically robust/chance-constrained AC-OPF model that explicitly uses an SDP relaxation and scenario-with-certificates method, making it suitable for benchmarking feasibility and conservatism of relaxed formulations. It directly addresses violation risk under uncertain loads and renewables, which is highly relevant when comparing D-OPF formulations.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文：它聚焦于不确定性下的鲁棒 AC-OPF，而不是覆盖 NLP、SOCP、LinDistFlow 等多模型统一比较；且其精确性只对受限网络类别成立。 / English: It focuses on robust AC-OPF under uncertainty rather than a unified comparison across NLP, SOCP, LinDistFlow, and other models; exactness is only proven for a restricted network class.
supporting_evidence: hasSolvedProblem: Robust and chance-constrained AC optimal power flow with uncertain loads and renewable generators.
hasMathematicalProblemType: Nonlinear Programming Problem; Semidefinite Programming Problem.

hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文：该模型面向 ACOPF 的快速近似求解，强调可扩展性，并在 IEEE-30/118 上与 IPOPT ACOPF 结果对比，适合作为基准框架中的学习型近似参考。它包含 AC 功率平衡、线路容量和电压/相角边界约束，可用于观察近似模型在可行性与速度上的权衡。 / English: This model targets fast approximate ACOPF solving with a strong scalability focus and compares against IPOPT ACOPF on IEEE-30/118 cases, making it a useful learning-based approximation reference in a benchmark framework. It includes AC power balance, line capacity, and voltage/angle boundary constraints, enabling study of feasibility-speed tradeoffs.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文：它是模仿学习的近似器，训练目标依赖 IPOPT 生成解，且主要输出发电设定值，不是用于系统性比较多种 D-OPF 公式的通用基准。 / English: It is an imitation-learning approximator trained on IPOPT-generated targets and mainly outputs generator setpoints, so it is not a general benchmark for systematically comparing multiple D-OPF formulations.
supporting_evidence: hasPrimaryPurpose: Approximate AC optimal power flow solutions with a local, scalable graph neural network trained by imitation learning.
hasPrimaryOutput: Estimated optimal generator active power outputs; evaluated against IPOPT ACOPF solutions.
hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Limitation: trained to imitate IPOPT solutions rather than solve OPF exactly.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Distribution Grid Optimal Power Flow (D-OPF): Modeling, Analysis, and Benchmarking
data_properties.hasAuthor: Rahul Ranjan Jha; Adedoyin Inaolaji; Biswajit Dipan Biswas; Arun Suresh; Anamika Dubey; Sumit Paudyal; Sukumar Kamalasadan
data_properties.hasInstitution: Washington State University; Florida International University; University of North Carolina at Charlotte; ComEd
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Benchmark and compare distribution-grid OPF formulations for feasibility, optimality, and scalability.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Distribution OPF is nonconvex and different relaxations/approximations can be infeasible, inexact, or poorly scalable.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Distribution grid optimal power flow under loss minimization, PV hosting maximization, and voltage deviation minimization.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How do NLP, convex relaxation, and linearized D-OPF formulations compare in feasibility, optimality, and scalability across problem types and feeder sizes?

data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method found globally optimal feeder configurations on tested networks and was computationally efficient.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Minimize generation cost in AC optimal power flow while satisfying network constraints under uncertain loads and renewable generation with probabilistic guarantees.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Classical OPF dispatch is rigid and can become inefficient or infeasible under renewable and load uncertainty, causing overloads and outages.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Robust and chance-constrained AC optimal power flow with uncertain loads and renewable generators.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can AC-OPF be solved efficiently under uncertainty while limiting the probability of violating generation and transmission constraints?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal controllable generation dispatch, generator voltage magnitudes, deployment vector, and corresponding bus voltage and line-flow-feasible operating point.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Scenario-with-certificates formulation combined with convex SDP relaxation of AC power flow.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power balance equations with voltage-magnitude and line-flow constraints via lifted matrix W.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period OPF repeated over hourly demand scenarios in experiments.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per solve; 24 hourly solves in simulation.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Probabilistic uncertainty in loads and renewable generation using scenario with certificates and chance constraints.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes renewable generators, uncertain loads, generator participation factors, voltage limits, and transmission limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Convex relaxation plus randomized scenario-with-certificates sampling.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: A priori probabilistic guarantee on constraint-violation risk; exact for a restricted class of networks.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Uncertain loads are explicitly modeled and balanced through generator deployment factors.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize generation cost f(u); in the penalized variant, worst-case cost adds reactive-power and line-loss penalties.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power balance equalities; generator active/reactive limits; voltage magnitude bounds; line-voltage-difference or apparent-flow limits; deployment factors sum to one and remain nonnegative.
data_properties.usesParameter: Uncertain complex load and renewable deviations δ; deployment vector α; bus-voltage matrix W split into Wu and Wx; risk levels ε and β; line admittances ylm; voltage and power limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Uses SDP lifting W=VV* and scenario-with-certificates sampling to solve a convex program; implemented with YALMIP and Mosek.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on the New England 39-bus system with Monte Carlo testing over 10,000 samples and comparison against nominal OPF and a prior probabilistic AC-OPF method.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed method greatly reduced infeasible samples and line-flow violations versus nominal OPF, while using far fewer scenario samples than the compared parameterized approach.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: less conservative, probabilistic guarantees, computationally efficient, and exact for some networks. Limitation: exactness is only proven for a restrictive network class.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Can incorporate N-1 security constraints and outage probabilities within the same scenario framework.

data_properties.hasModelName: Hybrid UC OPF Renewable Integrated Power Systems
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Hybrid UC–OPF Optimization for Renewable-Integrated Power Systems
data_properties.hasAuthor: Muhammad Nurul Hadi; Ramdhan Halid Siregar; Rakhmad Syafutra Lubis
data_properties.hasInstitution: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Universitas Syiah Kuala, Banda Aceh, Indonesia
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Optimize unit commitment and power flow feasibility for renewable-integrated power systems with PV and pumped hydro storage.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Intermittent PV output creates scheduling and power-flow feasibility challenges that require flexible generation management.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Day-ahead UC-OPF scheduling for a modified IEEE 30-bus system with thermal generators, PV, and pumped hydro storage.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid MINLP–PSO approach produce a cost-effective UC schedule while satisfying power-flow constraints under varying PV outputs?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal hourly generator dispatch, PV and PHS operating schedules, bus voltages, line flows, and total operational cost/penalty values.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid two-stage UC then OPF refinement; MINLP scheduling followed by PSO-assisted Newton-Raphson feasibility correction.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with bus voltage, reactive power, and line capacity constraints.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: 24-hour day-ahead planning horizon with hourly load and PV profiles.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: 24 hours.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Varying PV outputs are tested, but no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model is formulated.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Modified IEEE 30-bus system with thermal generators, PV at bus 6, and PHS at bus 25.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: SCIP-MINLP initial solve, Newton-Raphson feasibility check, then PSO refinement for violated hours.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reduces power-flow violations by more than 99% and lowers penalty from 302,210.9 to 2,128.49.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Hourly load profile is fixed; no demand response or flexible demand model is included.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total operational cost over 24 hours, including thermal fuel cost, start-up and shut-down cost, and PHS operating cost.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Generator active and reactive limits, minimum up/down times, ramp-rate limits, PHS storage/capacity bounds, power balance, bus voltage limits, and transmission line capacity limits.
data_properties.usesParameter: Quadratic fuel-cost coefficients a, b, c; generator min/max active and reactive limits; minimum up/down times; ramp rates; PHS capacity, efficiency, initial storage, O&M cost; penalty weights for voltage, power, reactive power, line, ramp, and NR convergence violations.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: SCIP solves UC first; Newton-Raphson checks feasibility; PSO optimizes only hours with violations using a penalty-based fitness function.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Tested on a modified IEEE 30-bus system with 24-hour load and PV data; OPF refinement substantially reduced violations and penalties.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: UC alone gave the lowest cost but infeasible power flow; OPF refinement slightly increased cost while making the schedule technically feasible.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: balances economic dispatch and feasibility with large penalty reduction. Limitation: no explicit stochastic uncertainty model; PSO is applied only after detecting violations.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: PHS operates mainly as a balancing/backup resource with relatively low output.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Optimal Power Flow Using Graph Neural Networks
data_properties.hasAuthor: Damian Owerko; Fernando Gama; Alejandro Ribeiro
data_properties.hasInstitution: University of Pennsylvania, Department of Electrical and Systems Engineering
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Approximate AC optimal power flow solutions with a local, scalable graph neural network trained by imitation learning.
data_properties.hasMotivation: ACOPF is non-convex and costly to solve, and existing approximate methods do not scale well to large power networks.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: AC optimal power flow on power networks, using IEEE-30 and IEEE-118 test cases.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a graph neural network learn to imitate optimal ACOPF solutions accurately and efficiently in a decentralized, scalable way?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Estimated optimal generator active power outputs; evaluated against IPOPT ACOPF solutions.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Graph neural network parametrization with local message passing and scalable architecture.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power flow equations with nonlinear active and reactive power balance.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Training uses randomly sampled load scenarios from uniform ranges around reference loads.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Generator dispatch, bus voltages, active/reactive loads, and network topology on IEEE test systems.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Imitation learning with GNNs trained on IPOPT-generated optimal solutions.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported relative RMSE and much faster inference than IPOPT.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Loads are sampled as inputs; model predicts generator dispatch to meet demand.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, with generator cost depending on active power output.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Active and reactive power balance equations p=P(v,δ;W), q=Q(v,δ;W), plus elementwise bounds Xmin ⪯ X ⪯ Xmax on voltages, angles, active and reactive powers.
data_properties.usesParameter: Network adjacency/weights W from line impedances; node states X=[v,δ,p,q]; generator selection matrix G; load vectors pL and qL; generator cost functions cm(pm).
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: IPOPT is used to solve ACOPF and generate training targets; GNNs are trained with MSE using ADAM on IEEE-30 and IEEE-118 datasets.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on held-out test sets from IEEE-30 and IEEE-118; compared against global/local GNN and MLP baselines using relative RMSE.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: GNNs outperform MLP baselines, especially on the larger IEEE-118 case, and provide orders-of-magnitude faster inference than IPOPT.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: local, scalable, permutation-equivariant, and stable to graph perturbations. Limitation: trained to imitate IPOPT solutions rather than solve OPF exactly.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Uses graph convolution layers with K-hop neighborhood aggregation.

data_properties.hasModelName: Multi Period Hybrid AC DC OPF

data_properties.hasAuthor: Damian Sieraszewski; Ole Kjærland Olsen; Dmytro Ivanko; Irina Oleinikova; Hossein Farahmand
data_properties.hasInstitution: Department of Electric Power Engineering, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU); NORCE Norwegian Research Centre
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Model flexibility market clearing and TSO-DSO coordination using a hybrid AC/DC optimal power flow formulation.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Need to unlock consumer-side flexibility and coordinate DSO and TSO operations to address congestion, voltage, and balancing challenges.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Seamless coordination of transmission and distribution grid operation in a local flexibility market with multi-period flexibility procurement.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a multi-period hybrid AC/DC-OPF model accurately clear flexibility and coordinate TSO-DSO actions across transmission and distribution grids?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal day-ahead dispatch and flexibility market dispatch, including generation, flexible load, battery charging/discharging, load shedding, bus voltages, and line power flows.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid SOC-ACOPF for distribution grid and DC-OPF for transmission grid; multi-period formulation; AC-DC connection constraint.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: SOC-ACOPF for distribution; DC-OPF for transmission; convex relaxation with auxiliary variables.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Multi-period; hourly day-ahead plus quarter-hour flexibility intervals; rolling horizon in operation.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: 24 hours with quarter-hour subperiods.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Scenario-based planning mentioned, but probabilistic scenarios are not developed in this paper.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: TSO-DSO coordination in a local flexibility market with transmission and radial distribution grids.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Pyomo implementation solved with Gurobi; two-stage optimization for day-ahead and flexibility market clearing.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Validated on standard test grids; reported high accuracy and applicability; compared with standalone AC and DC OPF.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Flexible loads, load shifting, load shedding, distributed generation, and batteries.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total operating cost of transmission and distribution generation, flexibility activation, battery operation, and load shedding across all periods.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: SOC-ACOPF power balance and conic relaxation constraints; AC-DC coupling constraint; DC power balance, line flow limits, slack angle; flexible generation/load bounds; zero-net load shifting; battery SoC, charge/discharge, and terminal SoC constraints; load shedding equals served load.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generation cost coefficients, flexibility prices, battery cost, load-shedding cost, network susceptance matrices, active/reactive load limits, generation limits, line flow limits, slack angle, battery SoC bounds, charge/discharge limits, efficiencies, and initial SoC.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Implemented in Python with Pyomo and solved using Gurobi on a 33-bus distribution grid and 9-bus transmission grid test case.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated against standalone SOC-ACOPF and DC-OPF results and tested on flexibility, voltage, and congestion cases.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: Flexibility reduced costs, improved voltages, lowered imported transmission power and distribution losses, and could also relieve transmission congestion.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: unified multi-period TSO-DSO coordination and flexibility clearing. Limitation: single-optimization formulation may become computationally heavy for multiple DSOs; reactive power flexibility not yet included.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Future work extends the model with ADMM for multiple DSOs and reactive power flexibility exchange.

top_rows.Requirement text: A D-OPF model benchmarking framework is needed to compare NLP, SOCP, SDP, LinDistFlow, and other models under different objective functions. metadata.hasPaperTitle: Loss reduction in a windfarm participating in primary voltage control using an extension of the Convex DistFlow OPF
metadata.hasAuthor: Benoît Martin; Philippe De Rua; Emmanuel De Jaeger; François Glineur
metadata.hasInstitution: Université Catholique de Louvain (UCL), MEED/iMMC and CORE/ICTEAM

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Loss reduction in a windfarm participating in primary voltage control using an extension of the Convex DistFlow OPF
data_properties.hasAuthor: Benoît Martin; Philippe De Rua; Emmanuel De Jaeger; François Glineur
data_properties.hasInstitution: Université Catholique de Louvain (UCL), MEED/iMMC and CORE/ICTEAM
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Optimal reactive dispatch in a wind farm to reduce collector-grid losses while providing primary voltage control.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Current reactive power setpoint dispatch among wind turbines and switchable capacitor/inductor banks is suboptimal and causes extra energy losses.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: OPF for a radial wind-farm collector grid with transformers, line charging, OLTC, and discrete capacitor/inductor bank switching.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can an extended convex DistFlow OPF accurately and efficiently determine OLTC tap and reactive dispatch under primary voltage control?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal OLTC tap selection, reactive power dispatch of wind turbines and static units, bus voltages, branch power flows, and minimized active power losses.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Extended convex DistFlow with discrete OLTC and static bank switching; formulated as MISOCP and relaxed by linear outer approximation.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Convex DistFlow with π-line model, variable-ratio transformers, SOC relaxation, and convexified voltage-drop equations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single operating point; repeated over many operating conditions.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: 10 min data used for yearly clustering; model itself is static per case.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period OPF per operating condition.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Radial wind-farm collector grid with DFIG turbines, capacitive cables, OLTC transformer, and switchable capacitor/inductor banks.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Linear outer approximation of SOC constraints using Ben-Tal–Nemirovski BTN relaxation.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Compared with Matpower; accuracy assessed by relaxation error and PF feasibility; faster for some cases but slower at higher BTN degree.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize active power exchange at the PCC, representing collector-grid losses, plus a penalty on reactive mismatch with the PCC setpoint.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Reserve Constrained AC Optimal Power Flow Using Accelerated Primal-Dual Interior Point Method
data_properties.hasAuthor: Yehong Peng; Yong Fu
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Co-optimize energy dispatch and operating reserve allocation in AC power system operation.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Conventional reserve scheduling or simplified ED-based approaches neglect full AC network constraints and can cause infeasibility, voltage insecurity, congestion, and suboptimality.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Single-period reserve-constrained AC optimal power flow with device energy/reserve co-optimization, AC network limits, and zonal reserve requirements.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: How can reserve models be efficiently incorporated into AC OPF and solved accurately for large-scale systems?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal generation and consumption dispatch, device reserve allocations, bus voltage magnitudes and angles, AC branch power flows, shunt steps, transformer tap ratios and phase shifts, and reserve shortfall amounts.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Single-period nonlinear AC OPF with co-optimized energy and real/reactive reserve scheduling.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Full AC branch flow equations with voltage magnitudes/angles, transformer tap ratios, phase shifting, and shunt modeling.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single-period.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses predefined zonal reserve requirements; no explicit stochastic or robust uncertainty model.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Includes producing and consuming devices, real/reactive reserves, zonal reserve zones, shunts, transformers, and branch overload penalties.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Accelerated primal-dual interior point method with symmetric Jacobian, Cholesky factorization, direct step-size update, and tailored initialization.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Designed for faster and more stable solution of large-scale RCOPF instances.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Consuming devices participate in energy and reserve provision.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Maximize total market surplus: device consumption benefit minus generation cost, imbalance penalties, branch overload penalties, reserve offer costs, zonal reserve shortfall penalties, and reactive reserve costs.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Equality constraints enforce device definitions, reserve cost definitions, AC branch flow equations, bus real/reactive power balances, and zonal reserve requirements; inequalities bound device outputs, reserve capabilities, voltage magnitudes, transformer settings, branch apparent flows, shunt steps, and reserve requirements.
data_properties.usesParameter: Offer/bid block prices, imbalance penalty costs, branch overload penalty cost, reserve marginal costs, branch conductance/susceptance, shunt coefficients, device power limits, reserve capability limits, zonal reserve requirements and scaling factors, branch flow limits, voltage/tap/phase bounds.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Solved by A-PDIPM using perturbed KKT conditions, symmetric Jacobian construction, pivoted Cholesky factorization, matrix reordering/scaling, direct feasibility-preserving step sizes, and problem-specific primal/dual initialization.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on 73-bus to 23,643-bus GO3-derived cases; compared with pre-reserve/post-reserve OPF and IPOPT.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: RCOPF produced converged secure solutions and higher market surplus than simplified reserve allocation approaches; A-PDIPM reduced iterations and runtime, especially on large cases.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: accurate AC co-optimization with reserves and improved computational efficiency. Limitation: single-period formulation and some scenarios still allow reserve shortfalls when economically optimal.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Derived from DOE ARPA-E Grid Optimization Challenge 3 datasets.

data_properties.hasModelName: Real Time Sequential Security Constrained OPF
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Real-Time Sequential Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow: A Hybrid Knowledge-Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning Approach
data_properties.hasAuthor: Zhongkai Yi; Xue Wang; Cheng Yang; Chao Yang; Mengyang Niu; Wotao Yin
data_properties.hasInstitution: Alibaba DAMO Academy; Alibaba US; Tsinghua University; Harbin Institute of Technology
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve sequential real-time security-constrained optimal power flow with fast dispatch decisions under inaccurate environmental parameters.
data_properties.hasMotivation: ACOPF is nonconvex, time-coupled by ramping limits, and difficult to solve quickly and safely when system parameters are inaccurate or contingencies are unexperienced.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Sequential security-constrained AC optimal power flow for real-time operation with generator active/reactive dispatch and network security limits.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning method produce safe real-time OPF dispatches efficiently without relying on accurate environmental models?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Safe generator active and reactive power dispatch commands; resulting bus voltage magnitudes and branch active/reactive power flows within limits.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid knowledge-data-driven reinforcement learning with a safety-layer projection model and inactive-constraint identification.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow formulation with nonlinear nodal injections, branch flows, voltage magnitudes, and ramping-coupled generator limits.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Sequential multi-step dispatch with future load forecasts and ramping-coupled time dependence.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Real-time operation over time slots; forecasting horizon T steps.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Infinite-horizon sequential decision process terminated by grid failure/non-convergence.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Uses reinforcement learning for inaccurate environments and updates safety-layer parameters from latest measurements.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained ACOPF with coordinated active and reactive power dispatch, voltage and branch-flow security limits.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Improved SAC with SAM, prioritized replay, adaptive entropy, hybrid safety layer, and inactive-constraint elimination.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Claims faster decision-making and reduced security violations with comparable economic performance.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Includes forecasted net load demand in the state; no explicit demand response control.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize cumulative generation operating cost, with quadratic cost coefficients for each generator over time.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power-balance equations, branch active/reactive flow equations, generator active/reactive limits, branch flow limits, voltage magnitude limits, and ramping-coupled generator bounds; safety-layer projection also enforces linearized security constraints and power balance.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generator cost coefficients; generator active/reactive bounds and ramping limits; bus voltages; line conductance/susceptance or resistance/reactance; branch flow limits; load demand and forecasted load; slack-bus limits; penalty coefficients; SAC temperature and learning rates.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Sequential decisions are produced by an improved soft actor-critic policy, then projected by a linear security layer initialized from linearized power-flow knowledge and updated with data; inactive constraints are removed analytically.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated on IEEE 30-bus and larger systems, including contingency and parameter-error scenarios, with comparisons against penalty, constrained-policy, and pure data-driven safety-layer baselines.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The method maintains voltages and branch flows within safe ranges, reduces violation times in early training and contingencies, and scales to larger systems with low decision time.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: safe real-time dispatch, better robustness to inaccurate models, and high computational efficiency. Limitation: safety layer uses linearized power-flow approximation and may need conservative limits to offset approximation error.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: The paper also evaluates scalability on 9-, 30-, 57-, 118-, and 1187-bus systems.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：与需求高度一致，直接面向风电场一次电压控制，目标就是降低集电网损耗并满足PCC无功指令，同时协调风机、静态电容/电抗器组与OLTC的无功分配。 / English explanation: Highly consistent with the requirement; it directly targets wind-farm primary voltage control, aims to reduce collector-grid losses while satisfying PCC reactive-power instructions, and coordinates reactive allocation among wind turbines, static capacitor/reactor banks, and OLTCs.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：主要限制是单时段静态OPF，更适合单一工况；若用户需要显式多时段联动或更强动态控制，这一点不够。 / English explanation: The main limitation is that it is a single-period static OPF, so it fits one operating condition well; it is less suitable if explicit multi-period coupling or richer dynamic control is required.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：具备无功重分配、损耗降低、电容器组控制和变压器分接头参数，和电压/无功协调有一定相关性，但核心场景是三相配电网与微电网，不是风电场集电网主电压控制。 / English explanation: It includes reactive redispatch, loss reduction, capacitor-bank control, and transformer tap-ratio parameters, so it is related to voltage/reactive coordination, but its core setting is three-phase distribution feeders and microgrids rather than wind-farm collector-grid primary voltage control.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：没有明确针对PCC无功指令跟踪，也没有把风机、静态电容/电抗器组与OLTC作为风电场专用协同对象，因此对用户的关键机制支持不足。 / English explanation: It does not explicitly track PCC reactive-power instructions, nor does it coordinate turbines, shunt capacitor/reactor banks, and OLTCs as a wind-farm-specific control set, so it misses key mechanisms in the request.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：虽然是完整AC OPF，并包含无功、变压器分接头和电压控制变量，但其核心目标是储备协同与市场剩余最大化，不是风电场一次电压控制或集电网损耗最小化。 / English explanation: Although it is a full AC OPF and includes reactive power, transformer tap, and voltage-control variables, its core objective is reserve co-optimization and market surplus maximization, not wind-farm primary voltage control or collector-grid loss minimization.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：缺少风机—静态电容/电抗器—OLTC的专门无功分配机制，也没有面向PCC无功指令的明确跟踪目标，因此与用户需求偏离较大。 / English explanation: It lacks a dedicated turbine–capacitor/reactor–OLTC reactive allocation mechanism and does not explicitly track PCC reactive instructions, so it diverges substantially from the requested model.

checked_candidates.consistency_check: 中文说明：它是通用配电网D-OPF基准模型，确实包含电容器组、调压器和DG无功控制，并以网损最小化为目标之一，因此在电压/无功优化层面有一定可用性。 / English explanation: It is a general distribution-grid D-OPF benchmark and does include capacitor banks, voltage regulators, and DG reactive control, with loss minimization as one objective, so it has some relevance for voltage/reactive optimization.
checked_candidates.violation_or_gap: 中文说明：但它不是风电场集电网的一次电压控制专用模型，没有明确的PCC无功指令跟踪，也没有风机—电容/电抗器—OLTC的专门协调结构。 / English explanation: However, it is not a wind-farm primary voltage-control model, it does not explicitly track PCC reactive instructions, and it lacks the dedicated turbine–capacitor/reactor–OLTC coordination structure.

requirement.requirement_text: A machine learning-aided fast SCOPF model is needed for obtaining near-optimal solutions that satisfy constraints in large-scale power grids. Pure machine learning can easily violate power flow balance constraints, so this method only predicts voltage magnitudes and angles, and then uses physical network equations to recover the remaining OPF variables.

prefilter_result.user_requirement: A machine learning-aided fast SCOPF model is needed for obtaining near-optimal solutions that satisfy constraints in large-scale power grids. Pure machine learning can easily violate power flow balance constraints, so this method only predicts voltage magnitudes and angles, and then uses physical network equations to recover the remaining OPF variables.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文：该模型直接面向安全约束 AC OPF，并采用机器学习预测关键电压变量，再通过网络方程恢复其余变量，和“先预测电压幅值与相角、再用物理方程补全 OPF 变量”的需求高度一致。/ English: This model directly targets security-constrained AC OPF and uses machine learning to predict key voltage variables, then recovers the remaining variables through network equations, closely matching the requested “predict voltages first, then recover OPF variables physically” workflow.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文：它是单时段静态 SCOPF，主要验证于 500-bus GO 网络；若用户需要更强的在线泛化或跨场景鲁棒性，仍需额外检验。/ English: It is a single-period static SCOPF, validated mainly on a 500-bus GO network; if the user needs stronger online generalization or cross-scenario robustness, additional testing is needed.
supporting_evidence: hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve security-constrained AC optimal power flow efficiently using a machine-learning-aided approach.
hasPrimaryOutput: Bus voltage magnitudes and voltage angles; derived current injections, complex/real power injections, generator dispatch settings, and branch power flows.
hasSolutionDetailsSummary: RF is trained on converged MATPOWER solutions; case I predicts v and θ then computes injections and costs via network equations.

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文说明：该模型直接面向快速、近最优的 ACOPF 求解，并明确采用物理约束校准来提升可行性，和“先预测电压幅值与相角，再用物理方程恢复其余变量”的思路高度一致。 / English explanation: This model targets fast, near-optimal ACOPF and explicitly uses physics-informed calibration to improve feasibility, closely matching the idea of predicting voltage magnitudes and angles first, then recovering the remaining variables with network equations.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文说明：它是 ACOPF 而非明确的 SCOPF，且校准在部分大系统测试中并非总能收敛，因此在强安全约束或更大规模场景下可能需要额外稳健性。 / English explanation: It is ACOPF rather than explicitly SCOPF, and calibration did not converge on all larger-system tests, so stronger security constraints or larger grids may require extra robustness.
supporting_evidence: "hasPrimaryPurpose": "Generate ACOPF solutions using physics-informed deep learning and feasibility calibration."
"hasPrimaryOutput": "Optimal bus voltage magnitudes and phase angles, generator active/reactive power dispatch, and calibrated feasible ACOPF solutions."

"hasSolutionDetailsSummary": "A CNN predicts voltages and angles from demand; power-flow equations reconstruct generator outputs and demand; an iterative calibration loop updates load-bus voltages and generator injections"

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文：该模型直接面向实时安全约束OPF，强调快速、可行且接近最优的调度；并且输出包含母线电压幅值、相角以及有功/无功潮流，符合“先预测电压再用物理方程恢复其余变量”的安全约束求解思路。 / English: This model directly targets real-time security-constrained OPF, emphasizing fast, feasible, near-optimal dispatch. It outputs bus voltage magnitudes, angles, and active/reactive flows, aligning well with the idea of predicting voltages first and recovering the remaining variables through network equations.
selected_candidates.main_risk_or_gap: 中文：方法依赖强化学习与线性化安全层，物理恢复环节采用线性化近似，面对强非线性或极端工况时可能需要保守约束。 / English: The method relies on reinforcement learning plus a linearized safety layer; the recovery step is approximate, so strong nonlinearity or extreme operating conditions may require conservative limits.
supporting_evidence: hasPrimaryPurpose: "Solve sequential real-time security-constrained optimal power flow with fast dispatch decisions under inaccurate environmental parameters."
hasPrimaryOutput: "Safe generator active and reactive power dispatch commands; resulting bus voltage magnitudes and branch active/reactive power flows within limits."
hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: "Improved SAC with SAM, prioritized replay, adaptive entropy, hybrid safety layer, and inactive-constraint elimination."

selected_candidates.why_matched: 中文说明：该模型就是面向快速求解 SCOPF，采用混合数据驱动方法并输出基准工况调度与满足约束的电压、潮流结果，适合大规模电网的近实时应用。 / English explanation: This model is explicitly for fast SCOPF solving, using a hybrid data-driven method and producing base-case dispatch plus contingency-feasible voltages and flows, suitable for near-real-time large-grid use.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Machine Learning-Aided Security Constrained Optimal Power Flow
data_properties.hasAuthor: Jubeyer Rahman; Cong Feng; Jie Zhang
data_properties.hasInstitution: The University of Texas at Dallas
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve security-constrained AC optimal power flow efficiently using a machine-learning-aided approach.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Full AC OPF is highly nonlinear and non-convex, making large-scale security-constrained solving computationally challenging.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Security-constrained AC optimal power flow with switched shunt security constraints.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a machine-learning-aided method predict key OPF variables and avoid running a physics-based OPF solver while preserving feasibility?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Bus voltage magnitudes and voltage angles; derived current injections, complex/real power injections, generator dispatch settings, and branch power flows.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid machine-learning-aided OPF using multi-input multi-output random forest plus physics-based network equations.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power-flow equations with bus admittance matrix, current injection, apparent power, and nodal power balance.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Single-period steady-state OPF.
data_properties.hasTemporalResolution: Not specified; load samples from hourly ERCOT profile used for training/testing.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: Single operating snapshot per case.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: No explicit uncertainty model; trained on sampled load cases.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Security-constrained AC transmission OPF with generators, buses, branches, and switched shunts.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Multi-input multi-output random forest predicts voltages, then network equations recover remaining variables.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported zero constraint violation for the proposed method and much faster solution time than MATPOWER MIPS.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Load demand inputs Pd and Qd are used as predictors; no demand response model.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, with generator costs represented by individual piece-wise linear cost functions.

data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Learn OPF solutions directly from operating conditions using a physics-informed data-driven regression framework.

data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Nonlinear, nonconvex OPF calculation for large-scale power systems with renewable uncertainty and many samples.

data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Monte Carlo-generated training samples with renewable and load fluctuations.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: IEEE 39, 57, 118-bus and Polish 2383-bus benchmark systems with wind and photovoltaic integration.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Feature decomposition, reinforcement-mode SELM, and active-constraint sample clustering.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Fast training and testing with improved accuracy over original SELM and deep-learning alternatives.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Power demand inputs PDi and QDi; renewables treated as negative loads.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation operating cost, modeled as the sum of quadratic generator cost functions over generator buses.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: AC power balance equations; branch active/reactive flow equations; generator active/reactive limits; bus voltage magnitude limits; branch flow limits.

data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: The proposed approach achieved the best accuracy and much faster computation, and direct learning with original SELM was intractable for OPF.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: fast, few hyperparameters, extensible across systems. Limitation: direct deep learning and original SELM struggle with OPF complexity; future work targets field-data validation.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Sample pre-classification uses active-constraint critical regions to cluster similar OPF samples.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Optimal Power Flow Using Graph Neural Networks
data_properties.hasAuthor: Damian Owerko; Fernando Gama; Alejandro Ribeiro
data_properties.hasInstitution: University of Pennsylvania, Department of Electrical and Systems Engineering
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Approximate AC optimal power flow solutions with a local, scalable graph neural network trained by imitation learning.
data_properties.hasMotivation: ACOPF is non-convex and costly to solve, and existing approximate methods do not scale well to large power networks.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: AC optimal power flow on power networks, using IEEE-30 and IEEE-118 test cases.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a graph neural network learn to imitate optimal ACOPF solutions accurately and efficiently in a decentralized, scalable way?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Estimated optimal generator active power outputs; evaluated against IPOPT ACOPF solutions.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Graph neural network parametrization with local message passing and scalable architecture.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: AC power flow equations with nonlinear active and reactive power balance.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Training uses randomly sampled load scenarios from uniform ranges around reference loads.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: Generator dispatch, bus voltages, active/reactive loads, and network topology on IEEE test systems.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Imitation learning with GNNs trained on IPOPT-generated optimal solutions.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Reported relative RMSE and much faster inference than IPOPT.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Loads are sampled as inputs; model predicts generator dispatch to meet demand.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost, with generator cost depending on active power output.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Active and reactive power balance equations p=P(v,δ;W), q=Q(v,δ;W), plus elementwise bounds Xmin ⪯ X ⪯ Xmax on voltages, angles, active and reactive powers.
data_properties.usesParameter: Network adjacency/weights W from line impedances; node states X=[v,δ,p,q]; generator selection matrix G; load vectors pL and qL; generator cost functions cm(pm).
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: IPOPT is used to solve ACOPF and generate training targets; GNNs are trained with MSE using ADAM on IEEE-30 and IEEE-118 datasets.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Evaluated on held-out test sets from IEEE-30 and IEEE-118; compared against global/local GNN and MLP baselines using relative RMSE.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: GNNs outperform MLP baselines, especially on the larger IEEE-118 case, and provide orders-of-magnitude faster inference than IPOPT.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: local, scalable, permutation-equivariant, and stable to graph perturbations. Limitation: trained to imitate IPOPT solutions rather than solve OPF exactly.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Uses graph convolution layers with K-hop neighborhood aggregation.

data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Estimating Global Variables in Multi-agent Distributed OPF with Unreliable Communication
data_properties.hasAuthor: Masoud Bashari; Mikhak Samadi; Javad Zare; Ashkan Rahimi-Kian
data_properties.hasInstitution: IEMS Group Ltd.; University of Ottawa
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Solve distributed optimal power flow under unreliable communication by estimating exchanged global variables.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Communication link disruptions can prevent consensus exchange in distributed OPF and degrade convergence and feasibility.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Distributed OPF across multiple regions with lost or interrupted communication links between agents.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can predictive estimation of missing consensus messages preserve feasible D-OPF convergence when communication is interrupted?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Regional bus voltage magnitudes and phase angles, weighted-average global bus voltages, and convergence of D-OPF results across iterations.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Multi-agent distributed OPF with coordinator-agent consensus and predictive estimation of missing exchanged variables.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: Region-based OPF coupled through tie-line voltage consensus and line power-flow equations.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Iterative multi-region consensus over repeated ADMM iterations.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Handles unreliable communication by estimating missing consensus messages with a trained DFNN.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: IEEE 14-bus transmission network partitioned into three regions with PV units and a BESS.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Extended ADMM combined with a shallow feedforward neural-network estimator for missing messages.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Faster convergence to actual global variables and feasible D-OPF results under interrupted links.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total generation cost for each region/sub-network.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: Regional OPF constraints are enforced through bus-voltage and tie-line coupling; line power flows are updated from estimated voltages and consensus variables.
data_properties.usesParameter: Bus voltage magnitudes and phase angles, tie-line voltages, line impedances, line currents, regional loads S_i,j^t, PV units, and BESS size.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: IEEE 14-bus case split into three areas; ADMM iterations compute regional OPF, estimate missing voltages with DFNN, average exchanged voltages, and update line flows.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Compared three scenarios: normal communication, lost bus-5 communication, and lost communication recovered by estimation; tested on IEEE 14-bus case.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: With DFNN-based estimation, interrupted-link cases converged closer to global voltages and faster than the unrecovered communication-loss case.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strength: improves distributed OPF feasibility and convergence under communication loss. Limitation: estimator still shows biased error and needs more training data.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: ANN/DFNN estimator trained on OPF data generated from 90%–100% loading scenarios.

data_properties.hasModelName: Multi Period Hybrid AC DC OPF
data_properties.hasPaperTitle: Multi-Period Hybrid AC/DC-OPF Model for Flexibility Market Clearing With Seamless TSO-DSO Coordination
data_properties.hasAuthor: Damian Sieraszewski; Ole Kjærland Olsen; Dmytro Ivanko; Irina Oleinikova; Hossein Farahmand
data_properties.hasInstitution: Department of Electric Power Engineering, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU); NORCE Norwegian Research Centre
data_properties.hasPrimaryPurpose: Model flexibility market clearing and TSO-DSO coordination using a hybrid AC/DC optimal power flow formulation.
data_properties.hasMotivation: Need to unlock consumer-side flexibility and coordinate DSO and TSO operations to address congestion, voltage, and balancing challenges.
data_properties.hasSolvedProblem: Seamless coordination of transmission and distribution grid operation in a local flexibility market with multi-period flexibility procurement.
data_properties.hasResearchQuestion: Can a multi-period hybrid AC/DC-OPF model accurately clear flexibility and coordinate TSO-DSO actions across transmission and distribution grids?
data_properties.hasPrimaryOutput: Optimal day-ahead dispatch and flexibility market dispatch, including generation, flexible load, battery charging/discharging, load shedding, bus voltages, and line power flows.
data_properties.hasModelFeature: Hybrid SOC-ACOPF for distribution grid and DC-OPF for transmission grid; multi-period formulation; AC-DC connection constraint.
data_properties.hasPowerFlowFormulationFeature: SOC-ACOPF for distribution; DC-OPF for transmission; convex relaxation with auxiliary variables.
data_properties.hasTimeHorizonFeature: Multi-period; hourly day-ahead plus quarter-hour flexibility intervals; rolling horizon in operation.
data_properties.hasOptimizationHorizon: 24 hours with quarter-hour subperiods.
data_properties.hasUncertaintyHandlingFeature: Scenario-based planning mentioned, but probabilistic scenarios are not developed in this paper.
data_properties.hasPowerSystemDomainFeature: TSO-DSO coordination in a local flexibility market with transmission and radial distribution grids.
data_properties.hasSolutionMethodEnhancementFeature: Pyomo implementation solved with Gurobi; two-stage optimization for day-ahead and flexibility market clearing.
data_properties.hasModelPerformanceFeature: Validated on standard test grids; reported high accuracy and applicability; compared with standalone AC and DC OPF.
data_properties.hasDemandSideFeature: Flexible loads, load shifting, load shedding, distributed generation, and batteries.
data_properties.hasObjectiveFunction: Minimize total operating cost of transmission and distribution generation, flexibility activation, battery operation, and load shedding across all periods.
data_properties.hasConstraintFunction: SOC-ACOPF power balance and conic relaxation constraints; AC-DC coupling constraint; DC power balance, line flow limits, slack angle; flexible generation/load bounds; zero-net load shifting; battery SoC, charge/discharge, and terminal SoC constraints; load shedding equals served load.
data_properties.usesParameter: Generation cost coefficients, flexibility prices, battery cost, load-shedding cost, network susceptance matrices, active/reactive load limits, generation limits, line flow limits, slack angle, battery SoC bounds, charge/discharge limits, efficiencies, and initial SoC.
data_properties.hasSolutionDetailsSummary: Implemented in Python with Pyomo and solved using Gurobi on a 33-bus distribution grid and 9-bus transmission grid test case.
data_properties.hasModelValidationSummary: Validated against standalone SOC-ACOPF and DC-OPF results and tested on flexibility, voltage, and congestion cases.
data_properties.hasFindingsSummary: Flexibility reduced costs, improved voltages, lowered imported transmission power and distribution losses, and could also relieve transmission congestion.
data_properties.hasStrengthsAndLimitationsSummary: Strengths: unified multi-period TSO-DSO coordination and flexibility clearing. Limitation: single-optimization formulation may become computationally heavy for multiple DSOs; reactive power flexibility not yet included.
data_properties.hasFurtherProperty: Future work extends the model with ADMM for multiple DSOs and reactive power flexibility exchange.
